games.name: A Factory Roguelike
games.summary: Engineer an efficient production pipeline to keep up with the increasing demand rates of the Boxes. Choose reward bundles and research modules strategically to expand your factory and optimize efficiency.

games.name: A little Jumpingspider's Garden Adventure (Day 1+2)
games.summary:
A little Jumpingspider's Garden Adventure is a mix of a 3D platformer and a mini game collection.
You follow the adventures of a cute little jumping spider, which needs to catch food and find a mate.
Each of the 16 levels has it's own unique game mechanics and offers a completely different experience.
Some levels test how fast you can react, others challenge your sense of direction and some are just the joy of collecting things.
Every level has 3 stages of difficulty (easy, normal and hard), which sometimes contain new mechanics and/or enemies.
This game is designed to be family friendly and approachable even for beginners (because of that you don't have to control the camera manually).

games.name: Abyssal Anarchy
games.summary: A fast-paced co-op spell-hell where each map pulls you deeper into the Abyss. Choose from 5 heroes and 14 spells, unlock upgrades, and survive alone or with friends as the magic grows wilder with every descent.

games.name: Ake no Yosuga: Twilight Loop
games.summary:
This is a loop-based psychological horror visual novel.

Every day at 5 PM, a girl named Akane dies.
The protagonist, Keita, becomes aware of this loop and struggles to change her fate.
However, no matter what choices he makes, her death is inevitable.
As the story unfolds, a shocking truth emerges—
Akane has been dying repeatedly to protect Keita.

games.name: All Out
games.summary:
All Out is a multiplayer gaming platform featuring a variety of online experiences created for players of all ages. Players can join games across multiple genres, including team-based PvP, social deduction, party games, survival challenges, and adventure experiences.

Featured games include Bed Wars, Random Roles, Hide and Seek, Squid Games, Murder Mystery, Fishermon, Backrooms, and many others. Players can play with friends, join public servers, unlock rewards, customize their characters, and participate in regularly updated multiplayer experiences.

Available on web and mobile platforms, All Out supports both casual and competitive gameplay through a growing collection of multiplayer games.

games.name: Arcane Merchant
games.summary: Open your own shop in the heart of a Medieval Fantasy realm! Stock your shelves with everything from potions and swords to mysterious crystals and legendary artifacts. Set your prices, earn your customers' trust and become the richest merchant in town!

games.name: Archwizard
games.summary: Fast paced "Hyper Shooter" complemented with esoteric exploration experience. Take a quest to become Arch Wizard: dominate surrounding realms, reverse Time, escape Death, befriend Chaos, face the End of the World. Knowledge based progression. High scores. Full of secrets.

games.name: Barnacle
games.summary:
Investigate an abandoned multiplayer server frozen in time, where something clearly went wrong. What once felt familiar now feels empty, distorted, and watching.

This atmospheric walking simulator focuses on exploration, tension, and discovery. There are no hand-holding objectives. Instead, you are left to navigate liminal, blocky environments inspired by early multiplayer worlds, slowly uncovering what happened here.

Search for hidden items, uncover secrets, and piece together the story through environmental storytelling and scattered notes left behind. Every area holds fragments of the past, but not everything wants to be found.

As you explore deeper, the world begins to shift. Spaces loop, change, and react to your presence. You are not alone. Dangerous entities roam the server, and avoiding them may be the only way to survive.

Featuring a completely hand-crafted soundtrack by composer Nate Sassoon, with unique music created for every zone to capture the atmosphere, emotion, and identity of each area as you descend further into the server’s mystery.

What happened to this place—and why does it feel like it’s still alive?

games.name: Beam It Up!
games.summary: Capture monsters from distant planets and add them to your cosmic collection. Upgrade your ship, travel further, and become the galaxy’s top collector.

games.name: Beatdown City Survivors
games.summary: Punch a car so hard it EXPLODES! Dash through flaming gas to create a fire trail burning everything. Destroy a hydrant to douse out the fire. Beatdown City Survivors is an immersive sandbox meets survive-em-up with dynamic environments & outrageous lite weapon crafting & team building.

games.name: Black Border 3
games.summary: The border never sleeps — and neither can you.  Inspect documents, expose secrets, and make life-changing decisions in this gripping night patrol simulator where one mistake can change everything. ️‍♀️

games.name: Bloobs Adventure Idle
games.summary: Inspired by RuneScape, Bloobs Adventure Idle is a skill-based idle RPG with 24 skills, prestige progression, over 100 pets, and a unique banked-time system. Train, craft, and conquer at your own pace.

games.name: BrokenLore: Follow
games.summary: BrokenLore: Follow is a captivating psychological first-person horror game that immerses players in the haunting narrative of Anne, as she grapples with issues of self-acceptance, bullying, and worthlessness while encountering metaphorical surreal creatures that heighten the terror of her journey.

games.name: BugSquash
games.summary: You are a professional Bug Squasher. Clients reach out to you with their pest problems, and you'll respond to increasingly challenging infestations. With each successful job, you'll earn money to upgrade and expand your equipment and take on bigger, badder bugs.

games.name: Caliban
games.summary: A strategic blackjack roguelike. Stack drinks, runes, and gems into game-breaking combos. Beat cursed bosses. Chase the leaderboard. One deck. One dealer. Infinite builds.

games.name: Caribbean Frontier
games.summary: Start with your ship and a couple of coins to conquer the caribbean frontier. Use trade, diplomancy or piracy to gather wealth. Control cities, build new ships for you fleet and expand your influence! Or become a well known pirate that every vessel fears.

games.name: Castle in the Sands
games.summary: Castle in the Sands is a pixel art visual novel set in a world inspired by "One Thousand and One Nights" and North African culture. The adventure begins in the heart of the desert and leads you to fairytale places full of magic and danger.

games.name: Celestial Lumina
games.summary: Ascend from the depths as Evan, heir of a fallen underworld, to uncover the truth behind a world stripped of dawn. Celestial Lumina is a 2D Pixel-Art Metroidvania where Light clashes with the Darkness that stole the sky.

games.name: Chef Knight
games.summary: Cook what you kill in this cozy fantasy incremental. Slay monsters, turn them into delicious meals, and build your dungeon food business!

games.name: Chrysalis: Chrome Butterfly
games.summary: Chrysalis: Chrome Butterfly - a cyberpunk neo-noir thriller. Play as Wendy, an agent with memory gaps investigating a disappearance in Neo-Kyoto. Switch between choreographed combat and detective work to uncover a conspiracy where reality is an illusion. But is the truth worth knowing?

games.name: Cosy Housing
games.summary: Cozy Housing is a relaxing game Build and decorate your house in a soothing atmosphere. Explore a large collection of unique furniture and decoration, Give free rein to your creativity.

games.name: Damashi Game
games.summary: A thrilling multiplayer experience where social deception, strategy, and quick thinking are your greatest weapons. Outsmart your opponents and be the last player standing in this intense fight for survival.

games.name: DarkPurple
games.summary: Dark Purple is a strategic roguelike Deckbuilder Game wrapped in a vibrant anime art style, where every decision shapes your run and no two cards play quite the same. Build a powerful deck, face challenging enemies and see how far you can push.

games.name: Dear My Bot
games.summary:
Write, test, and break through.
A programming puzzle game about the joy of trial and error.

games.name: Divinity Vassals
games.summary: A pixel-art creature collection, raising, and combat game. Capture and train unique creatures with distinct genes and talents. Hundreds of skills can be freely combined, with each upgrade offering an extra talent draw chance.

games.name: Dragon Guardians
games.summary: Evolve your dragons, build your cave, collect rare power cards, and defeat powerful bosses across dangerous lands. Grow stronger with every battle!

games.name: Explorers of the Brick Universe
games.summary: Build the impossible together

games.name: Fatherhood Legacy
games.summary: Fatherhood Legacy is an immersive narrative that follows Bryson, a young gamer, as he clashes with his father, Booker, over his future. Through an emotional journey across the city and a meditation-induced flashback to Booker’s past, the two learn to communicate, discover their similarities, and begin overcoming their family’s wounds. Blending interactive storytelling with Black history, gaming culture, and emerging technology, this project explores healing, resilience, and the power of understanding across generations.

games.name: Fatimopolis
games.summary: Logo após a chegada do ano novo de 2005, Lucas recebe uma ligação de seu chefe pedindo que ele faça algumas entregas em Fatimopolis, um vilarejo misterioso que, da noite para o dia, perdeu todos os seus habitantes.

games.name: Final Strategy
games.summary: Final Strategy is a serious, modern real time strategy experience focused on large scale warfare and direct unit control. Command elite forces and race against time to stop a rogue nuclear operation built from abandoned Cold War stockpiles.

games.name: Focus Grove
games.summary: Build your cozy forest farm… while thriving in life. Focus Grove is a mindful game that improves your focus, well-being and work-life balance. Let your Woodlings grow your farm, while you grow in life.

games.name: For the Fish in the Bottle
games.summary: In the vast desert, you discover a tiny fish sealed inside a small bottle. It seems to want something. Solve the puzzles to collect the items the fish desires.

games.name: Fragile Frontier
games.summary: You're an owl postal worker who just brought the first automobile to Moonperch Island. Drive with packages stacked on your roof, hit a bump, watch them scatter! Triple-jump to glide, help friends recover cargo, upgrade your truck. 1-4 player co-op. But why is the mountain getting warmer...?

games.name: Freefall '95
games.summary: Fast paced, arcade-like, 90’s inspired action packed fun! Play as a passenger on board a doomed flight stuck in a twisted time loop in the year 1995. Explore a wild time-bending narrative while stacking up trick combos, collecting items, earning coins, upgrading abilities and dodging debris!

games.name: Furniture Fu
games.summary: Furniture Fu is a home-makeover, demon-hunting, hoard-fighting roguelike. Lay out furniture strategically to make awesome synergies and cosy houses - all in a day’s work for America’s first suburban ninja.

games.name: Game.exe 2: Phantom Strike
games.summary: You find an old computer with a forgotten program installed: Phantom Strike. A single server is still online, frozen in time and waiting for someone to finish the match. What begins as nostalgic curiosity becomes a descent into something far stranger.

games.name: Gaming Burnout Treatment Center
games.summary: Digital ED Treatment Center is a random launcher for players in a gaming slump. We help you rediscover the joy of play and unearth hidden gems buried in your library. Click to start your treatment and reignite your gaming vigor!

games.name: Gaslit Bay
games.summary: Gaslit Bay is a co-op horror game following strict, ever-changing rules in order to survive a night shift at a remote gas station. While reality breaks down serve customers, manage the store and avoid what lurks in the dark at all costs. One mistake, one broken rule... It could cost you everything.

games.name: Geode
games.summary: In this top-down, multiplayer, co-op game, you must protect your Core Crystal by any means necessary. Build up your defenses, explore, refine, and upgrade to reach your goal. Play alone or with up to 8 people.

games.name: Golel
games.summary: Golel, a first person roguelike Dungeon Crawler.Combat is focused on mobility and using the environment to your advantage.Dropping book shelves on an enemy, or kicking an enemy into a trap are all valid tactics.Deep skill/magic and combat gameplay, with many development paths.

games.name: GraveBoy CrowFeet: A Quest for Skulls
games.summary: A spooky fun 2D adventure with focus on exploration and light puzzling. Help GraveBoy to collect 10 rare skulls to save his father from a demon!

games.name: Heart of Gaia
games.summary: Lead the resistance against an ancient, dark order seeking to awaken an ancient evil and plunge Gaia into chaos. Explore a vast, Steampunk-themed fantasy world and face formidable adversaries in this action RPG featuring real-time character switching and dynamic combat.

games.name: Heli 100
games.summary: Heli 100 is Tree Men Games take on bullet hell / shmup games. Try to survive 100 missions of enemies in a small arena type of battle, be fast, dodge bullets, use power-ups and defeat the enemies. Who will be the best player of HELI 100? Leaderboards start at mission 100!

games.name: HeroTail: Survivors
games.summary: HeroTail Survivors is a run-based roguelike where your heroes form a living chain. Level up, recruit followers, and stack powerful set bonuses while battling through waves of enemies and unlocking permanent upgrades.

games.name: Indian Street Food Simulator
games.summary: Run your own simple and friendly Indian street food stall. Serve customers from your roadside stand, cook authentic dishes and absurd food combos, manage limited ingredients, and keep up with orders. A chaotic yet warm single-player experience focused on your stall.

games.name: Jigdoku
games.summary: Sudoku logic meets jigsaw instinct. Jigdoku hands you a 9×9 grid and a tray of double-sided polyominoes. Fit every piece into the grid so they interlock perfectly AND the numbers obey Sudoku rules when you nail it!

games.name: Journey of Destiny
games.summary: A Chinese ancient-style visual novel made with Ren'Py. Two factions fight for a mysterious relic. Your choices unlock multiple endings. The story includes suspense, time travel and soul fusion. Simple mouse and keyboard controls. Enjoy an immersive storytelling experience.

games.name: Just a Gun
games.summary: Just A Gun is an incremental point-and-click shooter where you evolve a single weapon through a massive upgrade tree.

games.name: Kal
games.summary: KAL is a first-person psychological horror game. Trapped in an old, abandoned Creole house, immerse yourself in a time loop and relive the story of a slave who became a true legend.

games.name: Kurage no Gakkou
games.summary: A teacher-in-training is sent to a middle school where all students are jellyfish, except for this one girl.

games.name: Let's Café
games.summary: Let's Café is a cafe business simulator game with a quirky and cozy atmosphere. Manage your menu as you experiment and discover new recipes, keep your ingredient budget balanced while shopping to soup up your store, cook quickly and creatively, and serve up smiles to an array of characters!

games.name: Lirai: Heir Of Darkness
games.summary:
Lirai: Heir of Darkness is a fast-paced action RPG set in a dark fantasy world consumed by an ancient curse. Players take on the role of Brian, a warrior who must uncover the truth behind their corrupted heritage before losing their humanity entirely.

The game features intense real-time combat with a fluid combo system that rewards precision and timing. Each enemy presents unique attack patterns and weaknesses that require both strategy and quick reflexes to overcome. Boss encounters push combat mastery to the limit with multi-phase battles against legendary demons trapped between worlds.

Lirai: Heir of Darkness combines challenging skill-based combat, atmospheric world design, and narrative-driven gameplay, exploring themes of sacrifice, identity, and the corrupting nature of power.

games.name: Lost in Art: A Miniature Realm
games.summary: Explore the miniature universe filled with Eastern mythology, forgotten folk tales and surprising historical events in this puzzle adventure game. Step into real artworks, unreveal mysteries by solving unique puzzles, and be the hero of the miniature folk.

games.name: Lucha Chess
games.summary: Assemble the ultimate team of Mexican wrestlers in this roguelike auto-battler. Combine unique units with powerful items and relics to discover hundreds of synergies while battling your way through.

games.name: Metal Shoot
games.summary: Join Boltie, the electric-blue little hero, in a classic pixel-art adventure inspired by 80s and 90s platformers! Jump, shoot and defeat enemies across fun and challenging stages!

games.name: Minestrike
games.summary: Minestrike - is a multiplayer first-person shooter computer game that combines fast-paced competitive gameplay, a unique atmosphere, and exciting team battles.

games.name: Murderous Sunlight
games.summary: In a dark world where Holy mages rewrite probability and Profane forces trap the dead in eternal patterns, Murderous Sunlight blends exploration, psychological depth, and occasional combat in an unsettling journey. Unravel a linear, character-driven story about trauma, identity, and defiance.

games.name: Narcissist Tail
games.summary:
A point and click horror with a bullet hell dodge combat system.

This game is about helping a wolf guy who gets annoyed at his loving family as you explore surreal environments.

games.name: Not Turn
games.summary:
Not Turn is a fast-paced one-button game.

Your goal is to go down the platforms while avoiding the enemies. You slide down the pillars that hold the platforms and you can choose to switch the pillar using the nearest platform by pressing a button. Hold a button to speed up. Collect the coins that the enemies drop to score points.

The game is over when you hit an enemy.

games.name: Orbital
games.summary: Explore the cosmos, discover new worlds, and seed life across the stars in ORBITAL, a relaxing 2D space exploration and colony sim. Guide the growth of your civilizations through rich, narrative-driven events where your choices shape their future. A cozy journey to the farthest reaches of space.

games.name: Organic Evolution
games.summary: Organic Evolution is a neon platformer set in a microcosm. Jump across organic structures, break blocks, avoid hostile creatures, and find keys to navigate through 8 biological environments.

games.name: PawlleyBall
games.summary: PawlleyBall is a cute volleyball game where cats face off in quick 1v1 matches. Jump, dive, and spike to score against opponents on colorful, stylized courts. Simple controls and lively rallies make it fun to pick up and replay.

games.name: Pay 2 Win: The World Is Mine
games.summary:
PAY 2 WIN is an incremental strategy game about running a game studio. Customize your progression, find epic rewards, and discover clever ways to go infinite, as you're joined by Annie and May, your cute anime-inspired assistants.

As your repute grows, so do your choices; switch seamlessly between passive idle gameplay and active resource generation to more quickly boost your progress in the game and story. Random rewards keep you guessing what's next, while you invest in your favorite facilities to make the numbers BIGGER.

Your decisions alter your run and affect your story. One thing is certain - to make it in this industry, you'll need strategy, a bit of luck, and resources. Lots and lots of resources.

games.name: Planks Wars
games.summary: Planks Wars is a fast, irreverent cross-platform PvP card battler where 200-foot-tall sorcerers use kidnapped adventurers as tournament pawns. Build your strategy with CCG-style deckbuilding, command your puppets... I mean, heroes, and climb the ranks.

games.name: Postponed
games.summary: An addictive wave-based arcade roguelite, in which you are the manager of a game development studio. You get a project each week, that your team and you have to work on to get paid. With that money get upgrades, skill your employees and even unlock characters. Ever wanted to lead a game dev studio?

games.name: Pour Boy and the Nitro Necromancer
games.summary: A wholesome spooky, highly caffeinated 2D platformer hand-drawn and developed by a real coffee shop owner. Play as Pour Boy, a demitasse homunculus, and punch through undead mugs, discover ancient secrets of the Brew Cycle, collect lost pet flies, and survive before the moon swallows you up.

games.name: Protect Your Humans
games.summary: Rebuild a kingdom, raise an army and defeat the Demon King and his servants in this 4 player Couch co-op action shoot-em-up adventure. Protect Your Humans, or there will be no humans left to fight with.

games.name: Rec Room
games.summary:
Rec Room is a virtual reality online game platform to build and play games together. Party up with friends from all around the world to chat, hang out, explore millions of player-created rooms, or build something new and amazing to share with us all.

On June 1, 2026, following financial issues within the Rec Room Inc. company, Rec Room officially ceased operations and shut down all game servers.

games.name: Recursive Riftfall
games.summary: Explore dungeons, collect loot, and avoid dangers in this exotic looter! Play solo or with as many as the host can handle. Power your ship and yourselves with the resources you find to ensure your continued survival.

games.name: Redstream Dispatch
games.summary: Redstream Dispatch casts you as a police officer responding to multiple Dispatch Scenarios. Routine patrols spiral into a violent nightmare tied to a sinister streaming group. Randomized encounters and reactive gore make every run brutal. Rescue the girl. Get out alive.

games.name: Rejected Draft
games.summary: Rejected Draft is an incremental auto-battler where you play as a discarded doodle seeking revenge on the Artist who threw you away. Battle rival sketches, absorb their powers, and grow stronger through a deep web of upgrades, skills, and progression systems. Unlike traditional RPGs, you decide which enemies appear in your world, shaping your build by choosing which powers become available. Every enemy is a sketch, and many enemies can appear in multiple alternate interpretations, each offering a different artistic take on the same concept. With strategic progression, long-term growth, and randomized elements that make each run feel different, Rejected Draft blends idle game progression with RPG buildcrafting and auto-battler combat.

games.name: Rocket 1994
games.summary: Rocket1994 is a casual rocket action game set within a program called the "C-40 Campaign." Pilot a physics-based rocket and reach the goal. As you progress, the tone of the guidance begins to shift. What is the true purpose of the C-40 Campaign? 9 stages. About 30 minutes. Multiple endings.

games.name: Rogue 'n' Roll: Dice of Fate
games.summary:
Rogue 'n' Roll: Dice of Fate is a roguelite strategy game that blends dice-based combat with deckbuilding elements. Players roll and manage dice to trigger abilities, build powerful synergies through relics, and face increasingly challenging encounters.

Each run offers randomized events, enemies, and rewards, encouraging experimentation with different builds and strategies. Adapt to unpredictable outcomes, make strategic decisions, and shape your fate one roll at a time.

games.name: Rogue Assault
games.summary: A real-time strategy military game that lets you directly command your units, with no build times and impressive 3D visuals. Set in a post‑apocalyptic Europe - form alliances with other commanders, fight for resources and territory and rise in honor as a war commander.

games.name: Sea of Pirates
games.summary:
Sea of Pirates is a top-down, open-sea pirate MMO — one living ocean, shared by captains from every corner of the world.

It offers the oldest fantasy on the water: a flag of your own, a crew at your back, and a horizon with no fixed edge. You begin as a nobody on a single-mast sloop and sail into a persistent world that remembers every cannon you fire and every rival you send to the deep. Rise far enough, and the seas learn your name.

This is a world built for the long voyage — seasonal, competitive, and shaped by the players who live in it. No two legends are written the same way. The tide is open; the rest is up to you.

games.name: Sery: Into the World of Myths
games.summary: Dive into the mythical dream world of Sery for an epic adventure. In this precision 2D platformer, Sery must restore balance between the real world and the dream world, battling malevolent figures that invade her dreams.

games.name: Shape World Level up Lite
games.summary: A hyper clicker that combines control and strategy! From casual play to extreme difficulty, anyone can take on the challenge. Experience a vast adventure and endless leveling created by a solo developer!

games.name: Shift Happens
games.summary: Ever wanted to live out the American dream of working an abysmal 9–5 with rude management? No? Well too bad, I made a game about it anyway. Shift Happens is a first-person experience where you order stock, fill shelves, and keep the store running. The job is simple. Enjoy your shift.

games.name: Silent Noise: Prologue
games.summary: Silent Noise is a psychological horror experience by MSP Games, built in the Godot Engine. The prologue demo introduces players to its atmospheric design, emotional depth, and psychological tension—favoring immersion over jump scares.

games.name: Sister Ray
games.summary: 2D RPG about the brutal daily life of a drug addicted artist called Ray, who takes care of her little sister. Look after your condition, so no one finds out about the addiction. Improve your drawing and social skills. Do everything to get cash for another fix. Survive and look for a way out.

games.name: Sodaman
games.summary: Sodaman, he's a space agent. He must stop the hostile aliens trying to destroy the universe and save the carbonated drinks they destroyed. Maybe you should help him out?

games.name: Starforged Legacy
games.summary: Outlast the onslaught in a sci-fi survivors-like where your decisions matter as much as your firepower. Command customizable starships, enhance your arsenal with 100+ strategy-defining upgrades, and annihilate endless fleets of cosmic combatants! Carve your legacy among the stars and die trying!

games.name: Suck It Up!
games.summary: Suck It Up! Is an action-adventure where you take the role of an exterminator, tasked with clearing a city of its critter infestation. Dust off your vacuum cleaner and suck up the pests to save Cloud Town!

games.name: Take Your Throne
games.summary: A Tower Defense-style game. Take a strong stance and defend your throne against the brazen and utterly shameless claims of your enemies. With each level, your opponents will become increasingly resourceful... be prepared for anything... from formal charges to an angry mob!

games.name: Tale of Dark Lands
games.summary: Tale of Dark Lands is a fantasy action RPG in a charming low-poly style with the spirit of an old fairy tale. A brave mercenary gets drawn into an ancient dark story that threatens the entire land. Develop your hero and fight dangerous enemies! Become a legend and stop the approaching darkness!

games.name: Tattoo Removal Simulator
games.summary: Take on the role of a skilled tattoo removal specialist. Enjoy a soothing pace that lets you focus on the calming process of tattoo removal. Set in a small studio in a bustling city, your all clients share one goal: erasing parts of their past, marked by colorful images, texts, secrets and stories.

games.name: Tenebrix
games.summary: Descend into a living dungeon where hesitation empowers the darkness. Build your deck, command creatures across tactical lanes, and survive a roguelike descent shaped by fear, strategy, and the echoes of your past failures.

games.name: The Odyssey of Commander Cookie
games.summary: Take command of the PSS, Paw Space Squadron, and catfight your way through relentless swarms of cybermice. Scavenge their tech. Upgrade your ship and weapons and unlock a fleet of fellow cat heroes, as you claw your way to victory in this intense roguelite twin-stick shooter.

games.name: The Victor Initiative
games.summary: The Victor Initiative is an atmospheric horror game about exploring an abandoned government facility that lost contact with the rest of the world 60 years ago.

games.name: Tiger Knight
games.summary: Tiger Knight is an exciting action strategy PVP game which reenacts large-scale warfare set circa 200 BC. Featuring meticulously recreated battle equipment and weaponry, Tiger Knight: Empire War will transport you back to the brutal era of melee combat.

games.name: Unclean Water
games.summary: Unclean Water is an FPS roguelike action game where you must escape the sewers of Marlene. Defeat Night Moss assassins using precise strikes, defense, smashes, and shield bashes to exploit enemy openings. Unlock a variety of furniture and items to turn your endless challenges into ultimate success.

games.name: Underchoice
games.summary: Underchoice is a survival simulator set in a sealed bunker. Become the overseer and shape the fate of those who come knocking at the door. Each decision you make, whether it is to let in a stranger, to use your resources on something, or to risk the safety of the bunker.

games.name: Until the End
games.summary: Love remembers you. Even if you’ve forgotten.

games.name: Vapor World: Over the Mind
games.summary:
To escape the twisted world, the boy begins his journey.

Vapor World is an action-adventure game that unfolds the inner world.

games.name: Voidcutter Fuzor
games.summary: Battle through waves of enemies, taking their power for your own in this retro-styled arcade shoot'em up.

games.name: Whiskers Tale
games.summary: A cozy cat adventure set in a charming city. Explore rooftops, chase pigeons, help townsfolk, and uncover heartfelt stories at your own pace.

games.name: Wrecking Wave
games.summary: Wrecking Wave is an explosive action game with physics-based destruction focused on Challenge and Speedrun. Unleash a wave of chaos and smash cities, chase high scores and stop a mad scientist from polluting your ocean with toxic waste.

games.name: Astro Colony
games.summary: Explore endless Universe and create the most efficient constellation of colonies. Build conveyor systems to automate production. Take care of Astronauts and their needs! Establish new colonies as part of intergalactic simulation.

games.name: Baff A
games.summary: Minimalist, hardcore and challenging game in the genre of avoid-em up that will test your reflexes, timing and planning! This game is hard as hell!

games.name: Banana of Doom
games.summary: A party style deck building and card crafting game where you combine words in hand to win tournaments! ‘Robot Grandma’ vs ‘Moist Goblin’, which is more likely to end the world? A hilarious fast-paced multiplayer party game.

games.name: Battleship Command
games.summary: Command the mighty Scharnhorst in this immersive WWII naval simulation. Walk her decks in first-person, control gunnery, radar, and navigation, and lead your fleet through the Atlantic, Arctic, and Mediterranean. Battle convoys, outwit enemies, and survive the stormy seas of war.

games.name: Beholder: Conductor
games.summary: A Beholder series spin-off. Become a conductor of the Determination Bringer train: monitor passengers, report incidents, and carry out important Ministry assignments — whose level of secrecy depends only on your loyalty. And remember: mission success is very important to you!

games.name: Blackwood House
games.summary: Step into Blackwood House, a haunting text-driven horror mystery where every command pulls you deeper into a cursed family's buried past.

games.name: Bounce On
games.summary: A side-scrolling platform game, originally for mobile devices but recently ported to desktop.

games.name: Bugs in the Brain
games.summary: Bugs in the Brain is a Soup-like project crafted in the Bapalon engine. There are 18 rooms separated by 3 nights, or "swarms", in this case. 3 swarms, 6 rooms each.

games.name: Camelot Unchained
games.summary: Camelot Unchained is an in-development fantasy massively multiplayer online role-playing game from City State Entertainment which was partially funded through Kickstarter. Leading its production is Mark Jacobs, the former designer of Dark Age of Camelot.

games.name: Campsite Hustle
games.summary: Build your own outdoor store and campground in the heart of Red Shore Valley. Set up your shelves, manage your stock, expand your campsite, and take care of every guest. From humble beginnings to a thriving business all in the middle of nature!

games.name: Cheater's Table
games.summary: Play fair. Die first. A color-based shedding card game built around bluffing, cheating, and social risk. Simple rules, deadly consequences.

games.name: Counter Call: Half Escape Shooter
games.summary: Pressure never stops!

games.name: Daydream Mosaics 6: Empire - Collector's Edition
games.summary: Raven and Juliette are getting married—and while they build six magical cities to unite their peoples, Lucas and Reya set out to find the perfect wedding gift. Enjoy 204 colorful nonogram levels plus jigsaw, clutter, hidden object, match 3, and more in this charming Collector’s Edition!

games.name: Dino-Ducks Mayhem
games.summary: Dino-Ducks Mayhem is a twin-stick shooter with bullet heaven vibes, wrapped around duck-builder system, set in a duck-tastic world and all about surviving as long as you can while everything explodes around you.

games.name: Eclipse: Anomaly Research
games.summary: Investigate a haunted swamp as Ivy Summers, a field agent facing reality-breaking anomalies and a deadly creature. Monitor cameras, report the paranormal, survive the hunt, and uncover the swamp’s dark secret before the time loop resets everything.

games.name: FPSCore
games.summary: Competitive arena based FPS. If you enjoyed the Quake series and are looking for a fast paced, skill based, action packed multiplayer PVP shooter then look no further. FPSCore comes packed with the old school movement mechanics you know and love; bunny hopping, rocket jumping, wall surfing and more!

games.name: Fatekeeper
games.summary: Venture into a handcrafted world where ruins whisper of past cataclysms. Master the art of sword and sorcery and forge your path with relics, spells and choices that shape who you become in this first-person RPG.

games.name: Fortune Mill
games.summary: An incremental game where you must make $1,000,000 in each room to advance. Throw darts, play scratch-off tickets, unlock automation, and choose upgrades carefully as each room affects all the others. Can you escape the Fortune Mill?

games.name: Ghost Platform
games.summary: What happened on the oil platform? Find out in this third-person action game, search for clues and eliminate the zombies

games.name: Haligen Zero
games.summary: Find the answer in the incident involving the Professor and unravel the secret of the Awakened.

games.name: Hobby Horse
games.summary: Create your own hobby horse and hit the obstacle courses! Slay every ride, win trophies, improve and become the best hobby horse rider!

games.name: I Am Better Than You
games.summary: Prove you're better than the rest by popping balloons with household items! Control your helium-filled robot and make it clear who’s in charge. Wipe out your opponents and the friendship that binds you because only one can win.

games.name: Irradiate 235
games.summary: Discover and automate unique materials. Engineer the machines and tools for your factory. Handle hazardous materials to make explosives and near-limitless energy. Use your own tools to navigate a labyrinth of alien passages and uncover untouched tunnels in this innovative Automation-Metroidvania.

games.name: Joey The Duck
games.summary:
Joey The Duck is a linear, open level type platformer game.

Join Joey as he explores different locations within one large, diverse level.

Don't be fooled by his cuteness - Joey is a materialistic, money-driven duck who embarks on a risky journey through the Forbidden Lands in search of a treasure that may not even exist.

There's no main menu, no world map, no hub world - Joey keeps moving forward without pause to get his feathers on that so-called mythical treasure.

The game features minimalist pixel-art style, with the option to switch between light and dark modes, as well as effects like CRT TV simulation and Black and White mode. These effects can even be combined for an extra retro vibe.

Collect coins, jump on enemies, interact with the environment, and get that legendary treasure!

Key Features:

One big level, zero interruptions - no main menu, no world map, just go!

Light Mode and Dark Mode - switch the style anytime!

Optional effects - play with CRT TV or Black and White effects, or even combine them!

Minimalist pixel art - cute and colorful!

Play as Joey - He's greedy, he's cute and he's cool!

games.name: Kickabout
games.summary:
Created by the Lead Designer of Guitar Hero and creator of Slope, Rob Kay, Kickabout brings high-speed physics and kinetic chaos to tabletop football.

The finger football controls are easy to pick up but difficult to master, the game delivering fast-paced, two-minute matches inspired by foosball and air hockey. As a Universal App for both iPhone and iPad, it offers a single-handed portrait mode ideal for commutes, as well as a spacious digital tabletop experience built for face-to-face action.

Whether diving into solo competition or hosting a local multiplayer match, Kickabout is designed for instant accessibility and deep skill development. Single-player mode lets gamers collect and represent 40+ national teams while climbing the global leaderboard, while two-player local multiplayer turns any shared device into a lively, competitive party game.

Built as an indie passion project, Kickabout delivers accessible, skill-based arcade sports action for quick gaming sessions on the go.

games.name: Kingdom Conquer
games.summary: Build, lead and fight in a first-person Viking colony-survival game. Place every structure by hand, command settlers in real time, and personally raid enemy lands in a massive persistent world.

games.name: MegaFactory Titan
games.summary: A factory building game set on Saturn's moon Titan. Explore an infinite procedural world. Build a smart factory that manages logistics automatically. Trade, negotiate, and fight with Colonists, Rebels, Terrorists, and Pirates.

games.name: Monster Ops 19
games.summary: Season 2 of Monster Ops! Black Ops soldiers Wraith and Tide know the world is against them, and they can only rely on each other. Two soldiers, forced to go rogue, with a desperate mission. There's no one left they can trust. A NSFW Gay Visual Novel Dating Sim put out in Monthly Episodes!

games.name: Moonlit Nights
games.summary: Moonlit Nights is a base management game set in a zombie apocalypse world. Form raiding parties and send them out to gather supplies, deal with mysterious visitors, and make difficult choices. How many days can you survive, or can you be freed and return to your normal life? Make your choice wisely.

games.name: My Garage
games.summary: My Garage is a car simulation game with main focus being simulating real car repair, maintenance, and physics.

games.name: My Little Cafe Nightmare
games.summary: Brew otherworldly coffee for ghostly patrons in a dark, cozy first-person café. Upgrade your shop, manage supplies, and turn a haunted café into a sanctuary amidst nightmares.

games.name: Neon Sunset
games.summary: A brave little sun has found himself in endless neon dungeons! Help him jump across platforms, collect coins, dodge devious enemies, and destroy blocks in search of hidden treasures.

games.name: OddFauna: Secret of the Terrabeast
games.summary: Craft, forage & farm across a whimsical land with new friends in this open world sandbox adventure. What world will you create?

games.name: Ourlands
games.summary: Ourlands is a cozy island builder where you handcraft and play around in bespoke little lands and truly explore your creativity. No goals, no management, just vibes.

games.name: Papa's Mocharia Deluxe
games.summary: Create delicious coffee drinks and cannoli in Papa's Mocharia Deluxe! Create stylish layered lattes in the coffeehouse for Papa Louie's loyal customers while earning tips, points, and Special Recipes. Take a trip in the Food Truck to design and serve your own eye-catching creations!

games.name: Pheonix II
games.summary: A fast-paced shoot 'em up where skill matters. Master over 100 ships, unleash powerful special abilities, and blast through waves of Invaders. Play a new mission every day and climb the world-wide leaderboards.

games.name: Phoenix 2
games.summary: A fast-paced shoot 'em up where skill matters. Master over 100 ships, unleash powerful special abilities, and blast through waves of Invaders. Play a new mission every day and climb the world-wide leaderboards.

games.name: Rapunzel & Thumbelina: The Tiny Adventure
games.summary: A magical journey awaits beyond every winding path.

games.name: Remorses
games.summary: Learn terrifying witchcraft and investigate. Sanity? Open windows, or lose it.

games.name: Required Synergy Workshop: Deja Damnation
games.summary:
Mandatory orientation at a corporate hellscape. The loop never ends. A psychological horror visual novel where your accumulated choices build a hidden profile and the world around you adjusts accordingly.

Public demo available on Steam. Full release is currently in development.

games.name: Rescue the Puppies
games.summary: Rescue the Puppies is a light and charming hidden-object puzzle game where you explore ever-changing rooms, defeat an evil witch, and rescue adorable puppies.

games.name: Run Run Iguana!
games.summary: Make the iguana chase the delicious leaf for as long as possible! As the iguana runs after the leaf, you will encounter obstacles that the iguana must avoid. If the iguana catches the leaf, runs into an obstacle, or if you drop the leaf, the run will end!

games.name: Shadow Monarchs Rise
games.summary: Shadow Monarch’s Rise is a 2D action RPG with fast, skill-based combat, quests, hidden treasures, epic bosses, and character progression. Future updates will include cloud saves and accessibility features.

games.name: Soap Slide
games.summary: Soap Slide is a chaotic and fun party game set in a pastel world where soaps race and slide. Play solo or co-op with friends and dive into slippery chaos across mini-games like golf, football, and more!

games.name: Soul Card Duel
games.summary: A deckbuilder where position and direction make combats more tactical. Flank enemies with 8 attack directions and combine cards to win in any situation. Explore procedural maps, create decks and armor to customize your hero, and forge your legend in the region's grand tournament.

games.name: Space Bross
games.summary: Your chicken has been kidnapped, and that's all it takes to send a retired astronaut into full galactic mayhem. Space Bross is a hand-drawn 2.5D tower defense & action roguelite where you'll build bases, fend off alien hordes, and blast your way across planets to bring your feathery friend back.

games.name: Squishmallows FIFA World Cup Happy Meal
games.summary: A short experience where you try to navigate around moving players and score goals while playing as your favorite Squishmallow. This was part of a McDonald's Happy Meal promotion.

games.name: Sweetie Candy Maze: Coral Peach
games.summary: Dive into a vibrant candy world! Collect delicious sweets and find your way through playful coral peach mazes in this sweet and colorful adventure.

games.name: Texturetown
games.summary: TEXTURETOWN is an algorithmically remixed MMO created from assets of now-defunct mid-2000's children's MMOs. It uses the fabric of games themselves as media to collage.

games.name: The Boomies Show
games.summary: A frantic twin-stick roguelite set in a candy-coated amusement park turned massacre arena. Dual weapons, recoil mastery and modular builds. Survive the waves, push your luck and extract before the show swallows you whole.

games.name: Typer3000
games.summary: Typer3000 is a strategic typing game that combines precise typing with action survival and tower defence. By typing quickly, you control attacks, activate defences and adapt to increasing waves of enemies. There is also a multiplayer and COOP function.

games.name: Ultra0
games.summary: Enjoy a simple, easy-to-play pseudo-3D shooter! Upgrade your character with power-ups and take down the approaching monsters before they reach you.

games.name: Unlucky Mummy
games.summary: Unlucky Mummy is an incremental clicker where your task is to open a sarcophagus with a curse on it. Starting with a 25% chance of success, can you find 12 relics in a row to resurrect the mummy?

games.name: Up Cards
games.summary: UP CARDS is a light roguelike card game. In this exciting journey, you need to control the card situation, play the best combinations, stack additional effects to turn the tide, choose your permanent rewards, and reach new heights through different strategic builds.

games.name: Ward X
games.summary: Ward X is a indie horror puzzle game set inside an abandoned hospital that should have stayed forgotten. Navigate twisted halls and solve puzzles as you search for a way out.

games.name: Wasted Bloodline
games.summary: Wasted Bloodline is a first-person shooter with stunning graphics, singleplayer botmatch mode, online multiplayer, and cooperative play, featuring long-term support.

games.name: WayPoint
games.summary: Turn-based multiplayer strategy for up to 4 players. Carve your path to the finish line or eliminate your opponents using devastating events. There are no good events in this world—only the hope that your opponent's situation is worse. Only cunning and strategy will lead you to victory!

games.name: Where The Road Fades
games.summary:
“Where the Road Fades” is a short psychological indie horror game.
After a sudden accident, you find yourself lost in the woods.
You try to find help in a nearby house.
Inside, nothing feels right.

Explore a creepy house
Choose between different paths and doors
Face what’s haunting you in the darkness
Experience a short but intense horror story (~20 minutes)

Will you find your way out?

games.name: X-Ray 2D
games.summary: A fast-paced and challenging 2D platformer where precision, reflexes, and exploration are essential to overcome traps, obstacles, and secret-filled levels.

games.name: Your Meal, My Lord
games.summary:
Medieval Food-Tasting Sim. You are the royal food taster. Inspect every dish before it reaches the court. Or don't - Lord Snodtooth was going to die of something eventually, and his nephew has much better ideas about trade policy...

Every dish that crosses your bench was made by someone who cared. Glazes gleam. Stuffings steam. Jellies tremble for reasons that are unknown. Unlock new recipes, study the kitchen's growing repertoire, and serve the finest two-star cuisine the era has to offer - three, four and five stars are a few centuries away.

games.name: Arcade Archives 2: Cameltry
games.summary:
"Cameltry" is an action game released by Taito in 1990.
Rotate the maze to roll the ball and reach the goal before the timer hits zero. A variety of obstacles stand in your way, including traps that reduce your time and bumpers that bounce the ball away. It's a unique ball-action game with a whole new sensation.

games.name: Arcade Archives: Cameltry
games.summary:
"Cameltry" is an action game released by Taito in 1990.
Rotate the maze to roll the ball and reach the goal before the timer hits zero. A variety of obstacles stand in your way, including traps that reduce your time and bumpers that bounce the ball away. It's a unique ball-action game with a whole new sensation.

games.name: Astaryn: RPG Idler
games.summary: A World of Warcraft inspired game, with RPG features and an offline progression. Choose a hero and start farming, fight monsters, level up your skills, complete all the quests, run dungeons and get the best gear while joining player Clans and fighting in the PvP Arena!

games.name: Backpack Raiders
games.summary: Backpack Raiders is a hybrid survival roguelite + tactical inventory builder, where how you arrange your gear is just as important as the gear you choose. Survive the City. Build Your Loadout. Outplay the Swarm.

games.name: Bush Dog
games.summary: Fight the timer to herd the sheep on unique maps with each round adding more sheep.

games.name: Cafe Crew Simulator
games.summary: Craft coffee masterpieces, grow your dream café, and sabotage the competition in style! Coffee's hot, competition's hotter!

games.name: Chaos Claw
games.summary: You are the claw. Chaos is the goal. Fulfill increasingly ridiculous cat orders in a physics-fueled claw machine meltdown. Grab, toss, and scramble your way through waves of impatient cats, random items, global leaderboards, and pure, contained chaos. Nuclear Kitty Minis Tiny games. Pure chaos

games.name: Damways
games.summary: In Damways, you control a resourceful beaver that slides endlessly across the water, reshaping the environment with dams and creating unlikely paths toward home.

games.name: Earth Forge
games.summary: COLLECT, UPGRADE, UNLOCK AND NAVIGATE Single player adventure gameplay involves mining for materials, finding and collecting enough minerals in a randomly generated world to unlock upgrades. The upgraded player can then navigate through mines and dungeons avoiding bats to reach treasure chests.

games.name: Echoes of the Museum
games.summary: "Echoes of the Museum" immerses you in a first-person psychological horror set inside a corrupted museum. You are Alicia, a restoration student drawn into a nightmare where collecting souls opens sealed paths, but slowly erodes your sanity and distorts reality.

games.name: Elementalist
games.summary: A puzzle platformer where you collect Elements and use their powers to move around in various ways. Each Element you collect becomes the next one you use, so pay attention to the order!

games.name: F1 25: 2026 Season Pack
games.summary:
Rewrite the grid with the EA Sports F1 25: 2026 Season Pack. New teams, Audi and Cadillac, join the line-up, bringing a refreshed roster of drivers ready to challenge the field. Step into a new era with the groundbreaking 2026 cars and take on the adrenaline-fuelled MADRING in the next generation of Grand Prix racing.
• All New Teams: Two new teams join the 2026 grid: Audi, taking over Sauber, and Cadillac
• New Driver Line-ups: Race against the latest driver line-ups
• New Track: Get ready to race at MADRING, the first new F1 circuit since 2023
• New Cars and Regulations

games.name: Farm RPG
games.summary: Farm RPG is a simple, menu-based, mobile-friendly farming RPG / MMO game where you start a farm, plant crops, fish, craft and explore.

games.name: Final Fantasy VII Rebirth
games.summary: Final Fantasy VII Rebirth is the second entry in the Final Fantasy VII remake project, which retells the story of the genre-redefining RPG across three distinct games. Iconic heroes Cloud, Barret, Tifa, Aerith and Red XIII have escaped from the dystopian city Midgar and are now in pursuit of Sephiroth, the vengeful swordsman from Cloud’s past who was thought to be dead.

games.name: Final Generation
games.summary: In Final Generation, a 2.5D sci-fi horror action roguelike, embark on an ever-changing journey that will reveal the fate of the past and the horrors of the future to those strong enough to survive.

games.name: FuJianStrike
games.summary: Command the deck crew, experience the aircraft carrier deck scheduling process, ensure the smooth take-off and landing of aircraft, and ensure that the aircraft carrier can defeat the endless stream of enemies.

games.name: Galactic Love Utopia
games.summary: You are a writer who gets kidnapped by aliens and are taken to a space station run by a mysterious rich backer who selects a single writer from each known intelligent alien species. You are the only human on a writer's retreat space station filled with different alien species.

games.name: Gombo
games.summary: Explore, build, fight and survive in an enchanting cartoon world! Take control of Gombo, your very own animated character, and adventure through a beautiful, yet unforgiving world full of dangers and surprises.

games.name: Guinea Pig Runaway Together
games.summary: Two guinea pigs. One balloon. Endless chaos. Work together or get nowhere in this physics-based co-op parkour challenge!

games.name: Gunk
games.summary: Gunk is an endless rouge-lite wave survival game. Fight off hordes of enemies and level up your skills to increase your chance of survival, and save the world from the Gunk invasion. Their only weakness is rocks, and you are the last hope for humanity. Can you save us all?

games.name: Hentai Foot Fetish
games.summary: Play puzzles and relax! Collect all the pictures. A great way to spend the evening. Choose your favorite difficulty level and test your attentiveness.

games.name: ImpossibleBosses
games.summary: Team up in online co-op and take on powerful boss raids. Learn attack patterns, survive chaotic battles, and work together to defeat seemingly impossible bosses.

games.name: IncreKnight
games.summary: A short incremental game about a knight slaying a dragon.

games.name: Into the Deep
games.summary:
This game was made by 6 students as a group project assignment for their third year in the bachelor Digital Arts & Entertainment at Hogeschool West-Vlaanderen in Belgium.

The music was composed by Behnaz Tohidi, student at the Royal Conservatoire of Ghent.

Into The Deep - a rhythm roguelike game where you must dive into the ocean and clear it from corruption caused by a meteor.

Dash and fight your way through the rooms full of corrupted creatures and find your way to the Final Boss. On your playthrough you might find various abilities that you can equipt to completely change your playstyle for the run.

games.name: Kacha Fruit Cut
games.summary: Welcome to the cyberpunk night market! Kacha Fruit Cut is a fast-paced, casual fruit-slicing game. Manage your futuristic street stall, slice fresh fruits with precision, complete customer orders, and trigger the neon fever mode to become the ultimate midnight fruit master!

games.name: Leaves Against Unalived
games.summary: Leaves Against Unalived is a 3D game where you need to post shooters in order to stop the zombies from coming.

games.name: Li Shui
games.summary: This is a modern 2D pixel style casual decryption game with very simple game controls. Players can collect props, use them in reasonable situations, and unlock the plot Every time the plot is unlocked, there may be some changes in the game's scenes, and players can explore the plot again

games.name: Matilda
games.summary:
You are 5 years old.
Your parents left.
And your sister made a terrible mistake.

games.name: MonStars: Karaoke Party
games.summary: Sing your heart out with a monstrously fun musical adventure!

games.name: Neuroslop
games.summary: On a rainy night, the protagonist steps into a café that has never been on this street before. Inside are strange visitors, conversations about how stories work, and an evening that lasts longer than it should. A short linear visual novel.

games.name: Once Upon a Dungeon: Infinity
games.summary: Travel through dark dungeons, defeat dangerous creatures, and collect unique loot as you play endlessly in this hardcore, traditional roguelike.

games.name: Pawful Dice
games.summary: The cutest roguelike deckbuilder, where you roll your animal dice to win! Add new dice, level them up, pick up items, greed! Every strategy works as long as you can defeat the Mushroom King...

games.name: Prohibeast
games.summary: Immerse yourself in a 1930s Chicago plagued by corruption and illegal meat trafficking. In this stealth-tactics game, control Eliot Ness and his team. Exploit the environment, deceive your enemies and strike the mafia from the shadows to dismantle Al Capone's criminal empire.

games.name: PuzzleCore
games.summary: A fast-paced physics puzzle platformer where you jump, throw, and interact with objects to solve challenges across floating islands and futuristic labs.

games.name: Raidborn
games.summary:
Enough of wasting precious time by walking eternal distances and engaging in endless dialogue? Want to get to the fun part quickly? Say no more! Raidborn should be right up your alley.

Raidborn is a straightforward first-person fantasy action RPG featuring procedurally generated dungeons and quests. Plunder a treasure-strewn world, upgrade your gear, level up your skills, and hurl yourself into intense combat.

games.name: Scarlet Wolf
games.summary: If you're ready to run and play a deadly game of hide-and-seek, then come on in and make yourself at home. Behind the door, endless oppressive corridors, filthy walls, deadly traps, and a ravenous creature eagerly waiting to get up close and personal with you await.

games.name: Scropia
games.summary: Navigate a dystopian city, uncover secrets, and shape your path in this story-driven sci-fi visual novel.

games.name: Slaughter Void
games.summary: Slaughter Void is a heavy metal dark fantasy slasher where hesitation is death. Chain kills, keep your momentum, shape your build, and slaughter your way into the Void.

games.name: Slip & Skid
games.summary: Race against your friends and alter the track by placing obstacles after each lap. Change the rules mid-game with roguelike modifiers. Shove your opponents off the track, drift, boost and jump. Up to 4 players online and local split-screen.

games.name: Slots & Diapers
games.summary: Absurd incremental game where you turn even liquid assets into financial glory! Spin for jackpots and hire veteran gamblers to automate the madness. Use permanent upgrades and 'mishaps' to accelerate your progress! Simple. Messy. Addictive.

games.name: Snuggle Nightmare
games.summary: Snuggle Nightmare is a first-person mascot horror adventure set in an abandoned theme park. The player must solve puzzles, craft tools, avoid a deadly animatronic, and uncover the secrets hidden within Brain World Rots.

games.name: Springbot: The Last Spark
games.summary: Embark on a journey to save your fellow robots in colorful side-scrolling style!

games.name: Tanki Online
games.summary: Tanki Online is a free-to-play, browser-based multiplayer game in the arcade tank-shooter genre. Players use customized tanks on various different maps to defeat their opponents, either as part of a team or fighting solo. Other game modes include capturing flags and controlling specific points. Based on performance, every battle rewards players in the form of Crystals. Crystals can be spent to upgrade your tank or to buy new equipment. Tanki has many communities around the world, mostly based in Eastern Europe, Russia, and South Asian nations. The game can be easily run on old computers, even without a dedicated GPU, making it appealing to a large demographic.

games.name: Terminal Cursor
games.summary: Terminal Cursor is a fast‑paced reflex arcade game where you dodge evolving bullet patterns and survive as long as possible. Every movement matters. Features intense runs, rising difficulty, high‑score focus, and an original soundtrack by David‑Ștefan Horecica.

games.name: The Greatest Penguin Heist of All Time
games.summary: The Greatest Penguin Heist of All Time is a physics-based heist game where you and your friends gear up to take on some of the most challenging heists conducted by penguins in penguin history.

games.name: Tiny Catcher
games.summary: Tiny Catcher is a fishing game where you can keep it open in a floating window mode, so you can place it wherever you want while doing other things on your PC. The idea is to have something cozy running in the background while you work, study, or just relax.

games.name: Uno God
games.summary: This is not a rogue-like game. Test your luck and bet your life against the gods in a deadly card game. Use powerful relics to outplay immortal opponents — and survive until the last god falls.

games.name: Wasteland Outpost
games.summary: Wasteland Outpost is an explosive online cocktail of tactical shooter, base building, and survival. Scavenge for resources, build an impregnable fortress, and fight off hordes of mutants and the enemy team. Fortify your base or watch it burn in the flames of the apocalypse!

games.name: Word Sweep
games.summary: A Word-Finding Journey from the Deep Sea to Deep Space!

games.name: eFootball Kick-Off!
games.summary: Experience the excitement of every goal – solo or with everyone! Begin your football journey with eFootball Kick-Off!

games.name: 1000 Questions to Be Chosen by the Cat Lord
games.summary:
Are you worthy of being chosen by the cat lord?
1000 questions to prove your love for cats.

games.name: 1997 Reloaded
games.summary: Three teenagers find a mysterious audio tape recording which turns out to be evidence of a murder. It’s the end of the world as they know it. Immerse yourself in a kinetic novel that encapsulates the essence of the 1990s by completely reinventing its music scene.

games.name: A Kobold Story : Trenchcoat Adventurer
games.summary:
Trenchcoat Adventurer is a dungeon-crawling roleplaying game with a whimsical heart and a beautiful, hand-drawn CrayonVision aesthetic.

Three Kobolds find themselves drawn to the allure of Adventuring after overhearing how successful adventurers get to eat the best food and have the shiniest shiny things. Cunningly disguised in a trenchcoat, this towered trio find their way though an ever-deepening dungeon in the hunt for shinies and tasties!

Unbeknownst to them, the "beginner dungeon" that they wandered into breaks through into a much deeper, darker place full of real peril... with the training wheels off and the worst equipment they could find, can our Trenchcoated heroes go from wannabes to true heroic adventurers?

games.name: A-Train 9 Evolution
games.summary:
The evolved scenery depicts a new city.

The railroad connects cities and transports people. In connected cities, people gather, and the cities grow even larger… In A-Train 9, you can realistically experience the joy of urban development.

A-Train 9 Evolution is not a mere port of A-Train 9—the user interface and graphics have been completely revamped. Furthermore, the addition of new buildings, including greenery-covered buildings, allows for modern urban vistas.

games.name: Ahapika: Heroic Agency
games.summary: Gather brave heroes and open the most heroic agency in Ancient Greece! Help people, argue with the gods, but remember: a mistake can be fatal.

games.name: Alruna: End of History
games.summary: Alruna; now in wide-screen! A different kind of Metroidvania, a tour-de-force of game design, with world-class temples and dungeons. Dead men yearn for Heaven, but Elysium remains out of their grasp.

games.name: An Automaton's Journey
games.summary: Play as the ancient automaton Cecilia Immergreen as you explore the world for secrets, solve puzzles, delve into dungeons, fight other Hololive members as powerful bosses, help other members with side quests, and find powerful items to explore previously unavailable locations.

games.name: Animal Puzzles
games.summary: Play and learn who lives in farmlands, forests and seas!

games.name: Arcade Pack
games.summary: Jump into classic arcade-style action with the Arcade Pack, a collection of three exciting games inspired by retro machines and fast-paced gameplay.

games.name: Astra Quest
games.summary: Astra Quest is a retro-futuristic bullet hell shooter. Design modular starships with unique cores, bases, and devices. Survive intense battles, earn Evolution Points, and unlock upgrades in Adventure and Evolution modes to dominate the neon-lit cosmos.

games.name: Backrooms: No Escape
games.summary: A 1–6 player immersive psychological horror experience. Venture through multiple handcrafted liminal Backrooms levels, solve puzzles, explore and survive.

games.name: Battle Strike
games.summary: The pinnacle of current-generation graphics, a game changer in modern warfare

games.name: Below
games.summary: Survive heart-pounding chases in this first-person found footage psychological horror. With the help of a camcorder, explore dark tombs and tight halls under the great pyramid. Find its terrible secrets, manage your batteries and, if you can, SURVIVE.

games.name: Brain Training! Order Quiz
games.summary: 365, V = IR, A K Q J… What's the word? Read the clue. Rearrange the letters!

games.name: Chicken Coop Invaders
games.summary: Save the chickens! Help Lucas defend the chickens against a ruthless alien attack in this frantic FPS game with Tower Defense elements! Battle through dozens of levels, make allies, buy and upgrade items!

games.name: Clockfall
games.summary: Master the clock, break the loop. Time is limited and is the ultimate resource in this hybrid Dungeon Crawler packed with phases of village defense. Each run is a fight to earn more time, or unlock new weapons and skills to build your escape.

games.name: Comatose
games.summary: After going through a traumatic experience, Laura finds herself trapped within a looping nightmare inside her comatose brain. Fight monsters as you process your trauma and look for the door that will lead you back into the real world.

games.name: Console Archives: Firework Thrower Kantaro's 53 Stations of the Tokaido
games.summary: Wait for me, Momoko-chan

games.name: Crayon Magic World
games.summary: Mystical friends met in dreams awaken in vibrant colors at my fingertips!

games.name: Crazy Chain: Elpis no Kusari
games.summary:
To quit being a saint, she falls in love.
"No. I’ll accomplish both love and the salvation of the nation."

Long ago, a war begun by two European nations.
A conflict waged through ever-advancing mysticism and technology continues even now—nearly a thousand years have passed.

games.name: Crystalase
games.summary: Turn crystals into masterpieces.

games.name: Dark Trip
games.summary:
Dark Trip is a psychedelic VR escape room where the hero is forced to use drugs investigating a sadomasochistic lab.

The game of Escape Room genre features Lavcraftian setting, Psychedelic Trips gameplay mechanics and the goals to collect and investigate evidences. Some event in the game are inspired by David Lynch's and Terry Gilliam's movies.

- Experiences Psychedelic Trips. Use VR to immerse yourself into psychedelic experiences not possible on any other gaming platform.

- Investigate the Sadomasochistic Laboratory. Solve twisted riddles in surrealistic setting of physical and mental torture.

- Collect the Pieces of Horrible Truth. Search for clues, artifacts and diary pieces in each location to discover the dark story behind the events.

games.name: Deep Sea Fish: Hidden World
games.summary: A short incremental fishing game where you catch fish, earn gold, and unlock powerful upgrades to explore the deep sea.

games.name: Drift
games.summary: A calm, dreamlike exploration experience set in a procedurally generated world where shifting landscapes and quiet structures emerge from the haze.

games.name: Eggconsole Marchen Veil II PC-9801
games.summary: The saga of the Lake Prince reaches its grand finale. A masterpiece Action RPG that masterfully fuses immersive visuals with pulse-pounding action!

games.name: Eterspire
games.summary: Eterspire is a true free-to-play, cross-platform MMORPG where your skill and dedication define your progression! Play on PC and Mobile with crossplay, join a friendly and active community, discover new content updates every two weeks, and explore a massive world full of charming characters.

games.name: Factory
games.summary: A short visual novel about an endless shift at a garment factory. Wonder what gets you liquidated faster: corruption, naivety, or immorality? Industrial melancholy, where nothing goes unpunished.

games.name: Far Mining
games.summary: Far Mining is a short and relaxing incremental game about mining asteroids. Mine resources, upgrade your ship, unlock new tools, and find your way out of deep space.

games.name: Fire Pit: Throw Things Into the Fire
games.summary: The world doesn't deserve to exist. Nothing matters anyway. Destroy and burn things alone. Or get your nihilistic friends and throw things into the fire together.

games.name: Fish & Hike
games.summary: Play as the dog, Doctor Shiberson. Catch fish, explore wild trails, and fight friendly monsters. Help the locals, gather treasures, and uncover the secrets of the Eight Lakes Valley. Can you catch the 4 legendary golden fish?

games.name: Fish In
games.summary: Cast your line across stunning worlds. Catch rare fish, upgrade your gear, and build the ultimate collection. Your fishing adventure awaits!

games.name: Gachamon
games.summary: Gachamon is a cozy idle clicker where gacha meets multitasking. Collect creatures, earn coins, and climb the ranks — all from the bottom of your screen!

games.name: Gate Guardian
games.summary: Gate Guardian is a casual fantasy roguelike with rich build options. You are the guardian of the Gate of Life, who protects it from Death. Create combinations of skills, improve and radically change them with modifiers. Survive Death!

games.name: Goals
games.summary: GOALS is a fast, responsive football game built for pure skill, real competition, and a global community. Gameplay first, free to play, crossplay and unique players. No excuses - just football.

games.name: Golem Lights
games.summary: Light the Path, Awaken the Golems

games.name: Halfway House
games.summary:
You're a nineteen year old dude who just spent four years in juvenile detention. Today's the day of your release. But you're still under a six month probation period, so you can't do whatever the heck you want just yet.

You get assigned to a halfway house way out in the boonies to learn a thing or two about being an adult. After all your were just fifteen years old when they put you away. And in juvie, they don't exactly teach you anything about dealing with the outside world.

So you're thinking to yourself you're shit outta luck being shoved from one crap hole to another. Outside, your friendly neighborhood probation officer is waiting to drive you to your new home. Is the new place gonna be as bad as you think?

Well, you have to play the game to find out. Or you could just read the rest of this post to get some idea of what to expect.

games.name: Harmolinks
games.summary: Harmolinks is a slide puzzle for learning chord types. Players slide tiles marked with notes and pair them up to build chords. Its main goal is to collect a cast of 60 creatures called Harmofriends: at the end of each round, the game awards one based on how you played — the chords you made, the combos you chained, and the mode you chose.

games.name: Hentai Police Girl
games.summary: Hentai Police Girl is a seductive puzzle game where you complete levels to unlock revealing illustrations of a confident police officer.

games.name: Hidden Legends 2
games.summary: Find the invisible, discover the impossible!

games.name: Hidden Oddities in Everyday Life Mystery
games.summary:
Wait — something's off here, isn't it?
Spot the oddity hidden in everyday life.

games.name: Hollowbody
games.summary:
A tech-noir survival horror short story, set in the urban decay of a long abandoned British city.

It's a Shipper's biggest fear. You're grounded in the exclusion zone, twenty miles of death and decay sealed off by the towering, suffocating walls erected after the collapse.

Play as Mica, an unlicensed black market shipper who will stop at nothing to find her missing partner.

Alone, stranded, and with limited resources at your disposal you'll have to push your way through the zone, solve environmental puzzles, manage resources and fight for your life as you try to find a way to escape beyond the wall.

games.name: House Flipper Remastered Collection
games.summary: House Flipper Remastered Collection lets you become a one-person renovation crew. Clean, build, decorate, and sell for profit! Now with better graphics, voice acting, all expansions in one toolbox, and some more heartfelt addition. It’s flipping time!

games.name: Hunt Asylum Together
games.summary: Hunt Asylum Together is a 1-4 player co-op horror action game. Use your radar to find hidden cursed books inside an abandoned asylum, fight terrifying enemies with weapons and melee attacks, and work together to break the curse. But be careful — the past is still alive inside these walls.

games.name: Illusion Connect: Re
games.summary: Illusion Connect: Re is a stylish anime strategy RPG.

games.name: Isekai Villain
games.summary:
An ordinary young man is reborn into the world of his favorite comic—only to find himself as a bit-part villain doomed to die. To escape his fate, he must rise as a true villain, gathering allies, defying heroes, and carving a new destiny in this dark fantasy isekai JRPG. Experience a story of survival, betrayal, and ambition where good and evil clash in a pixel-art world.

Fight strategic turn-based battles that blend classic RPG command systems with modern mechanics. Exploit enemy weaknesses, trigger chain attacks, and unleash powerful break attacks. Earn notoriety through misdeeds to rank up and unlock unique arts via a skill tree. Explore dungeons, gather resources, and develop your own evil base with a smithery, lab, smuggling, and more. Packed with pixel-art charm, immersive story, and tactical depth, this parallel world RPG is a must for fans of JRPGs, anime-style games, and fantasy adventures.

games.name: Just One More Link
games.summary: A dark arcade incremental roguelite. Invest ZEK to buy time, chain crystals for exponential value, and cash out before collapse. Welcome to Blagine Corp. No refunds.

games.name: Kat-tastic Hidden Object
games.summary: Join Whiskerburg’s next big detective adventure!

games.name: Keeper's Vigil
games.summary: As the Harbinger, you are the only Keeper who can cast spells. Stop a necromantic plague, uncover an Elven conspiracy, and decide the fate of a dying world! A text-based fantasy novel, 193,000 words and hundreds of choices, without graphics or sound effects."

games.name: Komayama Kiri ha Zenbu Yari ni Iku
games.summary: Popular streamer Komayama Kiri stars in a chaotic streaming survival action game! Fall through deadly obstacles, survive endless enemies, go viral across the galaxy, and overcome mysterious cosmic trials with the fox-eared V-streamer Kiri in this wild minigame collection!

games.name: Korean Drone Flying Tour Anmyeon-eup
games.summary: This game is a drone simulation game that allows you to experience real drone flight based on footage shot by a real flying drone. There is no up, down, left or right direction control, only the control to increase or decrease the drone speed.

games.name: Lord of the Click 4
games.summary: In "Lord of the Click 4" you will find incredible new challenges, amazing graphics and improved mechanics. As a great monarch, you will fight many new and dangerous enemies using your clicker skills. Every click on your screen summons powerful warriors, deals crushing blows to enemies and directs the magic of nature into battle. But be careful — each level will bring even more powerful and treacherous bosses, who will have to be defeated to advance further.

games.name: Lord of the Click 5
games.summary: Open a new chapter of epic battles! In "Lord of the Click 5" you will find a strategic deployment of troops, army upgrades and battles with powerful bosses. Evolve, use magic, and protect your kingdom from impending threats!

games.name: Medic: Pacific War
games.summary: Become a medic - the true hero of war. Survive the horrors of the battlefield, dodge the bullets, and bring salvation to the wounded. Be their last hope in the chaotic reality of the Pacific Front. Patch, revive, and carry them to change the course of the battle! Be ready to make hard choices!

games.name: Minkle's Masks of Mayhem
games.summary: A cosy 2.5D micro management game, situated in a magical fantasy universe. Play as Minkle, and help him arrive safely at his destination by keeping his troublesome masks at bay.

games.name: Mori Carta
games.summary: Mori Carta is a handless deckbuilding roguelike. Choose left or right on every card to adventure through stories. Simple decisions lead to rich and rewarding gameplay. 3 dramatically different characters with their own unique card sets. 1000+ playable cards. 185 unique enemies.

games.name: Mosaic Quiz Fastest Finger Battle
games.summary:
What's hiding behind the mosaic?
The moment you see it is the moment you win.

games.name: Oh No, Not Another L
games.summary: A classic puzzle game in a recognizable genre. No skills, progression, or plot. Just you, falling pieces, and the desire to beat your own high score.

games.name: Outblast
games.summary: Outblast is a fast and frantic arcade shooter for flatscreen and VR. You are piloting interceptor C11-28. Your objective: destroy infected constructs, collect data particles, and purge the system before total collapse.

games.name: Planetfall Conquerors
games.summary: Customize your spaceship and set off on a fast-paced galactic adventure. Race through unique planets, blast enemies, dodge dangerous mines, and outmaneuver rivals.

games.name: Police Simulator: Patrol Officers
games.summary: Welcome to Brighton! Join the police force of this fictitious American city and experience the day to day life of a Police Officer. Start with citing violations and giving out parking tickets, then work your way towards shouldering more responsibilities. Be part of the community of Brighton, get to know your neighborhood and handle daily police work to fight crime during your shift. Always be tough, but fair: respect the law and gain more experience to unlock more neighborhoods, districts and duties.

games.name: Police Simulator: Patrol Officers - Highway Patrol Expansion
games.summary: Discover the Police Simulator: Patrol Officers expansion and extend your patrol area! Engage in intense highway chases and use fast-paced pit maneuvers to tactically stop fleeing suspects who are in violation of the law, and enjoy a more dynamic police simulation experience.

games.name: Project Microchip
games.summary: A social deduction survival game set in a radiation-filled, abandoned forest. Survivors must complete tasks to stay alive, while the Infected hunt them down.

games.name: Pronoun Palace
games.summary: Pronoun Palace is a word-spelling roguelike set in a dystopian future where the government has taken your pronouns. Use spells to manipulate letter tiles, catch fish, and abuse amphetamines to defeat the Party and get your pronouns back!

games.name: RPG: Fire Keeper
