games.summary: Fire keeper, guard the spark, reap the fire. Read books, seek stories and truths. Communicate with people, offer help and healing. Make choices, face the dying gasp or sin.

games.name: Ragnarok Origin: Classic
games.summary: "Ragnarok Origin: Classic" is an MMORPG game published by Gravity Game Vision. Serving as the "green nostalgic version" of "Ragnarok Origin", it primarily features a fair monetization model and a simplified progression system.

games.name: Realmlords
games.summary: Realmlords is a fast‑paced Bullet‑hell / Spell-hell roguelite with 12 distinct classes, each offering unique weapons, abilities, and build paths. Explore 9 dangerous Randomly Generated Elemental Realms filled with unique monsters, hazards, and loot as you fight to survive each run.

games.name: River City Saga: Journey to the West
games.summary: River City Saga: Journey to the West is a roguelike action brawler that reimagines the classic Chinese novel with River City characters, casting Kunio as Sun Wukong and other familiar faces as legendary figures. In the turbulent Tang Dynasty, you embark on a pilgrimage to retrieve Buddhist scriptures, fighting through waves of demons and bosses with intuitive, satisfying combat. Every run features different layouts, enemies, and skills, encouraging repeated playthroughs as you grow stronger with each attempt.

games.name: Rolling Wheels
games.summary: You are a wheel. A truly deadly wheel. No one will be safe in your path.

games.name: Shepherd Knight
games.summary: Shepherd Knight is an adventure game where you must guide your flock of sheep, with your faithful dog by your side, through a world infested with dragons, wolves, and other dangers.

games.name: Sitting Ducks
games.summary: A chaotic co-op armageddon game where you build ridiculous structures to survive world-ending disasters with sticky hands, physics chaos & friends who probably won’t save you. Don´t be a Sitting Duck!

games.name: Snacktorio
games.summary: Snacktorio is a factory-cooking simulator where you must satisfy the appetites of unspeakable horrors... with food! Build and manage sprawling networks of machines & pipes to mass produce delicious meals that can satiate the endless hunger of the beasts that are invading your home. Order Up!

games.name: Sonki's Lagoon
games.summary: Dive into Sonki's Lagoon, a colorful low-poly high speed 3D platformer, inspired by the classic. Explore a fun world, pull off stylish moves and find all the Johnnies in this indie adventure!

games.name: Sora: Songs of the Stone
games.summary: Stay united with your wandering parrot flock.

games.name: Sports Card Shop Simulator
games.summary: Rip open packs and flip cards for profit while building the sports card shop of your dreams. Hunt for holos, parallels,autos, and numbered cards to satisfy your collection obsession. Design your own card and experience the ultimate high as you pull yourself out of a pack!

games.name: Stickcross Classic
games.summary: To play, move the sticks. Where three sticks cross, stones will fall. To win, clear the bowl.

games.name: Swan Song
games.summary: Swan Song is a cozy and emotional puzzle game where music guides your journey. Use notes of different shapes and sizes to program a music box and solve each puzzle. Help the swan reach the exit as you uncover a touching story of family, loss and grief.

games.name: TD Master
games.summary: Build, upgrade, and defend in this tactical tower defense experience. Place traps, manage resources, and survive increasingly intense waves of enemies in a system-driven, replayable strategy game.

games.name: Tamer: King of Dinosaurs
games.summary: A survival/action/dating sim with an interactive world based on the best selling harem novel series by Michael-Scott Earle. Fight, hunt, and tame dinosaurs, craft weapons and tools, build a fort to protect the alien women you love, and experience a romance story like no other.

games.name: Tetris: The Grand Master 4 - Absolute Eye
games.summary:
The action puzzle game Tetris the Grand Master first appeared in game arcades in August 1998, and became a beloved game for gamers as a Tetris game packed with addictive elements.

Then, Tetris the Absolute: The Grand Master 2 was released in 2000, and Tetris the Grand Master 3: Terror Instinct was released in 2005. The latest in the series, Tetris the Grand Master 4: Absolute Eye, ​​will be available on Steam for the first time in 20 years.

This time, Tetris the Grand Master 4: Absolute Eye offers players a deeper, more strategic Tetris experience, and the depth of the game will satisfy even experienced players. New modes have been added, and this game will test your skills to the limit, requiring precise strategy and fast play.

Of course, there are also modes that even beginners to Tetris can enjoy, and the game is so full of charm that you will find yourself retrying it over and over again.

The sound is handled by Shinji Hosoe, who is well known for the Tetris the Grand Master series. His music, full of tension and excitement, will increase the player’s concentration and make the game even more exciting.

games.name: The 7th Guest
games.summary:
Henry Stauf's mansion has been abandoned for as long as anyone dare remember. Stauf was a master toy maker, a maker of amazing puzzles and this strange, eerie, mansion was his greatest creation.
It stands empty, rotting ever since children started dying with his toys near them, ever since six guests came and were never seen again.

Now, you are in the house, moving from one room to another, trying to remember and trying to forget. Because Stauf's game isn't over. There were six guests the world knew about - and there was one other.
The mansion of horror comes to life again and only you can end this mad nightmare and learn the secret of the 7th guest.

games.name: The 7th Guest Remake
games.summary: The iconic game The 7th Guest has been brought back to life with modern technology, delivering an atmospheric story like no other. Explore a foreboding mansion, solve mind-bending puzzles, and uncover its dark secrets. The 7th Guest is the ultimate mystery adventure, reimagined for modern platforms.

games.name: The Brewline
games.summary: The Brewline is an open world bootlegging simulation. Players build their own alcohol empire through production, trade, and NPC interactions while competing against rival gangs. Manage your resources and navigate a dangerous landscape to expand your illegal operations.

games.name: The Cycling Games
games.summary: Les Jeux du Cycle turns your Bluetooth FTMS trainer into a cycling party game: sprint, dodge, team up, add bots, and outplay friends across 25+ minigames.

games.name: The Vanishing Train
games.summary: The Vanishing Train is a psychological horror game where you work as a train driver on a rural Japanese railway line.

games.name: There's Nothing Down There
games.summary: There's Nothing Down There is a short undersea horror exploration game. Descend into a sinkhole at the bottom of the ocean and discover the remains of a lost, yet not dead, civilization.

games.name: Tickets, Please!
games.summary: Become a train conductor and run your own train in a relaxing cozy simulation! Check tickets, keep everything clean, repair faults, and upgrade your train. Experience humorous chaos on the rails in a laid-back yet hectic single-player adventure.

games.name: Tour de France 2026
games.summary: Take on the best international cyclists with one goal in mind: winning the 2026 Tour de France. Conquer legendary mountain passes, launch your sprints at the perfect moment and emerge triumphant on the Champs-Élysées wearing the Yellow Jersey.

games.name: Unforgettable Love
games.summary: You survived a drowning accident but lost all your memories. As “Pe Luem,” you must slowly piece together your past. Along the way, you will meet five women with their own dreams and secrets. Build relationships and uncover the truth, Who is the one that still remains in your memory?

games.name: What Happened At Sugar Hill?
games.summary: A First Person Horror Walking Simulator set in a fictional town called Sugar Hill. Play as various characters trying to unravel the mystery of What Happened At Sugar Hill.

games.name: World War: D-Day 1944
games.summary: Waves crash on the shore. Paratroopers tear through the night. Operation Overlord, the legendary struggle reborn on a new battlefield.

games.name: You Know The Drill
games.summary: You Know The Drill is a relaxing incremental mining game about digging underground to harvest ores. Collect resources, sell them, and upgrade your drill to go even deeper!

games.name: YumeNoka
games.summary: A short, surrealist game in which you play as a farmer.

games.name: A Week in Paradise
games.summary: A Week in Paradise is an interactive narrative mystery. Discover the unusual circumstances of your arrival to a bar called Paradise, and drink through the night with the bar's charismatic regular. Each night, unravel the threads holding back memories in your dreams.

games.name: Abyss Born
games.summary: Abyss Born is a single-player dark action RPG with survival and dungeon crawler elements. Fight various monsters, explore dangerous dungeons, trade with allies and complete quests to find a friend and face evil.

games.name: Airport Security Sucks!
games.summary: Embody your inner power-tripping TSA agent and hunt down other players attempting to blend in and smuggle contraband past you. Control the crowd and your problematic K9 with authoritative voice commands, and use "compliance devices" to apprehend smugglers making mischief or hiding in plain sight.

games.name: Alien Life
games.summary: You just crash landed on a small mining planet, and your ship is broken! Don't worry though, you will make friends to help you recover the ship parts. Advance through different worlds and talk to wacky characters in this stupid RPG.

games.name: Angry Capybara
games.summary: The world's chillest animal just exploded!

games.name: Astral Lords
games.summary: Master the core "Combat × Base-Building" loop. Survive intense horde-clearing chaos with agile gunplay, then think like a strategist—build your economy and army in real-time. With diverse Commanders and endless builds, your choices shape each run.

games.name: Backrooms: Blackhole
games.summary: Backrooms: Blackhole is a cooperative psychological horror game for 1-4 players. Somewhere deep within the endless halls, reality begins collapsing into a growing void that consumes light, sound, and everything around it. The deeper you descend, the less the world makes sense — and the harder...

games.name: Ball & Gun
games.summary: Ball & Gun is a genre-bending, Sports-FPS game where you master your jump shot and an evolving arsenal of divine weaponry to hold back the undead. This isn't just about survival; its about becoming a Basketball God in the Ballpocalypse. A ball. A gun. Zombies. This is the new definitive shooter.

games.name: Blendkins
games.summary: Explore the jungle in search of Blendkins, masters of camouflage! Everyone wants these adorable pets, but beware: keeping them may bring unexpected consequences. Discover their secrets in this unique adventure!

games.name: Classic: Snake
games.summary: A tribute to the timeless snake game. Use arrow keys to guide the snake, eat food to grow longer, and avoid crashing into walls or yourself. Unlock achievements, compete on global leaderboards. Simple to pick up, impossible to put down.

games.name: Cloud Golf
games.summary: Putt Above the Clouds

games.name: D.U.M.B.E.R. Ducks
games.summary: The D.U.M.B. ducks are back for an Emergency Rescue!

games.name: Death Attraction
games.summary: Are you afraid of clowns?

games.name: Death Standing
games.summary:
Death Standing is the first of its kind 'Stand' type of game, where the player has to do nothing but hold still for a set amount of time. It's a meditative endurance challenge game where you have to hold the left mouse button without moving the mouse itself.

Who's going to give up first? Will Kojira-san drop the baby? Or will Death wrap it up for the day and go home?

games.name: Deep Crafter
games.summary: As a specially trained explorer in "Deep Crafter", you'll gather resources, design production lines, automate everything, and explore this vast, ocean-covered planet to uncover its secrets.

games.name: Dire Echo
games.summary:
In the near future, humanity is steadily expanding into the depths of space. You are an astronaut on a routine but important mission: follow a designated route to a remote station and deliver technical data.

Along the way, command contacts you with an additional request — retrieve documents from the research vessel "Echo-7", which recently went silent. The silence is attributed to a recent geomagnetic storm disrupting communications.

As you approach Echo-7, you attempt to contact the crew — but there’s no response. The ship appears functional from the outside. Inside — nothing.

No welcoming party, no signs of life. Just empty corridors, scattered personal belongings, and the unsettling feeling that you're not alone.

Key Features

Realistic graphics — visual fidelity enhances the feeling of unease

️ Haunting atmosphere — silence, isolation, and growing tension follow your every step

Immersive sound — rich audio design pulls you deep into the experience

games.name: Drawn Together
games.summary: Doodle, communicate, and play your own drawing games with friends using your own desktop digital whiteboards!

games.name: Dustin Sunset
games.summary: A post-apocalyptic world, a bastion of hope, the wasteland gangs united to destroy it, and only one man crazy enough to try to save it. Dustin Sunset is a vertical shoot 'em up with a touch of bullet hell and a whole lot of love, made by fans of the genre for fans of the genre.

games.name: Finis Actus
games.summary: Unveil the doors of a mansion haunted by a tragic past in the gloomy shadows of 1891 London. Finis Actus is a Victorian-era psychological thriller focused on environmental storytelling and deep atmosphere. Do you have the courage to find the truth before the final curtain falls?

games.name: Follow Us
games.summary: A co-op horror game for 2 players, where you risk your life outside to entertain a world that never leaves home. On Follow Us, contestants work in pairs: one explores, the other guides. Trust is your lifeline.

games.name: Fruits Slot Machine
games.summary: Spin the reels and win multiple payouts and a legendary jackpot.

games.name: Goalkeeper Journey
games.summary: Step into the gloves of a rising goalkeeper, starting your journey at local clubs and working your way to the world's biggest football stages.

games.name: GoatBrains
games.summary: Goatbrains is a casual trivia game combining quiz challenges, short educational segments, an energetic endless runner, and a pressure-free meditation mode, offering multiple ways to learn, play, and unwind.

games.name: Gothic 1 Remake
games.summary: Gothic 1 Remake is an action role-playing game set in a third-person perspective within a fantasy open world. It is a remake of the 2001 game Gothic, developed by Alkimia Interactive using Unreal Engine 5. The player controls a nameless prisoner sent into the Valley of Mines, a penal colony surrounded by a magical barrier. The game features NPC routines, faction-based quest paths, and a progression system where the player starts with no skills and must learn them from trainers. Navigation is done without a minimap, and the game world is 10 to 30 percent larger than the original, with expanded chapters and additional quest content. Combat and skill systems are based on the original game's design.

games.name: Horny Massage Clinic
games.summary: The hard life of a worker changes when he decides to do something as trivial as going to a massage clinic. There he discovers that he can do more than just relieve his back pain. Thanks to his four hot masseuses, he will rise from the ashes.

games.name: I Am Cat
games.summary: "I Am Cat" is a VR sandbox adventure game where players step into the role of a cat living in Granny's house. Explore the house, interact with its environments, and complete cat-themed quests. The game offers free-form exploration, physics-based interactions, and mini-games, allowing players to solve puzzles, play games, and create mischief. Whether sneaking around, uncovering secrets, or causing chaos, the choice is yours.

games.name: Ice Cream Simulator
games.summary: Run your dream ice cream shop in Ice Cream Simulator! Create delicious ice cream using a variety of ingredients, manage your business, hire staff, decorate your store, handle changing weather and different customers, and enjoy a relaxing first-person simulation experience.

games.name: John broke his bones
games.summary: Ragdoll physics platformer where you control a scientist to going through different labs with gadgets and hazards to get the medkit

games.name: Kinetype
games.summary: Kinetype is a minimalist, terminal, ASCII, roguelite where your keyboard is the interface for survival. Navigate procedural terminal grids by typing commands to move and survive. Extract to bank Bytes for permanent upgrades, or lose your streak to the system. The terminal is yours to command.

games.name: Kromex
games.summary: Conquer. Control. Dominate. A fast-paced, competitive territory game where every tile you claim brings you closer to victory, and every second of inattention can turn the tide completely.

games.name: Lord of Anatolia
games.summary: A real-time city-building and strategy game set in 1300s Anatolia. Build your settlement, manage resources, expand your economy, train soldiers, research new technologies, and defend your beylik against enemy forces.

games.name: Lots of Bugs
games.summary: Lots of Bugs is currently in early playtest! Dive shell first into a cozy but slightly chaotic beetle world where pickles are legendary, shells are painted, and dung is absolutely involved. Play solo, or better yet, bring some friends!

games.name: Masters of the Universe: Legends Unite
games.summary:
Unleash the power of Grayskull in Masters of the Universe: Legends Unite where both heroes and villains come together in this cooperative deck builder. With sworn enemies forced into alliances, up to 4 friends will unite legends including the mighty He-Man, the mystic Teela, the devious Skeletor, the fierce Evil-Lyn, and the ever-resourceful Man-At-Arms for over-the-top, chaotic card play.

Unique playstyles bring each legend to life in the fight against Hordak’s unstoppable horde. Throughout Adventure Mode you’ll work together to deliver even bigger hits, gather increasingly powerful cards, and further strengthen your characters. Battle your way through a variety of diverse biomes and obstacles with every playthrough; but the enemy is not the only challenge you’ll face.

Along your journey engage in Trials of Eternia, arcade mini games where friendly competition amongst legends for precious bonuses. Snatch treasure from the faceless one, dodge crushing boulders, and avoid falling into the depths of darkness to claim heroic advantages.

Time to build your strategy to defend Castle Grayskull from the evil forces of Hordak!

games.name: Mega Man W
games.summary: Explore eight New Levels with an array of new Robot Masters! Augment Mega Man, and even Robot Master weapons, with different properties to suit your gameplay style! Collect CDS, earn Trophies, and fill out an Bestiary of enemies made by our development crew! Enjoy amazing original Compositions by MinobiVW, Marley Juaz, 40Nix, BastyArts. A Challenge Mode awaits with over 80+ challenges, and an all new endless mode where you can mix and match utilities from Mega Man's past adventures!

games.name: Mewlin the Clicker
games.summary: Click to roll the crystal ball across the table, dodging obstacles and facing bosses while building a deck of cards that completely changes your strategy with every run. Help Mewlin, a very curious orange cat, make a total mess in this magical clicker with deckbuilding elements.

games.name: Nexus Legacy
games.summary: Rebuild civilization from a single planet in Nexus Legacy, a persistent sci-fi 4X MMO. Colonize worlds, manage resources, research technologies, command fleets, forge alliances, and fight for control of a living galaxy.

games.name: Project Absentia
games.summary: Project Absentia is a retro FPS inspired by 2000s-2010s flash animations and sprite comics, with vertical, aerial, elemental combat as the main focus. Play as an angel known as Abby in this retro shooter focused on interactivity, verticality and cool weapons.

games.name: Putrika 2nd.Cut: For the Exquisite Attire
games.summary: Is cutting down a young girl a sin, or a salvation? In the Haku-a Church where pure love and jealousy collide, a young gem-craftsman is forced to choose—to let her live, or to end her life.

games.name: Roguegg: Hardboiled Survivors
games.summary: Roguegg: Hardboiled Survivors is a top-down roguelike bullet heaven where you play as a brave egg fighting hordes of bugs. Collect upgrades, manage your grid inventory, and craft unique builds to survive the swarm before they scramble you!

games.name: Rugby League 26
games.summary:
Step onto the pitch in the most authentic Rugby League experience ever!

Whether you're chasing club glory, building a custom ‘Pro Team’, or rising through the ranks with a self-made superstar, Rugby League 26 puts YOU at the heart of the action.

games.name: Seals From the Frosty Bay
games.summary: Help the seal overcome the obstacles!

games.name: Shattered Chess
games.summary:
You only have 10 moves. Every capture counts for scoring.
Build huge combo chains, multiply your score, and push your run as far as possible.
Upgrade powerful passives, discover broken synergies, and survive bosses that completely twist the rules of the game.

games.name: Sinner Maker
games.summary: Sinner Maker allows you to create up to 100 characters and simulate a society built around them. Construct homes, manage their needs, and watch as they fall in love, form friendships, and even become enemies. Manage resources and solve emerging problems if you want your soul to be saved.

games.name: Solaris
games.summary: "Solaris" is a story about a journey in search of yourself. The hero fulfills the last will of a loved one, meeting many strange characters. The road is full of humor, but the further you go, the stronger the feeling becomes: beneath the cozy surface, something terrible is awakening.

games.name: Spire Blast
games.summary:
Take a step into the colorful world of Spire Blast. With your ever hungry dragon companion collapse numerous mysterious towers of all shapes and sizes that have risen all over the kingdom.

Test your wits and skills, use all the tools at your disposal and you will emerge victorious!

games.name: Steamboat Incident
games.summary: Trapped at sea on a steamboat - fix it, hide, and escape

games.name: Stoned to Death
games.summary: While trapped in a stunning forested wilderness, engage in brutal hand-to-hand combat with a notorious durg cartel producing dangerous illegal drugs to uncover the mysteries of their crimes.

games.name: Sudoku Bactron
games.summary: Sudoku Bactron is a logical number-filling game developed by Bactron. The game offers a random mode and an adventure mode. Players can also design their own levels, constantly verifying the unique solution, ensuring that each puzzle has only one answer.

games.name: Supermarket & Clothing Store Simulator
games.summary:
Build your business.
Grow your stores.
Become a retail legend.

games.name: Tactorius
games.summary: Tactorius is a spell-based chess roguelite. Over 100 unique spells and 9 new pieces change the game in ways subtle and explosive. Enter the Gauntlet, build your skill tree, and make every match your own.

games.name: The Fallen Kingdom
games.summary: The kingdom is at war and you are the wizard who can save it! Get ready for a 2D isometric journey with spells, combat, bosses, an incredible soundtrack that accompanies the simple, yet epic story!

games.name: The Modern Atlas
games.summary: This is an in-progress visual novel from the perspective of Ernest Frankenstein, Victor's younger brother, taking place after the events of Mary Shelley's novel.

games.name: Time to Love
games.summary: Time to Love is a 2D, top-down, co-op roguelike centered around two protagonists trying to keep reality from collapsing. You will traverse from timeline to timeline, strengthening yourself from each unique branch, seeking to bind what little remains after past mistakes.

games.name: Tiny Town Market Simulator
games.summary: Build and manage your own small-town market. Stock shelves, serve customers, grow crops, craft products, and expand your business from a tiny shop into a thriving local store.

games.name: Tribots
games.summary: Robotic warrior of a mysterious army, you are now stranded on a world unknown. Alone or with other survivors of your battalion, lead a ruthless guerilla and take part in the reconquest of an entire planet. A cooperative experience for up to 5 players.

games.name: Village of the Curse
games.summary: Uncover the secrets of an abandoned cursed village. Explore haunted locations, face twisted entities, and perform the final ritual to decide your fate.

games.name: Witch's Apocalyptic Journey
games.summary: Abyss decayed, witches awaken. As their guide, you will weave their destinies. Craft unique cards, schedule their days, shape endless possibilities through deckbuilding. Each choice will lead to different Ending...

games.name: Wonder Warp
games.summary: An Alien Threat Has Emerged in the City of Cynosure! Run and gun through a series of mazes to defeat the monsters.

games.name: Xeno Swarm
games.summary: "Xeno Swarm" is a hardcore side-scrolling shoot-'em-up game. Team up with your allies to battle overwhelming swarms of alien creatures, engage in life-or-death showdowns with colossal bosses on extraterrestrial battlefields, and relive the exhilarating thrill of bullet-hell mayhem!

games.name: APE
games.summary: Deep within a secret laboratory hidden from the world, scientists are creating artificial life. Trapped inside the facility, you must solve puzzles and evade the creations that roam the halls.

games.name: All Lanes Must Exit
games.summary: Build a highway interchange to connect all the roads. Don't go over-budget and don't have traffic jams. Can you complete all the levels? Yes, easily, it's not a particularly demanding game.

games.name: Apartment 19
games.summary: Apartment 19 is a horror-based interactive point and click puzzle game with visual novel elements. You start a new life by moving into this seemingly ordinary apartment complex. To get to know your new neighbors, you decide to invite them to your house-warming party. Everything goes well until a horrific event occurs, spiraling the night into insanity.

games.name: Avatar: Ice Wars
games.summary: An open world adventure role-playing game set 7,000 years before Aang’s birth, in the aftermath of volcanic eruptions triggering an ice age.

games.name: Baby Bananza Races
games.summary: Baby Bananza Races let's up to 50 chatters participate in the interactive BB Arena(200 in Tournament Mode!), earn badges, customize their racers, and more!! Try out Baby Bananza Races today at bb.gmgnrepeat.com

games.name: Beaming
games.summary: Beaming is a minimalist logic-based puzzler that involves directing beams through a hexagonal grid.

games.name: Black Plague
games.summary: A fast-paced bullet heaven roguelite where you battle endless plague hordes, collect powerful upgrades, and create game-breaking builds to survive as long as possible.

games.name: Blue Fury
games.summary: A helicopter combat game inspired by classic 16-bit titles. Destroy tanks, eliminate enemy forces, and rescue soldiers before an enemy missile launches. Manage fuel, ammunition, and altitude while engaging helicopters and avoiding AA launchers over procedurally generated terrain.

games.name: Cozy Twinkie
games.summary: Help Twinkie maintain her proper orgasm rhythm in a series of naughty minigames.

games.name: Electro Havoc
games.summary: Electro Havoc: A retro twin-stick shooter set in a neon-charged battleground where you'll face waves of geometric foes. Lure more enemies into debris fields to trigger chain reactions, and grab power-ups to boost your multipliers.

games.name: Exc. Reigai Jishou Kanshikyoku
games.summary:
This is a point-and-click adventure game where you investigate anomalies.
The protagonist is an employee of the "Reigai Jisho Kanshi Kyoku". While monitoring and investigating unexplained phenomena known as “exc.”, they search for clues to return from a parallel Earth to the original Earth.

games.name: ExerciseSimulator Vol.1
games.summary: This is a simulator where your uncle exercises hard on a rodeo machine. Operate the rodeo machine and let the uncle get some good exercise.

games.name: GeckoShop
games.summary: Collect and sell geckos. Decorate and upgrade your shop. Chase Thieves. Explore the small open-world city, full of charm and life. Sell your lizards, or keep 'em as your Pets!

games.name: Giant Waifu Wash Simulator
games.summary: Clean the city, serve a giant superstar, and shape your relationship in this relaxing power-washing simulator set in a vibrant resort town. No pressure, just satisfying gameplay and choices that matter.

games.name: Helicopter Shooter: Hot Ace Heli War Borne
games.summary: Stay airborne. Stay in control.

games.name: Janky Horse
games.summary:
Junkyard Robot Janky Horses racing for glory ... what else do you need to know? An interactive streaming game that integrates with all major streaming platforms.

Part of the Snoodle-Doodle collection of Streaming Games.

games.name: Journey Express
games.summary: A hybrid 2D/3D adventure game pitting the player against countless dangers on a cross-country journey. Manage your resources and keep your party alive!

games.name: Kitten Island 2
games.summary: The adventure continues! Return to Kitten Island and test your skills across 15 new platforming levels and guide your kitten on an all-new journey.

games.name: Mice Crisis
games.summary: Mice Crisis is a cute and chaotic action game where you play as a heroic cat on a mission to save the town! Hunt down swarms of mischievous mice, smacking corrupted predators, and saving the town in fast paced, adorable action!

games.name: Minnow
games.summary: You control a minnow in a pond looking for bugs to eat. Conversely, you'll have to dodge all of the other animals trying to eat you in turn.

games.name: Momento
games.summary: Momento is a cozy room decorator with a twist: the choices you make play out over the course of a lifetime! Decorate your room, choose which items are important to you, and discover how the objects you choose will alter the course of the story, in a winding ode to the power of everyday things.

games.name: Mortal Shell II
games.summary: Their Flesh Is Your Weapon. Mortal Shell II is a standalone sequel action-RPG with adrenaline-charged, high-stakes combat. Possess warrior Shells, dethrone false gods, redeem a ravaged world.

games.name: My Isekai Hotel
games.summary: Become the manager of your very own hotel from another world! Gather resources, play fun mini-games, expand your establishment, and keep your guests entertained. Build your reputation and create the ultimate otherworldly getaway!

games.name: Ninjas on Trampolines
games.summary: What if ninjas fought in a trampoline park, but with paint?

games.name: Nurny Battles HD
games.summary: Nurny battles HD is a little indie PvP auto battler with pre-rendered 3d visuals and gimmicky characters that can be played ONLINE or locally. it's also accessible to people with poor internet or ability to use controls

games.name: Paper Cannon
games.summary: Paper Cannon is an addictive casual shooting game where you destroy balls with simple controls. Face off against bosses at the end of each stage, and power up your cannon to destroy everything raining down from the sky! Wow!

games.name: Particulitix
games.summary: Pure 2D chaos made of particles. Fight relentless waves, exploit key positioning, do a clever build, and unlock permanent upgrades. ℙarticuliti𝕏 is a survivor action roguelite from a parallel timeline where 2D arcade games never stopped evolving.

games.name: Shényóu Kèběn
games.summary: This interactive puzzle book is for all children and those who are young at heart! You'll be transported back to your childhood school desk and immerse yourself in Chinese, math, and English textbooks. Use your brain, click your mouse, solve puzzles, and have fun! The book also includes fun illustrations and stories, so come and try it out, young and old!

games.name: Sibilla
games.summary:
Sibilla is a side-scroller action-adventure platformer inspired by games like Mirror's Edge Mobile, Vector and Canaball.
Set in late Renaissance Apulia (Italy), the game follows Sibilla, a sharp-witted and agile messenger.
The objective of each level is to avoid different type of obstacles by jumping, sliding, hanging or climbing.

games.name: Sindikat
games.summary: SINDIKAT is an online board game about business and money: buy companies, upgrade assets, collect rent, and outplay your friends in the fight for full control of the city.

games.name: Sumire's Secret
games.summary: When Sumire's teacher develops a one-sided obsession with her, her day-to-day becomes a 24/7 horror story without a hero... only victims and villains.

games.name: The Cascadier
games.summary: A coin-pusher roguelike with pinball physics! The Cascadier is a kinetic deckbuilder where you build powerful decks, drop charged coins into enchanted machines, and unleash explosive combos that cascade into high scores, hidden paths, and godly combos.

games.name: Trading Card Inspector
games.summary: Inspect your way through dozens of unique, hilarious cards in this chilled-out papers-please-em-up! Identify and appraise cards from The World's Most Coolest TCG! Start your new job as an official Habubis Trading Card Inspector and uncover a tale of friendship, corporate espionage and murder?!

games.name: UFO 50 Nonograms
games.summary:
UFO 50 Nonograms is an unofficial fangame of Mossmouth's UFO 50.

If you enjoy Nonograms and UFO 50, this game is quite literally made for you.

After a crash-landing on Zoldath, you must repair the Campanella by solving Nonogram puzzles. UFO 50 Nonograms is also an incremental game. As you solve puzzles, you will collect resources which will allow you help out others and craft upgrades.

games.name: Underworld: Allied Expedition
games.summary: Valhalla's sealed abyss unleashed dark hordes during a magical cataclysm. United surface races repelled the invasion but now venture into the unfathomable pit to confront ancient evils and uncover truths buried beneath their war-torn world.

games.name: Your Own Cozy Motel
games.summary: Build and run your own roadside motel in a hands-on simulator. Check in guests, clean and repair rooms, manage payments, upgrade facilities, and grow from a small stopover into a thriving, high-reputation business.

games.name: 2 Fights in 2 Tight Spaces
games.summary: Agent 11 is back. The iconic tactical deck-builder returns, with new tricks up its impeccably tailored sleeves and this time its with friends. Improvise within the space, adapt your deck to the challenges ahead, and overcome a roster of new enemies in stylish, animated, fight sequences.

games.name: Bckspce
games.summary: BCKSPCE, FOR A MESSAGE UNSENT as you spend the week with Stella, a close friend of yours, uncovering the mysteries of the long since abandoned SPECTRE OS. Despite her enthusiasm, something seems off with her... just don't let it bother you.

games.name: Exo Rally Championship
games.summary: Exo Rally Championship is the galaxy’s most dangerous off-road racing event - remote, unexplored, extreme exoplanetary rally. Master a brutally realistic racing simulation and fight for every second gained on your quest to become a champion.

games.name: Five Nighs at Fairy's
games.summary: Five Nights at Fairy's is an unofficial fan-made parody combining Five Nights at Freddy's and Zenless Zone Zero. The game replaces all 50 original FNaF characters with characters from ZZZ, while keeping the core survival gameplay intact. It carries a comedic, light-hearted tone and makes no attempt to take itself seriously; it's a passion project made purely for fun by fans of both franchises. This game is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or associated with either Steel Wool Studios, Scott Cawthon, or HoYoverse in any way.

games.name: MS_Dos
games.summary: Imagine yourself trapped in a computer. Imagine if... maybe you are... Imagine yourself trapped in a weirdcore-inspired open-world metroidvania-style game. How would you feel? Can you feel at all? Perhaps try figuring out. In this game, you take a stroll across numerous strange worlds, listening to what people tell you, and doing as they say. Have you ever wanted to deliver milk? Have you ever wanted to serve the Milkman? Have you ever wanted to (not) kill an Angel?

games.name: Maku
games.summary: Battle and survive through an endless swarm of monsters! Maku is a bullet hell survival game where you power-up your character with weapons and upgrades to defeat increasingly stronger enemies that await you!

games.name: More Than Eleven
games.summary: In other soccer games, you move cards and manage bots. Here, you create a real player—your own—train him every day with minigames, and win with a team of real people. No CPU. No pay-to-win.

games.name: Professor Simulator
games.summary: Professor Simulator is an idle management game where players build their academic career from novice lecturer to established researcher. Players manage their university lab by recruiting students, assembling research teams, publishing papers, and completing projects. Success leads to promotions, lab expansions, and new equipment purchases as they climb the academic ladder.

games.name: Sushi Courier!
games.summary: This is Sushi Courier! A game where you build relationships, give back to the Community, and of course... Make Sushi!

games.name: Terrinoth: Heroes of Descent
games.summary:
Terrinoth: Heroes of Descent is the first video game based on the legendary tabletop IP Descent. It is a story-driven heroic fantasy Tactical RPG refreshing the formula of dungeon crawlers for all types of fantasy fans alike and expanding on the lore of the boardgames Descent: Legends of the Dark.
Lead a fearless company of heroes into the deep and dark corridors of Terrinoth, survive against epic boss battles in turn-based combat, and settle the fate of a world facing an unending darkness

games.name: The Named
games.summary:
3,236 years after the Copper Odyssey events, a Very Interesting Person creates a game show for TV where contestants can get a chance at winning a Name in this nameless world. The effects of the Sun and the colors of the Sky are now friends with the humans, or so it seems.

See how this game show plays out, and who will be the winner deserving of a Name.

games.name: The Wheelchair Man
games.summary: Steal $5,000 from an abandoned apartment complex while avoiding a demented man.

games.name: Where Winds Meet
games.summary: Where Winds Meet is a free-to-play wuxia action-adventure RPG set in China during the Five Dynasties and Ten Kingdoms period. Players take on the role of a wandering adventurer known as a youxia, wielding a variety of weapons including swords, spears, fans, and umbrellas, each paired with distinct martial arts styles. The open world spans multiple regions and supports both single-player and multiplayer modes, with cooperative dungeons, PvP arenas, and a range of casual activities. Combat combines light and heavy attacks, martial art skills, mystic arts, and defensive maneuvers like dodges, blocks, and deflects.

games.name: 100 Sherwood Cats
games.summary:
Join the cutest adventure in the world full of cats! Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of special themed locations as you embark on a quest to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game.
Test your attention and observation skills in this cozy and delightful hidden object game.
Each cat is more charming than the last, and every discovery brings a smile to your face.

games.name: Apology Video
games.summary: An FMV Choose-Your-Own-Adventure that'll leave you wanting to like and subscribe!

games.name: Arms of God
games.summary: Gear up for a battle through hell in this next-gen autoshooter with Doom-inspired gore vibes, metal music, roguelite mechanics, and a satisfying combat feel. Wield five weapons at once, upgrade and merge them to forge indestructible builds, and bring divine justice to a world on the brink of chaos.

games.name: Atre: Dominance Wars
games.summary: Attain the powers of a God and dominate in this lore-driven 4X game full of unique species. Evolve your units to command diverse armies. Develop magnificent cities. Research and master arcane spellcraft to lay waste to the world itself. Find your own path to power and Ascend above all else.

games.name: Aux Court
games.summary:
Aux Court is a free browser-based multiplayer music game in which players
battle over music taste. Connected to each player's Spotify account, matches
revolve around picking real tracks and judging the opponent's picks, with
verdicts delivered courtroom-style by gavel.

Game modes include Classic duels (turn-based pick-and-judge), Speed rounds
(both players pick and vote simultaneously on timed snippets), King of the
Hill (a lobby where the reigning King defends the throne against a queue of
challengers while the crowd votes), Genre Gauntlet (an elimination mode where
picks must match a target genre, validated against Spotify artist data), and
Streamer Mode (the streamer locks tracks and their audience votes YES or NO
in real time through a public vote page or the Aux Court Twitch extension,
with optional Bits-boosted votes).

Competitive play is organized into one-week seasons with Elo ratings: at the
end of each season the top ten players are inducted into a permanent Hall of
Fame, and ratings reset for the new season. Cosmetic court skins, a global
leaderboard, and English and Québécois French localization are included.

games.name: Backrooms: Multiplayer Horror
games.summary:
Enter the Backrooms, a multiplayer horror escape game where every match turns friends into enemies.

Team up with real players, complete tasks, and move through eerie zones filled with flickering lights, empty halls, and hidden danger. But not everyone is trying to escape. One player becomes the Backrooms monster, stalking the survivors and stopping them before they reach the final exit.

games.name: Chromadi
games.summary: Mix and match colors and blast your way through waves of Chromies in this fast-paced retro arcade shooter. Play as the Chroma Crew to defend the Rainbar and restore color to the fading planet of Chromara!

games.name: Cube Runner 3D
games.summary: Cube Runner 3D challenges you by making you dodge oncoming cubes that will destroy you as soon as you touch them. Survive as long as you can in this randomly generated world.

games.name: Cursemark
games.summary: Cursemark is an action-exploration roguelike where you forge unique equipment to pierce the depths of the Unknown Lands. Unlock hundreds of items and spells, then discover powerful rune synergies every run in this place beyond the edges of the world.

games.name: Decks of Dexterity
games.summary: Decks of Dexterity fuses bullet hell shooter gameplay with a strategic turn based card game; your deck determines your power! Explore the Void to discover hundreds of cards, powerful treasures, unique characters, all contributes to building a powerful deck and defeating the corruption!

games.name: Duppy Detective Tashia
games.summary: Help Tashia unravel the case of a heinous murder and find her cell phone in this point & click, mystery adventure based on Caribbean folklore!

games.name: Gacha Capsule Shop Simulator: Akihabara
games.summary: Stock and manage your Gacha Capsule Machines in this shop simulator. Help your collectors chase rare pulls, welcome anime lovers, and turn Akihabara into a true gacha paradise. Build your own capsule figure collection aswell, from giant mecha robots and kawaii cat maids to iconic meme figures.

games.name: Hearing Voices
games.summary: Hearing Voices is a unique indie short horror experience where you will need to put your listening and deduction skills to the test to solve puzzles. Mistakes have consequences.

games.name: Hell Bug
games.summary: Crush mutant bugs, unlock new allies from the remains of defeated bosses, and build your own swarm of chaos! Hell Bug is a fast-paced roguelite shooter where every boss you defeat brings you closer to expanding your army with strange and powerful bugs. Each bug has a story, some shouldn't be told.

games.name: Ikapali
games.summary: IKAPALI is a uber-short, linear point-and-click horror game about killing a paedophile to save women and children. Explore a house that's not yours and exact vigilante revenge against society's ill. But as his life unfolds in front of you, will you blindly follow your moral compass through death's door?

games.name: Insomnia: Chapter One
games.summary: 2012. The Arctic research station "Persei" loses contact with the outside world. You are Ethan Miller, a technician sent to the facility to fix the issues. But something here has clearly gone out of control.

games.name: Kamikaze Empire
games.summary: Carve the path to victory with kamikaze attacks! Blow away enemies with outlandish weapons, then become your own projectile and take the rest out in a blaze of explosive glory! A self destructive shmup where you devastate everything in your wake. "Squadron, charge~!"

games.name: Killer Bean
games.summary: You are Killer Bean, a rogue assassin who takes out the trash in this world, one bullet at a time. The procedurally generated story changes every time you start a new campaign in this third person, roguelike shooter.

games.name: Killzone Extraction
games.summary: Strap in for a high-octane rescue operation where every second counts. In this combat experience, you are dropped behind enemy lines with one objective: survive long enough to escape.

games.name: Menacetide
games.summary: Menacetide is a top-down sci-fi shooter where every second counts and every upgrade could mean the difference between extinction and survival. Dodge, destroy, and dominate as you unravel the mysterious forces behind a tide of chaos.

games.name: Mumagi: Stellar Saviors
games.summary: Mumagi: Stellar Saviors is a co-op horde survivor where you can gather up to 4 players to take down celestial forces. Choose a magical girl, enhance your powers, and restore time and space to their natural order!

games.name: Ogre Chambers 2222
games.summary: A ROGUELIKE, where you FIND and FUSE ABILITIES, while raiding TRANSFORMING space ARENAS Traverse randomized planets - Murder their populations - Get stronger - Take down Ogre Overlords! But remember, DO NOT anger the ogres beyond your guns' capabilities!

games.name: Pokegg
games.summary:
Simple click‑based egg hatcher inspired by Pokémon Eggs.
A web‑browser game where you click repeatedly to hatch eggs, earn money for every hatch, and use your earnings to buy rarer eggs or permanent upgrades.
Complete your Pokédex by discovering every creature you can hatch.

games.name: Pop Pop Potato
games.summary:
Pop Pop Potato is a rage game + 2D platformer where you blast yourself up the level with explosive corn kernels instead of jumping.

You lose control in the air, so wherever you land, that's it, even if it's the bottom of the level.

games.name: Puni the Florist
games.summary: Puni the Florist is a cozy flower shop simulation game that highlights creative expressions. Manage the shop, design unique bouquets, and join Puni on a silly, wholesome, and relatable journey of self-discovery.

games.name: Rakeo
games.summary: Rakeo is a precision platformer about collecting cookies! Find secrets, face bosses, and collect lots of cookies!

games.name: SeekOut
games.summary: Disguise yourself as props, blend into the environment, and survive while Hunters smash everything around them to find you. Use spells, traps, and special abilities to outplay your enemies and sometimes even sabotage your own teammates to gain the advantage.

games.name: Sinister Outbreak
games.summary: Sinister Outbreak is an action-horror game where you wake up in a zombie-infested lab. With no memory and danger around every corner, fight to survive, uncover the truth, and escape the nightmare.

games.name: Solarpunk
games.summary:
Solarpunk is a survival game in a technically advanced world of floating islands. Alone or together with your friends, you can construct buildings, grow food, craft gadgets and explore distant islands with your own airship.

Use sunlight, wind and water to create an energy system and automate your processes like gathering ressoureces, watering your plants or catching fish.

games.name: Spirit Talk
games.summary: Cozy visual novel about a lovely witch who’s able to talk to spirits in a fantasy setting. Using her powers, Julia helps her neighbors in their daily whereabouts. Craft potions, find the right time to use them and get to know both spirits and clients to find their peace.

games.name: Sudoku: Unlimited Expansion
games.summary: A growing Sudoku puzzle game with expanding Samurai boards, larger classic grids, notes, controller support, and Steam Deck-friendly play.

games.name: Super Coupon Club
games.summary:
Join Victoria and her rag tag group of underground after-market coupon counterfeiters collectively known as the Super Coupon Club as they take on the new Corporate Super Mart!

Utilize up to 25 unique coupons in order to take down the Super Mart within 7 rounds to show those snooty suits you ladies really run this town in this Roguelike Deck builder.

games.name: Table 9
games.summary: Deliver coffee to 9 tables in a looping European-style specialty cafe, spot the anomalies creeping in and reach Table 9.

games.name: The Profaned
games.summary: The Profaned is an Anomaly-Hunt horror game about a person who's trying to cleanse his sins. The primary task is to investigate the endless forsaken church to find the anomalies and capture them with your camera to cleanse your sins. And if you fail to do so, start again from the beginning.

games.name: Thug Wars
games.summary: An open world GTA style third person crime action game set in 3 cities, New York, London and Moscow. Contains 56 missions , humourous dialogue and a huge world. With retro ps2 style graphics and vehicles unique to each city. The story is centred around the main player doing jobs for the mob and different gangs to gain wealth and power and climb the power hierarchy.

games.name: Trials Survivors
games.summary: Fight through endless hordes in trials bestowed by constellation patrons. Upgrade skills, collect relics, and craft broken builds in true roguelite fashion! Rediscover the fantasy behind the words hack and slash and bullet heaven. Will you survive the densest monster Survivor-like ever created?

games.name: Wageslave
games.summary: A short, narrative, dystopian office survival game. Ship code to eat. Optimise your nootropics stack. Stay sane. Cope with HR's passive-aggressive pings. Climb the career ladder. Retire early (if you can).

games.name: Wanted Shadows: Unchained
games.summary: A survivors-like game where you defeat creatures of the night trying to take over the underworld. Vanquish the invasion, perfect your build, and become purgatory's master.

games.name: Wyvern Warriors
games.summary: Wyvern Warriors is an action game where players ride dragons and engage in dogfights with them.

games.name: Xeno Strike
games.summary: Sci-fi card battler where you build powerful decks of aliens, robots and starships. Outsmart opponents using strategy and skill in online competition.

games.name: 20 Floors
games.summary: You are left alone on the top floor of an apartment. Your only goal is to reach the ground. But as you descend, the corridor you once knew begins to warp into something grotesque. There's no telling what horror awaits. Just don't stop. Keep going down.

games.name: Algator vs Sharkz
games.summary:
Algator and Sharkz are enjoying a well-deserved taco in their retro lair when the alarm sounds. Guivarch and Kerberiou, straight out of the code's deep swamps, seize the precious Eminem vinyl records and cut off the RedBull supply. The two heroes spring onto the neon platforms to secure the first sector.

The arcade city streets are locked down. Jonathan and Vista unleash waves of absurd enemies armed with Brawl Stars stars. Algator triggers his Dash to dodge through projectiles, while Sharkz chains combos to recover the creator code hidden atop a tower of M&M's.

Just as the team thinks they've regained control, Timeo emerges with an overpowered army, triggering the Endless Survival protocol. Trapped in a never-ending arena, our two protagonists must harness the power of giant pears and €20 bills to unlock their ultimate attacks and break free.

The bosses unite for a chaotic final showdown in the heart of The Banger Empire. Legendary dialogue flies back and forth, retro-futuristic synth music swells, and only a flawless combo streak will let Algator and Sharkz etch their names at the top of the leaderboard.

games.name: Anime Quiz Challenge
games.summary: Anime Quiz Challenge is a fast-paced anime trivia game featuring 40 carefully selected questions from popular series such as Naruto, One Piece, Dragon Ball Z, Attack on Titan, Death Note, Jujutsu Kaisen, and more. Test your knowledge against a 10-second timer, build answer streaks, earn ranks based on your performance, and see whether you can achieve the title of Anime Grandmaster.

games.name: Atelier Yumia: The Alchemist of Memories & the Envisioned Land
games.summary:
In a world where alchemy is deemed "taboo", the alchemist Yumia yearns for the "truth" that lies hidden in the ruined continent.
Now, she takes her first steps on a grand adventure across the continent─

games.name: Axom: Conquest
games.summary: A base building roguelite tower defence game set on the dangerous planet named Axom. Gather resources to build defences, unlock research between games to get stronger and ultimately unlock the secrets of the mysterious planet.

games.name: Bad Football
games.summary: The arcade football game built to ruin friendships. Fast, brutal, lawless. Pick from 48 national teams and lift the Worst Cup, or wreck a friend in local 1v1.

games.name: Bellwright
games.summary: Establish and expand your own settlements, liberate the land and assist its villagers, and recruit others to your cause while learning more about a life you had to leave behind. Command your forces, prove your valor through combat, and cement yourself as the hero of your people.

games.name: CAPTCHA.Exe
games.summary: You are locked inside a small testing room. Your only job is to solve standard CAPTCHA tests by speaking into your microphone. Tell the machine where the fire hydrants and crosswalks are to prove you are human.

games.name: Call of Warfront
games.summary: Fight smart. Win fast

games.name: Cauldron Craft
games.summary: Grab your backpack and get ready to explore the seemingly peaceful lands of Cauldron Craft. Explore various areas, gather magical items, and craft, craft, CRAFT.

games.name: Crownseeker
games.summary: Hunt relics by day and night across a fog-shrouded world. Manage hunger. Gear up. Outlast or defeat what's hunting you. Collect all the relics — and the Crown appears. If you survive long enough to claim it.

games.name: Crude Oil
games.summary: Escape your captors as a puddle of petroleum on the run from Big Oil. Collect more oil to grow big and juicy. Bounce and slide. Operate heavy machinery. Flush polluters down the drain.

games.name: Damsels in Distress
games.summary:
This is a classic tale of rescuing maidens from dangerous villains such as goblins, trolls, werewolves, harpies, and other dark creatures. You will encounter them across a variety of locations throughout the game world.

Your choices directly influence the story and the progression of the main character. Certain paladin abilities depend on your moral path and personal discipline. Multiple endings await, shaped by the decisions you make along the way.

games.name: Echoes of Sin: Confusion
games.summary:
Echoes of Sin: Confusion is a first-person anomaly horror game where players must observe their surroundings and identify subtle changes in the environment.

The game features a unique anomaly system with randomized events, requiring players to pay close attention to details in order to progress. Some anomalies introduce new mechanics, while others alter the environment in unexpected ways.

The experience is designed to be replayable, with multiple outcomes and hidden elements that are revealed through repeated playthroughs.

games.name: Eden's Eclipse
games.summary: The third installment in the Eden series, a 2D bullet-hell vertical-scrolling shump with a feel reminiscent of arcade games from the 1990s to the 2000s.

games.name: Fearstruck
games.summary: Fearstruck is a rougelike, turn-based RPG with enemies themed around fears, phobias, and mental illnesses. Choose your Sinner, your Abilities, and learn how best to cope with the Incarnates you meet in the Inbetween.

games.name: Game Design at WVU Arcade
games.summary: A 3d arcade game in which you play the machines in your store to upgrade them and get ready for opening day. All games are created by students and alumni from Game Design and Interactive Media at West Virginia University.

games.name: How to Make an Atomic Bomb in Your Garden
games.summary: An absurd backyard bomb-building simulator. Raise funds, plan your approach, hunt down rare parts, and assemble your atomic masterpiece while staying calm and avoiding suspicion from nosy neighbors and federal agents.

games.name: Immunity Protocol
games.summary: Pilot an immune-cell sentinel in a neon pixel-art horde-survival auto-shooter. Move manually, auto-fire evolving weapons, draft upgrades, equip symbiotes, and survive escalating pathogen swarms inside a collapsing biotech system.

games.name: Lusófona Games Collection 2025
games.summary: Lusófona Games Collection 2025 brings you five unique, student and staff made games from Lusófona University. Dive into creative prototypes packed with passion, gameplay innovation, and behind-the-scenes commentary from the next generation of game developers!

games.name: Lóng zhī Gǔ: Huáijiù Fú
games.summary:
Dragon Nest Classic brings players back to the golden age of Althea.
This service focuses on the authentic PvE raiding experience, featuring classic progression from Cerberus to Sea Dragon Nests.

Our philosophy is simple: prioritize the thrill of the hunt and tactical cooperation over rushed content updates. We aim to recreate the genuine "first-clear" excitement that defined the original Dragon Nest experience. Join a community of dedicated adventurers and reclaim your legacy in the Nests.

games.name: Meccha Chameleon
games.summary: Paint yourself to blend in! "Meccha Chameleon" is a new-sensation hide-and-seek game where you paint your white body to mimic the stage. Spot, pose, and "artistic skill" are keys to survival. Deceive Seekers with techniques that put chameleons to shame! Supports public matches and streaming.

games.name: Million Bouillon
games.summary: Million Bouillon (/mɪˈjɔn buˈjɔn/ mee-YAWN boo-YAWN) is a short exploration "SOUP-like" game developed for SOUPJAM2026.

games.name: Mudventure
games.summary: Mudventure is a casual sandbox adventure set in a living tidal-flat world of mud. Dig terrain, gather resources, upgrade equipment, and control the environment by building dams. Fight monsters and bosses, enjoy fishing at night, and escape the island by repairing a ship—solo or online co-op.

games.name: My Summer Love
games.summary: Kang Yuna is a student at the University of Arts in Korea. She is someone very intelligent and charming. In a nineties summer you're a new student in her class. Could love develop between the two?

games.name: NBA The Run
games.summary: Take your favorite NBA stars to iconic streetball courts around the world, in this fast-paced, online 3v3 basketball game. Stack wins, earn cred and become the GOAT of THE RUN. Who's Got Next?

games.name: NBA the Run
games.summary: Take your favorite NBA stars to iconic streetball courts around the world, in this fast-paced, online 3v3 basketball game. Stack wins, earn cred and become the GOAT of THE RUN. Who's Got Next?

games.name: Nova Swarm
games.summary: Pick a ship, dive into readable bullet chaos, take down huge angry bosses, grab the bonus core you probably should have left alone, and chase one cleaner run in Nova Swarm.

games.name: Poetic Trio
games.summary: A game about rain, a game about snow, and a game about wind. All in one.

games.name: Regeneration Engine
games.summary: Fall into the engine and try to fight your way back up to the surface in this turn-based RPG. As your companions die, consume their essences to grow stronger. Explore a strange underground world with your party, battle creatures roaming the dark, and discover the mystery behind the apocalypse.

games.name: Return Machine.Love()
games.summary: 3 different Robot-romance stories. Written, drawn, and made by humans, for humans. Since the very moment the first mechanical mind became aware of itself, it craved love. No one truly understand why the heart made of copper and wires started beating, but it did. Even after we were gone.

games.name: Road to Empress II
games.summary: Play as the protagonist in this live-action interactive palace survival drama! Take a dynasty's fate into your own hands in Road to Empress II, the upcoming new content of a global hit. Defy fate, navigate intrigue, and claim the throne of power. You decide it all!

games.name: Shā Diāo Zhī Lù
games.summary: A bizarre open-world action RPG by a Chinese independent studio, seemingly abandoned after some time in Early Access.

games.name: Silent Howl
games.summary: In Silent Howl, every night is a fight for survival. Villagers must unmask the Werewolves lurking among them, ready to strike from the shadows. But beware, powerful hidden roles can shift the balance. Will you expose the truth and save the village, or tear it apart from within?

games.name: SnowRunner
games.summary:
SnowRunner is an off-road driving simulation game that focuses on navigating challenging terrain using a variety of heavy vehicles. Players complete contracts and objectives across open environments, transporting cargo while overcoming mud, snow, rivers, and other natural obstacles.
The game emphasizes realistic physics, vehicle customization, and route planning, with progression tied to upgrading equipment and expanding a fleet suited for different conditions.

games.name: Tavern Talk Stories: Dreamwalker
games.summary: Welcome Tavernkeep! In this D&D-inspired visual novel you will run a cozy seaside tavern, meet adventurers, gather rumours and mix fate-altering drinks to stop dreams from twisting into nightmares.

games.name: The Princess and the Portals
games.summary:
When the Spider Queen kidnaps the Princess and all the knights have fallen, what's a kingdom to do? It's time to throw on your wizard robes, grab your wand, and put the only two spells you know to use.

Take careful aim with your portals to solve platforming puzzles, defy death, and restore Faedum to its rightful glory.

Test your gaming mettle with precision platforming and aiming.
Conquer over 65 levels and 5 unique bosses.
Hone your skills as a wizard to climb the global leaderboards.
Unlock “Hard” Mode after beating the game for an even greater challenge.

games.name: Traumatarium: Penitent
games.summary:
A dungeon crawler inspired by the Fighting Fantasy books and Warhammer Quest 1995.

The followup to Traumatarium, Penitent aims to improve on the success of the original, while improving and expanding on almost all aspects. You have three distinct dungeons to overcome, all while managing scarce resources and making hard decisions on when to push on, or use a map to return to the safety of one of the few outposts found in those dark halls.

Traumatarium Penitent takes place well after the events of the original game. The kingdom's knights have broken into two factions: the Penitents, who swore to pay off their sins in defense of the kingdom, and the Ebon Legion, who aim to bring forth again the evil spirits that once haunted the land.

games.name: Voidling Bound
games.summary: Hatch, evolve, and upgrade powerful space creatures in this action-packed sci-fi 3rd person shooter that reinvents the monster taming genre!

games.name: We Belong Dead
games.summary: Toxic Yuri VN between a mad scientist, and her spectral lover who haunts the living. It has been far too long since you passed. You have been gone for so long. But no longer. I will bring you back my love. No matter the cost.

games.name: Wend
games.summary: A word-finding game where players connect letters in a grid to uncover hidden words. Every letter is used exactly once, and the challenge is finding the right path through the board to uncover them all.

games.name: Wound Man
games.summary: Wound Man is your guide on a gruesome adventure through the ages. Piece his epic story together while literally piecing him together. Poke, prod, stab and slice away to reveal his secrets. It's a jigsaw adventure! - but not for the faint of heart.

games.name: Xenoblade Chronicles: Definitive Edition - Nintendo Switch 2 Edition
games.summary: Xenoblade Chronicles: Definitive Edition - Nintendo Switch 2 Edition includes the additions and enhancements from the Definitive Edition, along with even more made possible by the power of the Nintendo Switch 2 system - including added features, a smoother frame rate, 4K resolution in TV mode, and full HD in handheld mode.

games.name: 33 Immortals
games.summary: 33 Immortals is a co-op action-roguelike for 33 players. Play a damned soul, and rebel against God’s final judgment. Pick-up and raid, cooperate to survive hordes of monsters, defeat massive bosses, and face the wrath of God in a fight for your eternal life.

games.name: Above
games.summary: A daylight, psychological horror experience. Stranded in the desert, every choice meant to save you brings something closer.

games.name: Aleesha's Tower
games.summary: A young woman named Aleesha was hunted and killed accused of witchcraft. Years later she comes back to take revenge on all mankind and it's up to you to stop her.

games.name: All That Time
games.summary: All That Time is a first-person nostalgic adventure where you wander surreal spaces, relive childhood dreams and memories, solve hidden mysteries, and search for your own escape while freeing those who remain trapped.

games.name: Apocalypse Express
games.summary: Conduct, upgrade and repair your train through endless waves of enemies in a post-apocalyptic setting. In this action management roguelike, the player decides to embark on a journey through the wasteland looking to fulfill the dream of seeing the remains of the outside world.

games.name: Armory Simulator
games.summary: Build, manage, and expand your very own armory, catering to cowboys, bounty hunters, and outlaws in search of the finest gear.

games.name: Artificial Extinction 2
games.summary: A Tower Defense hybrid where survival depends on strategy and firepower. Build turrets, mine resources, and hold the line against relentless AI swarms. Switch instantly between commanding the battlefield in RTS view or fighting on the ground in FPS combat.

games.name: Beats of Fury
games.summary: Beats Of Fury is mix of Rhythm Game and Bullet Hell Top down shooter, be ready to take the role of the DJ and smash your own fingers playing music while shooting every single beat on the screen.

games.name: Blast Head
games.summary: Blast Head is a meta progression-focused roguelite/bullet heaven with absurd weapons, powerful runes, and non-linear weapon skill trees. Dive into 10–30 minute runs, discover wild synergies, and unleash chaos across alien arenas.

games.name: Burglin' Gnomes
games.summary: An online Co-op game about breaking into houses and causing havoc as a tiny gnome. Avoid danger, repurpose stolen household items, and complete tasks to meet the High-Gnome’s demands. Craft equipment and upgrade your home to make your missions easier and more successful.

games.name: CoinPit
games.summary: CoinPit is a dark game that blends roguelike strategy with coin pusher thrills. Trapped in a never-closing, dimly lit bar, your escape lies in the coin pusher—stack shiny towers, spin the lucky wheel, and shake the machine until the coins spill out.

games.name: Come In
games.summary: After months of chatting online, she invites you over. A quiet house in the middle of the woods seems like the perfect place for a romantic encounter. But the longer you stay inside, the more you realize something is wrong with this place.

games.name: Crushed in Time
games.summary: Embark on an adventure with Sherlock Holmes and Dr Watson on this surprising and elastic point-and-click adventure. Grab, pull, and release to help them solve a bizarre investigation full of humor and meta-time travel!

games.name: Detective Inna Duke
games.summary: A noir story-driven visual novel where you team up with lieutenant Inna Duke and her partner corporal Fernal to investigate the mysterious abduction of the popular streamer Oleh Hamston. But will you manage to track down the poor hamster in rainy city?

games.name: Don't Panic Together
games.summary: Don’t Panic is an online co-op psychological horror game with a microphone detection system; players must control their real voices, protect their sanity, and work together to survive the night in a dark environment.

games.name: Fears to Fathom: Scratch Creek
games.summary: After noticing bone-chilling similarities to an episode of Fears to Fathom, Tessa and Marcus decide to share their own experience.

games.name: Finding Ducks
games.summary:
Finding Ducks is a game much like Where's Wally but for Ducks. Currently in EA with advancements coming with levels.

Can you find the ducks in this find point and click find them game.

games.name: Hold Your King
games.summary: In this physics-based co-op platformer, you and a friend must carry your short-tempered king through deadly medieval courses. Dodge traps, maintain balance, and work together to reach the throne room. One wrong step, and the king might crown you with his rage!

games.name: Hole*
games.summary:
explicit, 18+

under 500 words

vulgar and dysphoric language

made for the 2026 toxic yuri vn jam 2

games.name: Interdimensional Vending Machine
games.summary: Inspired by SCP-261, you play as a homeless girl struggling to survive in a distorted city using a vending machine that should not exist. Every coin dispenses impossible food that defies biology and logic, and every meal reshapes your fate. How long can you survive before you stop being human?

games.name: Into The Depths
games.summary: A roguelite city builder, where you colonize the mysterious underworld. Build your settlement, explore the caves and colonize the deepest caverns. Overcome the dangers hidden in the dark and make the riches of the Depths yours!

games.name: Kamilia
games.summary:
Kamilia is an emotional, story-driven detective mystery where your choices shape the outcome.

Step into the shoes of a gifted painter, pulled into an unsolved mystery. An investigation that soon turns into something far deeper — an intimate, heartfelt search for truth.

Explore a beautifully crafted narrative blending mystery, emotion, and visual storytelling into a unique, choice-driven experience.

games.name: Letter Lost
games.summary: You’re the sole employee at the Kharnym Isle post office, stamping, sorting, and delivering mail. But the job hides secrets, and the office itself holds mysteries you must uncover. This will be the only job you’ll ever need to work… unless you can escape.

games.name: Liminal Logistics
games.summary: Pick up a box, check the order, stock the right items, and complete as many orders as you can. Don’t forget to manage your stamina while working your way through our questionably designed warehouses. Enjoy your shift at Liminal Logistics, where a box is only the beginning.

games.name: Limit Zero Breakers
games.summary: Explore the floating islands of Seraphia as a Breaker in this anime action RPG. Build a team of characters with different fighting styles and unleash stylish attacks as you battle through ancient dungeons and massive monsters in search of the Archive of the Gods.

games.name: Lost Lands X
games.summary: The sudden madness of an old friend from the Lost Lands forces Susan, who has long since retired, to return to her old adventures. “Lost Lands X” is an adventure game in the genre of Hidden Objects, with plenty of mini-games and puzzles, unforgettable characters and complicated quests.

games.name: Love Chemistry: Sibella's Formula
games.summary:
A SFW release of "Lustful Chemistry" for consoles.

Take the role of an unhinged lady chemist in raucous side-scrolling platformer Love Chemistry - Sibella’s Formula! Shoot syringes of your special mind-control formula at weird enemies, from robots and carnivorous plants to roving bookworms, and make your way through tricky corridors in old-school pixel art style!

games.name: Maimai DX Prism Plus
games.summary: The mid-cycle update of SEGA's arcade rhythm game, maimai DX PRiSM.

games.name: Orbital Challenge
games.summary:
Roll, jump, and teleport through 10 intense levels in this fast-paced platformer!
Master challenging obstacles, dodge creative traps, and fight for the fastest time on the global leaderboards.
Precision, chaos, and pure platforming fun await!

games.name: Please Ignore The Anomalies
games.summary: A first-person psychological horror game about observing strange anomalies, surviving disturbing entities, and trying to make it to work on time. Sometimes the house is completely normal... sometimes it is not.

games.name: Quick Brown
games.summary: Quick Brown is a cute and cozy 2d puzzle platformer about a fox trying to collect all 26 letters of the alphabet scattered across a forest. It is the first game of the "Subspace" Franchise created by Subanshh.

games.name: RWS
games.summary: Rolling With Swords is a chaotic 2D arena brawler set in random levels. Chain attacks, roll through danger, and collect absurd power-ups in a tug-of-war system where control constantly shifts until one player claims the entire arena.

games.name: Robot Hospice
games.summary: "Robot Hospice" is a 2D pixel art adventure game where beloved robots spend their final days in a hospice. As a new staff member, you will gently yet painfully bid farewell to these cherished machines that once lived alongside humans.

games.name: Scream You Lose
games.summary: If you get startled, you go back to Number 0. A Japanese-style horror anomaly-spotting game that uses your microphone to detect your reactions. Eerie shrines, schools, and cult-like locations await, filled with all kinds of horror and anomalies.

games.name: Secret Paws: Cozy Apartments
games.summary: Secret Paws - Cozy Apartments is a game where you need to find all the hidden cats in the apartments. Open furniture, move objects, and uncover all the hiding spots. Are you ready to become the ultimate cat finder?

games.name: Shadow Among Nove
games.summary: In a remote corner of space lies an old ship with no engines nor power. In its dark cabin with no lights on, a brown-haired bounty hunter is watching the news about a high bounty on offer, unaware that someone is infiltrating his ship. Under the threat of a cold gun, a journey of suspicion and uncertainty begins.

games.name: Snowstorm
games.summary: snowstorm is a short narrative game about an old retired photographer. Find memories and unravel the burdens of the past.

games.name: Sugar Shatter
games.summary: Smash through your competition in Sugar Shatter, a breakout fighting game where you have to hit a candy ball to break more bricks than your opponent. Meet a variety of characters in campaign mode, or challenge your friends to a test of skill with local multiplayer versus mode!

games.name: The Dreams in the Peacock House
games.summary: Wake up from a never-ending slumber and find your lost dreams in the shadows of the Peacock House.

games.name: The Tragedy at Deer Creek
games.summary: Photographer Charlotte Gray travels to Deer Creek to document a long deserted logging camp for her upcoming book ”Forgotten Frontiers”. She finds not only a derelict camp, but also a mournful tale of family, love and loyalty hidden beneath the Alaskan snow, in this point-and-click adventure.

games.name: Total Football Online
games.summary: Build your All-Star lineup in Total Football Online! Easy to pick up, it lets you dive into pure football fun at your fingertips. With events and player updates syncing with real-world tournaments, get ready for a truly immersive football experience.

games.name: Trance World
games.summary: Trance World is a high-speed action platformer set in a world deep in the universe that is under attack by power-hungry, manipulative warlords. You play as Rem T. Saikle, a struggling individual facing classism with his older sister, Piper. However, when the planet-turned-mothership, Trauvia, invades Rem's home and kidnaps his sister, Rem is forced to defend himself and his people...using weapons he stole, and save his planet.

games.name: Witchspire
games.summary: A survival-crafting adventure in a world brimming with magic and peril. Befriend and battle creatures, and conjure up a sanctuary alongside other witches in co-op or single-player.

games.name: Withdrawal
games.summary: An FPS roguelike heist. Play as Mr. (?) Norton on his way to exterminate the whole headquarters of the Cranterry Wealth Corporation.

games.name: Wool at the Gates
games.summary: Defend your base from hordes of invading sheep. Fight as a hero with powerful abilities or shapeshift into a flying eyeball to traverse the battlefield and command troops. Build your defenses and economy while creating synergies that unlock class bonuses and perks for your hero, troops, and towers.

games.name: Word Rift
games.summary: A fast-paced word puzzle game featuring handcrafted levels, speedruns, endless mode, and global leaderboards.

games.name: 101 Dogs Hidden in Milan
games.summary: Join this adventure and discover the hiding places of 101 dogs in Milan in the hand-crafted landscape. Earn tons of achievements. How many can you find? Be quick!

games.name: 4 x 3
games.summary: A Connections inspired daily puzzle game with nine words that fit into four categories of three - with one word being shared between all categories

games.name: 4PGP
games.summary: Race around the world! 4PGP is a 90’s arcade-style racing game with a timeless charm and simple controls that makes it easy to pick up and play.

games.name: Aphrodite Evolve Weapons Survivor: Greek Gods Versus Heaven
Arashi Gaiden
games.summary: Arashi Gaiden is a turn-based action game, with frantic combat, in the dash-and-slash style.
