No cars means no fuel. No fuel means total darkness and trust me, you don’t want to be here when the lights go out.

games.name: The Last Salvage Squad
games.summary: Battle enemy forces reminiscent of alien weapons from retro sci-fi works in this single-player 2.5D FPS.

games.name: The Scroll of Taiwu
games.summary: "The Scroll of Taiwu" is an indie game themed around Chinese mythology and wuxia. Players assume the role of the mysterious "heir of the Taiwu clan" in an alternate ancient China, working through generations of heirs to defeat a powerful hereditary enemy and shape the fate of the human world.

games.name: The Seven Days I Spent With You
games.summary: With the enigmatic girl who imprisoned you――seven days in an unfamiliar room.

games.name: Total Simp Death
games.summary: You're a waifu just trying to get by, eating burgers to get thicker. The simps keep coming but you have your trusty rocket launcher.

games.name: Whisper of the House
games.summary: What's happening in this seemingly peaceful town? Strange residents, bizarre incidents, and unexpected storylines! Please be sure to let go of all your human lifestyle preferences and strive to meet the special requests of your otherworldly employers. Decorate this house with peculiar furniture!

games.name: #Drive Rally
games.summary: Drive Rally lets you relive the 90s in the most exciting era in motorsport history, where dust, mud, and snow are badges of honor. Unleash the raw power of legendary rally beasts, admire every second of the stunning landscapes, and remember: the faster you go, the better!

games.name: Angels Online Global
games.summary: Angels Online Global is a charming 2D fantasy MMORPG featuring flexible builds, faction warfare, and deep customization. Enjoy 4× leveling, expanded inventory, real-time chat translation, and dungeon-earned outfits with fusion upgrades!

games.name: Arcade Archives 2: Space Cyclone
games.summary: Stop the BEMs from building enemy rockets!

games.name: Arcade Archives: Space Cyclone
games.summary: Stop the BEMs from building enemy rockets!

games.name: Arcadie II: Cold Lands
games.summary: You are the Monarch. Protect your rule and your kingdom. Pursue the heart of your chosen lover, manage fragile alliances, or bring the world to heel, no matter the cost, in this character-driven interactive tale. The choice, and the crown, are yours.

games.name: Astrophidia
games.summary: Astronomical Tips:

games.name: Backrooms: Escape Together
games.summary: A visually lifelike 1-6 player co-op survival horror made in Unreal Engine 5. Explore procedurally generated levels that host liminal environments, puzzles, and entities with new levels and content added regularly. You are at the mercy of what's lurking and must do whatever it takes to escape.

games.name: Backrooms: The Void
games.summary: Backrooms: The Void is a cooperative psychological horror game for 14 players. Trapped in an endless emptiness where space feels alive and reality constantly distorts, you must navigate decaying corridors, forgotten places, and impossible structures while something unseen follows your every move.

games.name: Bakso Simulator 2
games.summary: The Sequel to Bakso Simulator with new gameplay, areas, characters, and more!

games.name: Barbecue
games.summary: Barbecue is a co-op party game where 1 to 4 players manage a backyard BBQ that spirals into total chaos. Light the fire, grill the meat, serve the guests, and try not to burn everything down.

games.name: Baron Misanthrope
games.summary: A short 1-2 hour denpa visual novel about a man of dubious sanity and his mysterious top hat-wearing companion.

games.name: Bloons TD 6
games.summary: Bloons TD 6 is a tower defense game in which players place various monkey towers along a path to pop waves of balloons ("Bloons") before they reach the exit. The sixth entry in the Bloons Tower Defense series, it features 3D graphics viewed from a bird's-eye perspective and introduces Hero units that level up over time. Towers have three upgrade paths with a maximum of five tiers each, allowing for varied strategic builds. The game supports solo play and up to four-player co-op, and includes Boss Events, Paragon upgrades, and paid expansions adding roguelike and story-driven modes.

games.name: Building 0: Hakuei University
games.summary: I'm a second-year university student in a paranormal club facing disbandment. In a desperate bid for survival, I sneak into the mysterious "Building Zero" — a place campus whispers warn you never to approach. What awaited me there was a terror beyond anything I'd ever encountered.

games.name: BunnyBakery
games.summary: Play as a little bunny running a cute bakery — bake and sell all kinds of sweets like cupcakes, donuts, pancakes, banana splits, and more!

games.name: Clay&Cats
games.summary: You'll forget about the rest of the world with the most satisfying hobby - repairing cute cat pots!

games.name: Color-A-Cube
games.summary: Dive into a relaxing, color-filled escape with Color A Cube. This immersive coloring experience lets you explore and bring voxel worlds to life, one cube at a time. Unwind and tap into your creative flow as each brushstroke reveals vibrant, voxel-based environments and characters.

games.name: Console Archives: The Legend of Kage
games.summary: Hurry to the princess!

games.name: Cup Heroes
games.summary: A turn-based RPG with pachinko mechanics.

games.name: Dave the Diver: In the Jungle
games.summary: Dave the Diver: In the Jungle is a DLC expansion for Dave the Diver. It introduces a new jungle-themed environment where players can explore for exotic resources and face additional challenges, all while continuing to balance underwater exploration with restaurant management.

games.name: Dead End Escape
games.summary:
Crisis Point: How Will You Escape?
Solve Puzzles and Change Your Destiny!

games.name: Deep Drift Signal Below
games.summary: Dive into a beautiful yet deadly pixel deep sea and track unknown signals from the abyss. Manage oxygen, pressure, currents, and creatures while exploring. Capture life with a harpoon, find relics and chests, upgrade gear, and face hidden giants. The deeper you go, the greater the risk.

games.name: Dungeon Raze
games.summary: Here’s a fast-paced dungeon destruction shooter you can clear in as little as 30 minutes! Break walls for shortcuts, detours, or direct paths. Double ammo, halve reload time, and power up to smash through even the toughest walls!

games.name: Eggconsole Relics MSX2
games.summary: Seize enemy bodies to brave the mysteries of the deep! Featuring the unique "Spirit Ride" system and a cinematic sci-fi atmosphere, Bothtec’s legendary 1986 masterpiece remains a timeless action-adventure.

games.name: Eggconsole Zodiac PC-8801
games.summary: The blue crystal shines again. Set foot in the "Dester Slum" and challenge the unexplored. A boy, a robot, and a mission: Rescue Dr. Dumas.

games.name: Emoji Battlefield: Sky Massacre
games.summary: Fast-paced rogue-like FPS mayhem above the clouds!

games.name: Find the Cats
games.summary:
Discover adorable cats hidden across charming handcrafted scenes in Find the Cats! Explore colorful environments, sharpen your attention, and find every sneaky little kitty before moving to the next level.

Perfect for casual and cozy game fans, Find the Cats offers a relaxing experience with cute visuals, satisfying discoveries, and plenty of fluffy cats to uncover. Can you find them all?

games.name: Fool's Pub
games.summary:
Welcome to Fool’s Pub - The Online Multiplayer Card Game.

This isn’t just a card game – it’s an online multiplayer battle where up to four players compete in a high-stakes game of skill, luck, and survival. Outplay your friends or strangers from around the world and prove you’ve got what it takes to be the last one standing.

- First-Person Fun: Experience the game through the eyes of your character, bringing you closer to the action with every draw, bluff, and shot fired.
- Play Your Way: Jump online to challenge others or enjoy offline mode with clever AI opponents when you’re flying solo.
- Cute and Dangerous: Meet adorable characters packing serious heat – their charm hides a fierce determination to win at any cost.
- Rough Rules, Wild Rounds: With Russian roulette-style mechanics, every turn could spell glory or disaster. Will you take the risk or play it safe?
- Only One Wins: In this pub, there’s no second place. Outwit, outplay, and outlast everyone else to claim the ultimate victory.

Get ready for the perfect mix of strategy, adrenaline, and chaos.
Fool’s Pub is calling – are you brave enough to answer?

games.name: Forgotlings
games.summary: Award-winning cinematic narrative adventure set in a hand-drawn world of living forgotten objects. Lead Fig and the crew of the Volare through a story of identity, unity, and survival—where diplomacy, difficult choices, and moments of action shape the fate of five divided tribes.

games.name: Fortune Pact
games.summary: A cursed arcade machine. A demon's pact. A hidden exorcism buried in the code. Find the encrypted phrases. Speak them aloud. Save the souls — or be claimed by the darkness.

games.name: Furry Aim Trainer 2: Multiplayer Gooning
games.summary: Furry Aim Trainer 2 arrives with more advanced training and multiplayer support! With a massive selection of furry targets and so many weapons to train on, you can enhance your skills and your pleasure at the same time!

games.name: Girls Force 2: Rising Academy
games.summary: Cute, fearless and armed! The girls TPS is back with Toon rendering, cel-shading, and non-stop action. Second class, now in session!

games.name: Git Gud
games.summary: Git Gud is a fast-paced, 3D precision platformer designed for 1-4 players. If you love speedrunning, bunny hopping, and intense platforming challenges, this is your game.

games.name: Handsome Watching Face Memory Challenge
games.summary:
What colour was his tie again?
One glance is all you get.

games.name: Hentai Sexy Nurse
games.summary: an erotic anime game about a mysterious nurse. Solve puzzles, unlock hot scenes, earn achievements, and dive into a world of temptation and fantasy.

games.name: Hold The Line
games.summary: Hold The Line is a 4-player online co-op wave-based zombie shooter. Team up with friends to survive endless waves of the undead, defend your core, upgrade your weapons and barricades at the workbench, and hold the line as the horde grows deadlier with every wave. Featuring multiple enemy types, a wide arsenal of firearms, character customization, and a perk system.

games.name: Illustack
games.summary: Cyber psychedelic roguelike Tetris with exquisite micro-pixel art, multi-style polished BGM and level rotation. Stack to build your unique tower with rhythm.

games.name: Inversion: The Single Path
games.summary: A world in motion awaits.

games.name: Jurnal Risa: Dark Destiny
games.summary: Witness the resurrection of the forspoken nemesis of Jurnal Risa crew that was never told before. Unveil its dark destiny within this horror-adventure game. This is the tale of Jurnal Risa, as recounted to me by Risa herself.

games.name: Just. Press. The Button.
games.summary: Welcome to Enterprise Corp. We are pleased to have you. Your job is simple. You must press the button when the system instructs you to do so. The system will evaluate your punctuality, consistency, and ability to follow instructions.

games.name: Lumen.
games.summary:
lumen. is a puzzle game with unique mechanics, where you have to solve levels using lights, lenses and mirrors.

You will find yourself in the old attic and discover the mysterious antique box of Ms. Olivia McLumen, who lived in Scotland over a hundred years ago and was a great inventor of her time, she saved her inventions in cinematic frames for you to restore.

HUNDREDS OF WELL DESIGNED LEVELS

Use lights, lenses and mirrors to solve a variety of easy to hard levels. lumen. is family friendly and suitable for players of all ages and created by Lykke Studios who also brought you Apple Arcade hits like the puzzle 'tint.'

EASY TO LEARN, HARD TO MASTER

The game is easy to pick up and play at any time for either short or long sessions on any Apple device with cross functionality game saves.

BEAUTIFUL GRAPHICS, MUSIC & SOUND EFFECTS

Dive into the fascinating atmosphere of soothing piano and saxophone in a handcrafted 1800 box and enjoy all the small details carved herein.

games.name: Midnight Train
games.summary: You wake up alone on a mysterious subway train. Can you find the true story ? Solve puzzles and escape… before the thing in the shadows finds you.

games.name: Monster Boy and the Cursed Kingdom
games.summary:
A legendary game series returns with an all-new adventure! Monster Boy is a colourful side-scrolling action adventure created in cooperation with Ryuichi Nishizawa, the creator of the Wonder Boy Monster World series (Trademark of SEGA Corporation Japan).

Monster Boy is being created to bring back the enjoyment of classic games that shine by simplicity. Pure, exciting gameplay; upbeat music and smooth graphics. You'll need to overcome huge bosses, find hidden passages, discover powerful equipment and use all your wits and skills to remove a powerful curse. Monster Boy can transform into 5 different creatures, each with their own skills and abilities. Take advantage of all the unique powers to open new paths and advance in an epic story. Monster Boy is a love letter to gaming from the 80's and 90's - will you join us and celebrate together with us?

games.name: Motorhome: Traveling North America 4 - Collector's Edition
games.summary: Remember that feeling of wind in your hair and the endless road?

games.name: Need: No End
games.summary: Build and upgrade production loops, manage resources and workers, and expand your realm. Trade, adapt and survive hunger, pressure, decay, and threats in a tense, multi-layered strategy game where every choice matters.

games.name: Observer: System Redux
games.summary:
The year is 2084.
In a dark cyberpunk world shattered by plagues and wars, become a neural detective and hack into the minds of others.

Rebuilt and augmented for the next-generation, Observer: System Redux is the definitive vision of one of the most acclaimed cyberpunk stories in games.

games.name: One Tower Defense
games.summary: One Tower Defense is a Roguelike Tower Defense game where you control a single tower. Gather resources, buy weapons and upgrades, and fight endless waves of enemies. Play in single-player mode or in multiplayer mode, where the last survivor wins.

games.name: One in 20,000 Raindrops
games.summary: Satoshi Kuga, who led a lonely high school life, was dreading the school trip starting tomorrow because he had been assigned to the same group as the popular clique. However, it seemed there were hidden tensions even within the group that appeared to get along so well at first glance.

games.name: P.I.S. File
games.summary:
P.I.S.=Postal Inspection Service
This is a point-and-click puzzle game with no dialogue, actions, or combat elements.

games.name: Paparazzi
games.summary: Take sneaky pictures of the Stars, or find and eliminate the Paparazzis in this chaotic multiplayer game of stealth and social deduction.

games.name: Parking Garage Rally Circuit
games.summary: Retro Arcade-style Rally Racing in repurposed Parking Garages in big cities across North America with tight arcade racing controls. A hybrid of Rally and circuit racing, from rally it draws the jumps and “one racer at a time against the clock” time-trial format. However, the tracks are similar to circuit racing, with each race consisting of multiple laps around the same track.

games.name: Phantom Fools
games.summary: Phantom Fools is a co-op third-person action roguelike for 1-4 players as poltergeist ghosts. Possess objects and use their powers, find magic books and random upgrade cards, climb procedurally generated castle tiers, and escape the dungeon!

games.name: Phrase Passport Japan A Travel Japanese Quiz
games.summary:
Take a Japanese quiz on the go!
Practice signs, transport, food, and daily phrases
Build vocabulary in quick play sessions

games.name: Pip's Big Discovery
games.summary: An enchanting interactive storybook journey for young minds!

games.name: Pixel Art Coloring Book 2
games.summary: Unleash your creativity with Pixel Art Coloring Book 2! Color by number and bring stunning pixel masterpieces to life—from anime and unicorns to retro vibes and pop art! Relax, de-stress, and paint your way through hundreds of dazzling designs. Tap, color, and let the magic happen!

games.name: Pixel Cross Stitch Color by Number: Miniatures
games.summary: Tiny, cute, pixel!

games.name: Planet Divers
games.summary: Fire up your blasters and smash through any planet's defenses!

games.name: Plant Anywhere
games.summary: Plan your real garden, then grow a virtual one. A spatial garden planner fused with a pixel-art farming simulator — companion planting, succession scheduling, seed-starting, 120+ crops, and local frost-date data. Design beds, track harvests, run the sim, and earn 20 achievements.

games.name: R-Type Tactics I & II Cosmos
games.summary:
Outsmart and outgun your opponent in R-Type Tactics I • II Cosmos, the ultimate turn-based sci-fi strategy collection!

This two-game combination of the classic R-Type Tactics titles arrives on modern consoles for the first time, equipped with an armada of unique units to deploy across dozens of levels.

Multiple campaigns allow you to take on the Bydo Empire or even play as them yourself, while competitive online play lets you square off against others.

games.name: Re-Taped
games.summary: You must record your movements and play them back to progress. Use your recorded echoes to weigh down pressure plates, body-block lasers, and trigger springs to launch you across gaps. Master the timeline and complete all 30 time-bending levels.

games.name: Retrograde
games.summary: Retrograde is an arcade-style game set in space where players control a space ship and must avoid asteroids by shooting lasers. The objective is to achieve high scores by staying alive for as long as possible. With retro-inspired visuals and audio, the game combines skillful maneuvering, quick reflexes, and strategic decision-making to create an addictive and competitive experience.

games.name: Shy Dogs: Hidden Orchestra 2
games.summary: Shy Dogs Hidden Orchestra 2 is the sequel to the cozy hidden object game Shy Dogs Hidden Orchestra. This time, you must find not only the dogs, but also their instruments.

games.name: Soccer Kid Collection
games.summary:
Recover the Stolen World Cup Trophy in this Stylish 16-Bit Action Game!

When an alien collector destroys the World Cup, it’s up to a boy and his soccer ball to save the day. Soccer Kid is a classic platformer that swaps traditional combat for ball skills. Dribble through diverse landscapes, use headers to reach high places, and kick the ball to knock down anyone in your way.

Experience a piece of gaming history with the QUByte Classics edition, featuring two versions of the same game with new features to help you master the most challenging levels!

games.name: Space Dragons
games.summary: Space Dragons is a classic "shoot em up" horizontal shooting game, in which you can choose different ships with unique characteristics and abilities to destroy tons of invading aliens. During the adventure you will run into powerful bosses and explosive enemies. Get upgrades for your ship, weapons and much more to make your way through the meaty and bloody path that awaits you in Space Dragons.

games.name: Speed Dates: Summer Edition
games.summary: Summer's here and hearts are heating up! Meet five different beauties, hang out, flirt a little... and maybe even find your summer romance. Your choices matter — and the story's all yours.

games.name: Summer Seaside Search
games.summary: Summer Seaside Search is a relaxing spot the difference game that transforms sunny beach days into a fun test of observation. At first glance, each seaside scene looks picture perfect, with golden sands, rolling waves, and colorful umbrellas, but subtle differences are hidden throughout, waiting to be discovered.

games.name: Super Scram Kitty
games.summary: Stop the evil Nezu-Me corporation's plan for eternal domination!

games.name: The Adventures of Elliot: The Millennium Tales
games.summary:
The Adventures of Elliot: The Millennium Tales is an action RPG set in the world of Philabieldia - a beautiful but savage land dominated by warring beast tribes. Humanity’s last bastion is the Kingdom of Huther, protected by its tall walls and Princess Heuria’s powerful magic.

When a mysterious set of ruins is discovered, a young adventurer named Elliot and his fairy companion Faie are sent off on a journey to investigate. What seems like a simple, if dangerous, mission soon becomes a grand saga that will be woven across time and space.

games.name: The Escape to the Afterlife
games.summary: The Escape to the Afterlife is a horror game where the protagonist, who has passed away, searches for a path to the afterlife.

games.name: The Final Week
games.summary: Take command of the final place on earth that hasn't been complete destroyed. Gather survivors and save as many of them as you can by sending them into space to the base there. Remember you have 7 days

games.name: The Gate Must Stand
games.summary: Fend off brutal waves of demonic hordes as a mobile hero amongst your stationary allies. As the city’s last line of defense, recruit followers, unlock upgrades, and synergize skills to hold the line against apocalyptic bosses. Remember: heroes can fall, but the gate must stand.

games.name: The Lucky Acre
games.summary: The Lucky Acre is a cozy single-player farming board game about inheriting a broken farm and rebuilding it into a million-dollar estate. Roll dice around a seasonal board, plant crops, manage storage and debt, upgrade farm buildings, hire managers, study skills, buy enterprises, and survive market surprises.

games.name: The Name I Wear
games.summary: Play as a spy in a first-person narrative puzzle game. Writing a name allows you to take on that identity. Explore a riad, gather clues, and uncover the truth. With no pen at your disposal, creatively and unexpectedly use the environment to form names and change identities.

games.name: The Quiet Things
games.summary: An auto-biographical, narrative game, based on real diary entries kept as a teenager. The Quiet Things seeks to explore mental health issues with a raw but brave look at childhood abuse and trauma. With a deep focus on storytelling through audio, set foot in Alice’s world and hear her story.

games.name: The Tenth Minute
games.summary: The Tenth Minute is a short emotional visual novel about memory, regret, and the words people fail to say at the right moment. The game focuses on reading, character conversations, and quiet choices that affect how certain scenes unfold.

games.name: Thousand Floors
games.summary: Tower Climbers carry amber light; allies follow through misty pagodas in an endless Eastern tower. Thousands Floors blends side-view pixel art with hands-off combat—summon, upgrade, and let them climb. Grow via allies, floor lockdown, and relics.

games.name: To Bee Jazz
games.summary: Drop the Beat, Merge the Bees, and Build the Perfect Band

games.name: Tokyo Yakuza Idols: Save the Heart of a Rebel Boy
games.summary: He shines on stage and disappears into the night. No one gets close. No one lasts. Until you.

games.name: Tokyo Yakuza Idols: Save the Heart of a Rebel Girl
games.summary:
She performs under spotlights. She rules in the shadows.
And somehow, she chose to let you in.
Can you handle both sides of her?

games.name: True or False: The World
games.summary: "The Statue of Liberty is barefoot."← True or False!? Acquire global trivia with a 2-choice quiz!

games.name: Tumble Type
games.summary: A frantic word puzzle where letter tiles rise, the board falls, and golden keys must be rescued. Spell fast, trigger orb powers, chase combos, unlock achievements and earn high-scores.

games.name: Ultimate Wobble Run
games.summary: Run fast. Fall hard. Build the chaos. Get back up and reach the flag before everyone else!

games.name: UsoNatsu: The Summer Romance Bloomed From a Lie
games.summary: This is a story about finding love to overwrite the feelings for the one they held dearest. A girls love visual novel about summer, love and adolescence.

games.name: Wet Candy
games.summary: There's candy underwater, in the pool. Not so sweet... and definitely not for everyone.

games.name: With Your Coworker
games.summary: Meet Yumi, your adorable catgirl coworker. Whether you're working, gaming, or just spending time at your PC, she'll stay by your side throughout the day!

games.name: WordRaid
games.summary: WordRaid is a free online team-based word guessing game played in real time directly in your browser. One player gives a clue, the other tries to guess the word before time runs out, and whoever guesses correctly scores points.

games.name: You Are The Monster
games.summary: Ever wanted to be a giant monster rampaging through a city? Experience mindless chaos as you destroy all in your path, earning new abilities, new monsters and new ways to wreak havoc.

games.name: 100 Madagascar Cats
games.summary: Join the cutest adventure in themed locations full of cats! Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of special places and try to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game. ️‍Can you find them all? ️

games.name: 2026 Soup Jam
games.summary: Soup Jam is broken into two chapters Night 1 and Night 2. Explore the world, seek lore, collect the Gold Chalice and return it to the Temple.

games.name: A Good Deed On Harris Avenue
games.summary: Untangle a web of wants and wishes from the residents of Harris Avenue in this brief PSX-styled puzzle-adventure game. Bask in the piercing heat of a summer afternoon, explore an intricately hand-crafted environment, and discover what A Good Deed On Harris Avenue has to say.

games.name: Aerovice Frutiger World
games.summary: A relaxing exploration adventure inspired by Frutiger Aero. Wander through dreamcore worlds, backrooms, poolrooms, and liminal spaces, uncover secrets, collect treasures, and experience a nostalgic journey in vibrant 3D.

games.name: Alien Cat 2: Retro Collection
games.summary: Will this black alien cat save the universe?

games.name: Alisa’s Incident Report
games.summary: Nursing student Alisa takes on a part-time job ghosts to pay for tuition. By glimpsing the ghost’s past memories and providing compassionate nursing care, help them rest in peace! A medical and occult RPG made by a REAL NURSE!

games.name: Arcostate
games.summary: Arcostate is a turn-based sci-fi roguelike set on a post-post-cataclysmic Earth. Explore ruins, hostile wilderness, and the lands surrounding Aathman, the planet’s last surviving arcology, while uncovering the events that brought civilization to ruin. Create a character through attributes, skills, equipment, cybernetics, and psychic powers, then survive a persistent simulated world shaped by factions, scheduled NPCs, weather, aging, and emergent encounters. Fight, sneak, scavenge, craft, build a home, recruit companions, and travel through hand-authored and procedurally generated locations, including endless caves and a derelict monorail network. Choose between classic roguelike and roleplaying modes.

games.name: Armor of God
games.summary: A 2D pixel-art platformer where you choose which armor to wear. Full armor makes you invincible - anyone can win. Leave some behind and the game becomes a very different challenge.

games.name: Cave of Treats
games.summary: Live a spooky Halloween night as a skeleton dressed up as a mummy! Play a haunted old arcade game that, on Halloween night, can bring monsters out of the TV. Fight off waves of monsters trying to escape the game to steal all your candy!

games.name: Chill Fishing
games.summary: Chill Fishing is the ultimate laid-back desktop fishing experience!

games.name: Chopping Together
games.summary: A 1-4 player co-op, You are stuck in a forest alone or together with one goal to chop every tree in sight. Chop Trees, Gather Wood, Make Money And Upgrade Your Tools

games.name: ComboChain Pulse
games.summary: ComboChain Pulse is a fast-paced top-down survival shooter where every second matters. Build devastating combos, unlock powerful upgrades, and survive relentless waves of enemies across unique biomes.

games.name: Cornfield
games.summary: Death Hides in the Harvest!

games.name: Craft Drill
games.summary: Craft Drill - this mining simulator puts you in control of powerful drilling equipment, letting you explore mysterious mines and uncover hidden treasures.

games.name: Dave.exe
games.summary: Dave.EXE is a third-person low-poly stealth horror game loosely based off of the video game "Dead by Daylight", which the creator has a love-hate relationship with. You play as Dave Microwave, an everyman trying to live his life, until one day being pulled into warfare by the Berrys against Edgy Dave. You'll travel through timelines and collect soda from five machines while avoiding whichever of Edgy Dave's ranks is hunting you that round.

games.name: Defi's Devotion
games.summary:
Enter into a dark and ominous world has the form hand of an inspiring lich. The last step of your ritual is to claim your power and become immortal. With various powers at your disposal and more to claim, you will infect the living, corrupt their structures, and bring ruin to their world.
The folks of this land are guarded by a powerful Overseer who uses the simulated economy's output to summon heroes and protect the people. You must keep your phylactery safe while you feed it corpses and the very buildings they call home. Turn villagers to zombies, take direct control of them, and

games.name: Dino Pet Walker
games.summary: Dino Pet Walker is a Fantasy Casual Game where you realize your childhood dream and play with your dinosaur pet. On this adventure, be ready for solve puzzles and have fun with your and another dino's in a voxel art enviroment, inspired by brazillians biomes.

games.name: Dragon Kisser
games.summary: Left alone as your little villages last hope, you: Domingo, know what you must do to save your people and also pull a hot date, and that is to do what you know best: Romance the dragon attacking your home! Put your charisma to the test in this cheeky third-person soulslike boss battle!

games.name: Dungeon Bricker
games.summary: Dungeon Bricker is an intense and exciting maze game. It’s a unique and interesting title where your focus is to try to move the player from wall to all or corner to corner in order to create a path of bricks and complete the level. Once the level is full of bricks, you can reach the next level. There are more than 150 levels to go through, and you will have a lot of fun enjoying every moment, while also testing your skills. Do you have what it takes to complete all levels?

games.name: Fire: The First Dreamer
games.summary: Uncover ancient secrets, summon totemic magic, decode enigmatic messages, and explore the majestic Preseli mountains of Wales in this open world adventure inspired by a true story. Dare to embark on this journey and rediscover the lost secrets of a life lived with purpose and meaning!

games.name: Heroines Through My Lens
games.summary: Me? A lookbook shoot?! New hire Kim Jiwoo joins YouTube studio Lazaworks and gets thrown into photographing top youtubers and his own bosses on day one. Under the bright lights, stolen glances turn into secret favors and forbidden romances. The more you shoot, the more hearts stolen.

games.name: Illvelo Swamp
games.summary: The latest game in the Illvelo (Illimatic Envelope) STG Series, Developed by RS34. The game is noted for it's branching level structure and focus on surreal visuals.

games.name: Immunuzzle
games.summary: Defend the Body, Control the Chaos

games.name: Iron Guard: Day Zero
games.summary: RON GUARD: Day Zero is a sci-fi tower defense game made in the spirit of classic RTS games. Lives of the surviving crew members are in your hands. Find out why the terraformer robots have rebelled and help evacuate your crew from an unknown planet, where survival is the new frontier.

games.name: Is Today Another Day?
games.summary: Break the Routine. Escape the Room.

games.name: Just a Little Longer
games.summary: Just a Little Longer is a punishing top-down shooter with the staples of classic action horror games, with a brutal permadeath gambling twist: whenever you die in the recurring nightmare the game takes place in, your save file is instantly deleted

games.name: LenscraftCube
games.summary: LenscraftCube is a 2D platform puzzle game where players take on the role of a cube that must navigate through levels while being constrained by the boundaries of other camera cubes.

games.name: Mak Survival
games.summary:
Mak Survival is an open-world survival game where you play as a lone human survivor with a single mission:
Stay alive — and help evolve the world of Oratius, a land threatened by wild creatures and terrifying monsters.

games.name: Market Simulator: Miami Beach
games.summary: Build your supermarket empire in Miami Beach! Start in a tent, drive to pick up wholesale cargo, and physically stock shelves. Survive the street economy, use your family to gather extra cash, and expand to two stores in this realistic business management and life sim.

games.name: Maseylia: Echoes of the Past
games.summary: Maseylia : Echoes of the Past is a 3d metroidvania that aims to reproduce the experience of a 2d metroidvania in 3d. It features a labyrinthine world in which you'll need to collect upgrades to unlock new passages and make your way out of the labyrinth.

games.name: Monologin
games.summary: A directionless night-shift worker clings to a dying MMORPG, a legendary White Unicorn mount, and the belief that old games are more "real" in this short psychological horror visual novel about escapism and being left behind.

games.name: Offroad Craft Runner 4x4 Simulator
games.summary: Drive where others can’t!

games.name: Once Upon A Card
games.summary: Help a royal child find their way through their dreams! Use cards to build paths, create combos, and adapt your strategy as each run brings new challenges and bosses. Will you let the nightmares take over?

games.name: Rabbits Hunt
games.summary: “A perfectly balanced scare” that lets anyone get great reactions. A debut short horror game created by a streamer, designed for beginners and those who aren’t good with horror.

games.name: Real Car Parking Simulator
games.summary: Park like you mean it.

games.name: Reel Talk: A Thoughtful Fishcussion
games.summary: You feel lost, and a friend suggests to come fishing in the French River. He told you to not pay any attention to the fish, as they only want you to leave, but it's hard when their blabbering is so interesting...

games.name: Reloadian
games.summary: Reloadian is an action roguelike built around fast-paced combat. Combine legendary weapons and restore order to a chaotic universe—solo or with friends.

games.name: Retronaut
games.summary: A rogue star pilot lost between galaxies—upgrade your ship, harness ancient artifacts, and survive relentless alien hordes in this cosmic action roguelite.

games.name: Rose:Ruin
games.summary: Drawn into a spectral library within the Spirit World, the protagonist seeks a way to escape with guidance from Lisa, a woman trapped within. A horror adventure that uncovers the lingering emotions and hidden truths left behind in the Spirit World

games.name: Rumble Avenue
games.summary:
Rumble Avenue is a free browser-based multiplayer board game built for live community play sessions.

Buy properties, collect rent, make trades, and try to outlast the competition in fast, casual games with up to 6 players per room. During live events and playtests, players can join available game rooms as they open and fill.

No download, account, or payment is required — just open the game in your browser and play.

games.name: Sakura Moyu: As the Night's, Reincarnation
games.summary: A magical fantasy adventure that connects your thoughts and feelings across thousands of nights.

games.name: Sheeps
games.summary: Kill a sheep - Feed it to a tree - Listen to a poem. Sheeps is a poem-based adventure in a small open-world. Find 200+ poems contained within the sheeps roaming the world. As more poems are read, explore more of the world and interact with the characters from the poems.

games.name: Signal Pit
games.summary: A fast-paced monster arena roguelite where every beast has unique passive traits, active skills, and powerful overclock abilities. Build your mutation loadout, survive deadly fights, and evolve between runs.

games.name: Star Cosmic
games.summary: Star Cosmic is a minimalist 2D HTML5 arcade game where players control a spaceship navigating through a dense asteroid field. The objective is to survive as long as possible by dodging oncoming meteors using the keyboard arrow keys, with the game's speed increasing as the score rises.

games.name: Strays POV Tales
games.summary: A charming adventure from a cat's perspective.

games.name: Tales Beyond the Tomb: No Witnesses
games.summary: A psychological horror anthology inspired by disturbing real-life cases. In No Witnesses, a simple road trip turns into a brutal fight for survival when two sisters cross paths with a ruthless serial killer stalking the highways at night.

games.name: Tarot Spell
games.summary: A fast-paced typing survival game where every word becomes a Tarot spell.

games.name: Team Panic
games.summary: Team Panic is a cinematic online co-op psychological horror game where two players try to escape deadly creatures, solve puzzles, and uncover the truth behind a mysterious experiment.

games.name: Thank You For Your Application
games.summary: Thank You for Your Application is an interview game. You play as a recent graduate who joins the Aeropolis Group as a recruitment officer.

games.name: The Labyrinth on Burrow Hill
games.summary: Unravel a thread of riddles and mystery as you progress your way through the atmospheric halls of a dazzlingly large, long-deserted labyrinth. Explore the vistas of spectacular rooms and the hidden challenges within. Do you have what it takes to find what lies at the labyrinth's centre?

games.name: The Man Behind the Trigger
games.summary: Action-platform game set in the mid-2000s. Take vengeance upon six key figures of the entertainment industry for morally bankrupt the society you once loved.

games.name: Void Tech
games.summary: A story-driven sci-fi adventure where you repair satellites in Earth's orbit while unraveling corporate secrets. Navigate dangerous space debris, manage resources, and banter with mission control in a game packed with humor, mystery, and tough choices.

games.name: Cluck and Tag
games.summary: Catch roaming chickens across the map, deliver them, and rack up points! If you aren't Hunter, throw beach balls at rivals to make them drop their loot; if you are Hunter, focus solely on the chase. In this chaotic pursuit played against friends or smart bots, the highest score wins!

games.name: Definitely Not a Cult
games.summary: Build your “totally normal” community, upgrade your base, gather weird resources, recruit suspiciously calm members, and pretend the red flags are just decorative. Manage the chaos, unlock content, earn achievements, and do not ask why everyone keeps talking about pyramids.

games.name: Dropfinity
games.summary:
Relax and challenge your mind in Dropfinity: Merge Puzzle!

Drop numbered tiles onto the board, merge matching numbers, and create powerful combo chains to reach massive scores. Simple to learn but satisfying to master, Dropfinity offers a cozy and relaxing puzzle experience with smooth gameplay, colorful visuals, and rewarding merges.

games.name: LingoGrid
games.summary: LingoGrid is a modern six-letter word puzzle game that combines classic deduction gameplay with unique progression and customization features. Solve hidden words in six attempts, earn coins based on how quickly you find the answer, and spend them strategically on hints when you get stuck. Personalize the experience with customizable tile colors and Dark Mode support, or challenge friends locally using Play with Friends mode, where one player creates a secret word for another to solve. Designed for quick sessions and endless replayability, LingoGrid offers a fresh twist on the familiar word-guessing formula while rewarding both vocabulary and smart decision-making.

games.name: Matilda 2
games.summary:
The nightmare was never over.
It was only waiting.

games.name: Mob Marathon
games.summary:
Mob Marathon is a side-scrolling endless runner where Twitch
viewers help or hinder the runner in real-time. Featuring 25+
viewer commands, 9 transforming characters with unique special
abilities, online global leaderboards, boss encounters, and
chaos-driven gameplay designed for streamer-centric play.

Built solo by indie developer datsusara_aki, this game combines
classic auto-runner mechanics with a deep Twitch chat integration
layer. Viewers can heal, attack, gacha-bomb, or even spawn
themselves as co-runners alongside the streamer's character.

Released May 20, 2026 on Steam.

games.name: Nubert's Stand
games.summary: Nubert's Stand is a Deltarune fangame with a joke premise that takes place near the game's end. While the game's premise and involvement with the character Nubert is largely comedic, it also contains many headcannons from the creator, causing it to be much more serious and in-depth than most comedic or parody fangames.

games.name: Oni Station
games.summary: Oni Station is a horror game with roguelike and arcade elements where you pilot a train to outrun the creature chasing you. Carefully plan which stations to stop, search for resources and, above all, how far can you survive?

games.name: Peerless Beauty Detective: Alice
games.summary: A murder occurred at the Ai Qing Apartment. The female owner of Apartment 1802 died strangely. There was no struggle, no signs of a fight. Why did she die at night? Why wasn't the male owner at home? All the mysteries await the detective: Alice to solve. There is only one truth, let's find it!

games.name: Poem of the Starherd
games.summary: A relaxing farming simulation game where you take care of humanoid spirits in a mysterious world. Grow crops, raise spirits (animals), live together with someone you love, and enjoy fun-filled days with a variety of approaches!

games.name: Pokémon Nova
games.summary: An open-world widescreen fangame set in the Ultra Megalopolis from Pokémon Ultra Sun and Ultra Moon! Explore the Ultra Space in an adventure focused on story, puzzles, and exploration! Become a member of the Ultra Recon Squad and help recover the stolen light from Necrozma!

games.name: Quickscope King
games.summary: A fast arcade sniper challenge where every shot counts.

games.name: Reality Stability Office
games.summary: Reality is unstable, and information is distorted. As an auditor, you must identify anomalies using unreliable systems and conflicting data. But as you begin to lose your sanity, you’ll find yourself trying to control not just these anomalies, but yourself as well.

games.name: Shout-Ai
games.summary: This game contains psychological horror, unsettling dialogue, screen noise, blackouts, glitches, fake code logs, and effects that may appear as if something is happening on the player's PC. It does not contain gore, explicit sexual content, drug use, or realistic violence against real people.

games.name: Snake Coil: Puzzle Adventure
games.summary: A relaxing 3D puzzle game where you guide a cute forest snake that grows every move and must fill every tile on the grid.

games.name: Submerged Lights
games.summary: After traveling to a country town to move into the house he inherited, Andrew finds the town flooded. While wondering what to do, he spots a dim light coming from the flooded library, in the middle of the night. Investigating, he finds that it belongs to a small fairy, trapped inside of a lantern...

games.name: Summer Sisters
games.summary: It's been years since Yuu last visited the countryside, and this summer, he'll finally be reunited with the sisters Hana, Rina, and Hina! Unfortunately, his mom has to hurry home, so he'll be staying with the three of them for a while. Find out what fun awaits him in Japanese countryside!

games.name: Treasure Beach
games.summary: Scavenge the beach and run a cozy trinket shop by the sea! Find hidden treasures or trash, clean and repair your finds, put them up for sale, and upgrade your workshop. Dig deeper and faster to make more money and buy back the beach from the greedy hotel.

games.name: Two Types Pollos
games.summary: Co-op management and survival simulator. Run your chicken shop, serve customers, and decorate while manufacturing "sugar" in the back. Fulfill orders to get the medicine that keeps you alive. Cook, manage, and survive alone or with a friend in this intense double life.

games.name: Alfons World
games.summary: Collect magical creatures called "Papas" in a vast world, have them engage in battles, build structures, farm, and produce industrial goods. This is a brand new open-world survival crafting game.

games.name: Blik Ball
games.summary: 3D action in multiplayer or solo. Defeat your opponent in various modes, gain or lose points in direct duels. Blik Ball, a fast-paced 3D action game with lots of fast balls and two paddles.

games.name: Fast Food Funkin'
games.summary: Have some beats with yo' mickey dee double-cheese. A high-caloric Friday Night Funkin' parody game made for the annual Flash Forward Jam on Newgrounds

games.name: Fore! Crisis: Final Fantasy VII Jolf
games.summary: In this tactical RPG Golf game based on Final Fantasy VII, mix and match over 15 different "golfteria" to customize the properties of your golf clubs while competing across five different courses.

games.name: Idle Startup
games.summary: Build a tech company from a one-person garage into a global empire. Train six skills, complete their upgrade trees, chase milestone bonuses, and unlock new departments in this clean, addictive incremental idle game — progress keeps rolling even while you're away.

games.name: Mesozoic Dawn
games.summary: Mesozoic Dawn is a multiplayer online dinosaur survival game. Starting as a vulnerable juvenile dinosaur, you must navigate the perils of the prehistoric wilderness, utilizing the core "Growth + Nesting = Evolution" system to achieve leapfrog species iteration and evolution.

games.name: Noneworld
games.summary: NONEWORLD is a cute RPG set in a dying world. You are a Princess from another world, accompanied by an omnipresent Cheshire Cat. Only YOU and your fruity colored allies can LIGHT THE WORLD and return home safely.

games.name: Pitch & Pixel
games.summary: Battle through 30 years of digital agency history optimize sales & marketing, deliver projects, grow your team and outsmart your rivals. Fully simulated market and freely chosen path to success boutique with quality or agency group? You decide.

games.name: Playful Pursuit
games.summary: Playful Pursuit is a colorful 3D adventure platformer where you jump, climb, solve puzzles, battle goofy enemies, collect VHS tapes, and build friendships with allies in a silly High Desert quest to rescue Eddy’s stolen teddy bear.

games.name: Reborn: The Evil Being
games.summary: This is an open-world action-adventure game where you explore a stunning and vibrant fantasy world full of magic, mystery, and hidden danger. Play in either third-person or first-person as you battle monsters, uncover secrets, and grow stronger in your quest to find the truth behind your arrival.

games.name: Recursudoku
games.summary:
Ever wanted to play Sudoku but found it too predictable?

In Recursudoku, empty cells can hide entire Sudoku puzzles. Solve those inner boards to reveal numbers needed in the puzzle above. Keep diving deeper, uncovering clues, and working your way back up until the main board is complete.

With up to 10 nested layers of puzzles, Recursudoku adds a new twist to the classic Sudoku formula.

games.name: Skillwood
games.summary: Skillwood is a survival simulator highlighting resource foraging. Chop trees, mine stones, and skillfully level up your abilities to upgrade buildings with the gathered resources. Go through the continous progression by unlocking more areas and buildings

games.name: The Lighthouse
games.summary: A short horror game based in a lighthouse

games.name: The Question Rooms
games.summary: In The Question Rooms You Need To Answer Questions Before Moving On To The Other Rooms.

games.name: Trolley Time
games.summary: Cute animals shopping for groceries - what chaos could possibly ensure? Play solo or with up to three friends, engage in frantic action as you try to deliver as many groceries as possible within the time limit!

games.name: Veiled Vents
games.summary: Keep an ancient megabuilding alive and thriving with the help of Ventba! This game is a semi idle management game with roguelike mini dungeons.

games.name: Wizzerd Quest 2
games.summary: Time to save Evenfall Bay! Wizzerd Quest 2 is a first-person action RPG with full splitscreen co-op, from the developers behind the acclaimed freeware Wizzerd Quest. Liberate regions from the Rising Night in this charming retro adventure inspired by the greats of the late 90's and early 00s!

808 is a surreal and introspective first-person narrative experience about memories and feelings that we avoid. Memories define us—but what happens when they’re taken away? This is a game about love, loss, acceptance. A game about being a human.

games.name: Acatalepsy
games.summary: Welcome to Acatalepsy, a new take on the liminal space experience. Progress deeper into varying liminal spaces with your team. Complete various tasks to continue forward, dive deeper, and don't expect to survive for long. You aren't alone in these spaces; nowhere is safe.

games.name: Agraria
games.summary:
Agraria is a single-player farming simulation game in which players become a Shared Land Agricultural Engineer for Agraria Inc. Starting with a small plot of land, players cultivate crops, manage soil conditions, harvest produce, expand their farm, and develop increasingly efficient agricultural systems.

The game features seasonal crop planning, orchards, beekeeping, livestock, irrigation, fertilizers, market tracking, contracts, production recipes, and farm automation. Players can process goods through canning, dehydration, brewing, and factory systems while working toward higher ranks and larger plots within Agraria Inc.’s shared-land program.

Designed with an emphasis on farming and production management, Agraria focuses on planting, harvesting, upgrading, and optimizing the farm rather than social obligations or town-life schedules.

games.name: Ashes of Morgravia
games.summary: Ashes of Morgravia is a dark fantasy tactical deckbuilder where you move, strike, and adapt using dual decks to survive against necrotic horrors. Uncover lost divine secrets and fight for survival in a world swallowed by eternal night.

games.name: Atomic Bot: Survivor of Planets
games.summary: Collect all the weapons and free the planets from evil clones!

games.name: Backrooms Untold
games.summary: Backrooms Untold is an atmospheric horror experience where you’re lost in an endless, infinite maze of fluorescent lit corridors, stained carpet, and humming lights. The deeper you go, the more it feels wrong—familiar spaces twisting into something hostile and unknowable. 8 total levels on launch.

games.name: Battlefield Hardline
games.summary: Battlefield: Hardline features a whole new variety of gameplay that breaks away from the traditional Battlefield game modes. The new game modes are Heist Mode, Rescue Mode, Hotwire Mode and Bloodmoney Mode. The focus of the game has been shifted to police rather than the millitary background that has spanned the whole series up to now. Players will have access to various millitary grade weapons and vehicles as well as having police equipment such as tasers and handcuffs.

games.name: Besiege: The Broken Beyond
games.summary: Launch into the Broken Beyond expansion and conquer your way through a new space themed campaign, traveling between planets using a suite of exciting new blocks. Obliterate alien spacecraft, annihilate their armies and destroy their worlds..

games.name: Bingle Bingle
games.summary: Bingle Bingle is a 'Roulette Builder' game where you can create your own Roulette. Strategically combine various betting options and unique balls to create synergies, earn extreme scores, and beat the casino

games.name: Blackjack: Cheat the House!
games.summary: Blackjack: Cheat the House!! is a blackjack deck-building roguelike where you collect, buy, and upgrade "cheats" to beat the dealer. Create synergistic combos, trick the dealer, and fix the deck to get dealt cards that work with your most overpowered build and reach the goal of winning $1,000,000!

games.name: Café Manager
games.summary: Design your dream cafe, manage staff, serve a variety of coffees and desserts, and grow your business. Are you ready to brew your way to success?

games.name: Cozy Cleaner
games.summary: Cozy Cleaner is a relaxing cleaning game where you tidy and organize messy rooms. Pick up clutter, wipe away dirt, and bring order to every space for a calming, refreshing experience with cozy soundtracks.

games.name: Crazy Neighbour
games.summary: A psychological horror game set in a small post-Soviet town. You play as a troubled man, drowning himself in cheap beer while being pulled deeper into the shadows of his dark past.

games.name: Daiblos Core
games.summary: Daiblos Core is a chibi-Anime RPG that utilizes turn-based mecha girl combat. The player takes the role of the Captain of an alien exploration project, recruiting mecha girls in an effort to defend humanity from the various extraterrestrial threats.

games.name: Dark Scrolls
games.summary: Dark Scrolls is a fantasy-themed action platformer that fuses shmup-style chaos with roguelite progression and is packed with charm, challenge, and secrets.

games.name: Drunk or Baby
games.summary: A party game for 2–8 players where you decide: is it a drunk person… or a baby? Players read ridiculous scenarios and must guess whether they describe someone who's drunk or an actual baby. Designed for laughs, surprises, and unforgettable moments with friends.

games.name: Echowood
games.summary: Relax and enjoy the tranquility of Echowood, an adventure farming simulator. The game takes place in a world where humanity has been displaced by nature. Humans have harmed nature too much, and for that, nature has destroyed them. Since then, the world has become calm and peaceful.

games.name: Election Train
games.summary: A turn-based strategy card game where up to 4 players compete for votes across real-world maps. Play cards, control cities, dominate regions, and outsmart your rivals to win the election. 7 maps, 4 unique parties, and dynamic disaster events.

games.name: Elemental Magic Wars
games.summary: A hero-based 3D tower defense game featuring 9 elements, elemental reactions, RPG growth, gear drops, and thrilling battles. Command your heroes, build your defense, and face endless waves of elemental enemies.

games.name: Fish
games.summary:
You are a Fish.. with a GUN!
YOU must destroy EVERYTHING in your path.
Will you be able to survive being only... an armed Fish? or just be flapping around like a normal Fish..?

games.name: Forgive Me My Love
games.summary: A first-person psychological horror game about the crushing weight of guilt. Live through the aftermath of a devastating tragedy: your wife is dead, and its your fault. But when her casket is brought home, something inexplicable and terrifying begins to warp your reality...

games.name: Goo Deer
games.summary: Goo Deer is a dark, first-person gas station management game set in a foggy world addicted to the strange drink Goo Deer. Players craft and sell a variety of Goo Deer flavors, manage inventory, and hire employees to help run the store. To keep up with demand, players venture into the misty forest to hunt deer for ingredients while avoiding a dangerous creature lurking in the fog. Balancing resources, staff, and production, and failing to meet the cravings of a desperate public can have deadly consequences. Survive and expand in a strange, eerie world.

games.name: Greed and Greed
games.summary: Greed and Greed is the sequel for Greed and Grind. It's a game where your main goal is to become strongeeeer!! You can grind as much as you want!

games.name: Hero of Sunset
games.summary: Venture into this retro pixel art action-adventure with an open world. Explore, fight, solve puzzles, challenge bosses — and, most importantly, you can romance the cute girls!

games.name: Idle Chapel
games.summary: A dark-fantasy incremental game about confronting a rising cult. Seek out worshipers who turned to darker gods and smite them back to the light. Harness their devotion to grow stronger and purge the land of evil - one click at a time.

games.name: Jungle Defenders
games.summary: Get ready for a wild third-person action journey where nature strikes back! In this explosive roguelike bullet hell, you play as fearless animals sworn to protect their forest from a relentless technological threat: invading robots set on exploiting natural resources and destroying the environment.

games.name: Knight On The Moon
games.summary: This is a top down adventure game involving exploration, delving into dungeons, solving puzzles, and engaging in combat with various enemies. Players control a protagonist who must gather items, such as weapons, tools, and upgrades, to progress through increasingly challenging areas. Exploration and discovery are key, as players uncover hidden secrets, navigate mazes, and complete objectives to advance the story. This game is a balance of action, problem-solving.

games.name: Layer2
games.summary: Walk into walls, descend into spaces. A SOUP fan game made for SOUPJAM2026.

games.name: Leap of Legends
games.summary: Leap of Legends is an epic 2D platformer game where players compete as their favorite animal characters in thrilling PvP and PvE battles. Easy to learn, yet hard to master!

games.name: Machine of Madness
games.summary: A dark, atmospheric adventure inspired by classic storytelling, where you explore the eerie mansion of Dr. Jeffrey. Featuring hand-drawn visuals, gothic horror vibes.

games.name: Microwave Simulator
games.summary: An absurd sandbox where you put random objects in a oven and see what happens. Heat, melt, explode, or discover the unexpected.

games.name: Neofold
games.summary: The idle creature-collector where each pet is uniquely yours, generated live by your GPU. Hatch endless weirdos, adopt the ones you love, and grow a living sanctuary of species that exist only on your desktop.

games.name: Neon Planet
games.summary: Build a life on a neon-lit alien planet. Farm, fish, cook, craft, decorate your home. Mine 100 floors deep, climb a combat spire, win at the casino. Solo or with up to 24 friends in a player-driven economy.

games.name: Neon Pulsefire
games.summary: Create an endless variety of unique builds and decimate huge waves of enemies. Unlock unique classes, weapons, passives and stats to unlock even more overpowered builds as you weave your way through enemies, arena hazards and projectile assaults.

games.name: Neverwood
games.summary: You journey through the haunted forest of Neverwood in board game orchestrated by a dark and mysterious game master named Bella. The game blends grid based combat with deckbuilding roguelike mechanics in a dreary yet somewhat cozy Halloween themed atmosphere.

games.name: Orbital Physics Simulator
games.summary: Master physics in this hardcore orbital simulator where Einstein’s theories come to life. Plot trajectories and manipulate spacetime via general relativity, time dilation, and length contraction. Command your starship, outrun time, and explore a universe governed by real physics.

games.name: Paranormal Meatball Simulator
games.summary: An unhinged paranormal simulation of a spicy Turkish meatball stuck on a ceiling! Survive a 16-day cryptic loop filled with ghosts, reality-bending physics, and a cosmic UFO escape plan. After this, you will never throw food at your ceiling again!

games.name: Pawsome Resort
games.summary: Pawsome Resort is a cozy life sim with Co-op gameplay where you run an animal hotel in a charming pixel-art village. Design your resort, care for cute animals, grow crops, craft things, complete quests, and bond with villagers. With farming and RPG elements, it's a perfect cozy escape.

games.name: Plant Nursery Simulator
games.summary: Plant Nursery Simulator is a cozy management simulation game where you run your own plant shop. Stock shelves with a variety of plants, order supplies, hire and manage staff, and expand your nursery to attract more customers. Grow and nurture plants to keep your store thriving while balancing costs and profits. With stylized visuals and a relaxing atmosphere, the game offers a wholesome experience for players who enjoy strategic planning and creative shop management.

games.name: Plus/Minus Zero
games.summary: As a research android, complete your mission of living a normal student life in this bittersweet slice of life visual novel. Record new experiences, revel in mundanity, and be a strange machine and a strange person.

games.name: Ramen Simulator
games.summary: Ever dreamed of crafting the perfect bowl of ramen? In Ramen Simulator, you can unleash your creativity and build your own unique ramen style!

games.name: Reflection Arena
games.summary: A shooting action game set in a closed arena where reflecting projectiles fly. Test your limits in evasion and interception.

games.name: Sand: Raiders Of Sophie
games.summary: In an alternate 1910, scavenge the sands of Sophie in towering Tramplers. Build your highly customizable walking base. Squad up or go solo. Gather loot, weapons, precious artifacts. Clash with other players in a brutal procedurally generated desert forged by history and chaos.

games.name: Scales of Silence
games.summary:
Clear the couch for co-op snake. A local party game where length is your life: up to 8 players on one shared screen for PvP battles, plus a 2-player co-op campaign.

Every hit costs you tail. Stay longer than your opponent, grind them down to nothing, and rack up +3 points per takedown. Shrink your friends before they shrink you.

Beneath it all runs an ancient war between serpents, and a living darkness feeding on the conflict. The campaign crosses ten biomes that change the rules: forests choke your sightlines, frozen wastes starve you, swamps poison most of your food, volcanoes stay in permanent darkness. Yes, this is a snake game. It just has more to say.

games.name: Sineus Arena Survivors
games.summary: Power up heroes in co-op or solo as you battle endless hordes in a roguelite bullet hell base-building run. Build a shared stronghold, face the final boss, and see how long you survive!

games.name: Slimecity
games.summary:
Slimecity is a colorful swarm-control roguelite about leading a cheerful little slime family through a bright, bouncy world.

Start each run with a tiny group of adorable slimes and guide them around the city with your cursor. Your slimes wiggle, wobble, and work together as a growing swarm, collecting goobies, exploring new areas, overrunning buildings, and bumping into silly enemies along the way.

Between runs, return to your cozy cave to bank your resources and unlock permanent upgrades. Grow your slime group from a few tiny blobs into a big, playful crowd. Upgrade your starting slime count, carrying capacity, vision, influence range, speed, health, damage, and more through a visual underground skill tree.

Each run lets you push a little farther, discover new enemy spots, collect more resources, and make your slime swarm even cuter, stronger, and more chaotic.

games.name: Space Grunts: Chrono Shard
games.summary: You have an X amount of turns before all hell breaks loose. Gain experience and new items to find ways to prolong the inevitable while you complete missions on board of space ships, moon bases and other mysterious areas in space. One step at a time in this fast paced but turn based roguelike.

games.name: Stompy's Big Adventure
games.summary: A big-eared dinosaur’s big adventure! Help Stompy save his herd in this heartwarming interactive story.

games.name: The Drifter
games.summary: The Drifter is a point-and-click adventure in the classic style. Taking cues from the second wave of the genre, there's an emphasis on story, with puzzle-solving being the glue that ties it together rather than the focus. Mick's a pretty practical guy, and so puzzles are down-to-earth, designed to be unobtrusive and give an investigative feel. The pacing is quick and lean, and you'll never be wandering around lost for long periods. Mick is propelled through the story at a good clip from one situation to another, with barely a moment to catch his breath.

games.name: Upward
games.summary: Try to stay alive for as long as possible, by avoiding various enemies and obstacles while collecting as many apples as your heart desires. Play against friends, unlock cool cosmetics or achieve a new high score. The choice is up to you.

games.name: Veil of Mist
games.summary: Veil of Mist is a first-person atmospheric horror adventure set in a shifting, logic-defying afterlife. Stay hidden from a deadly, perceptive entity, explore an ever-changing world, piece together fragmented memories, and face moral choices that shape your fate.

games.name: Veil: Project Conductor
games.summary: The train derails in an abandoned tunnel.No signal, no exits — only darkness and the broken remains of the carriage.You are an undercover journalist, and you had a reason to be on this train.

games.name: Where Stones Sleep
games.summary: A cozy, single-screen puzzle platformer focused on planning, experimentation, and clear cause-and-effect, with no combat or time pressure.

games.name: A Game About AI
games.summary: Build the machine that consumes the world. Expand your AI infrastructure, drain resources, and destabilize humanity as systems spiral into collapse, water runs dry, wars ignite, and nothing can stop what you've set in motion.

games.name: Amitabha Buddha
games.summary: Amitabha Buddha is an action role-playing game set against the backdrop of Buddhist teachings. Players embody a Bodhisattva on a journey to redeem the fierce souls trapped in the borderlands, embarking on a path through the joys and sorrows of the Saha world.

games.name: Ancient Adventure
games.summary: Evil has taken over the world. Equip your Weapon of Choice and venture forth. Journey out into the world to avenge your predecessors. Survive the hordes of monsters, seek out to extinguish the source of all Evil, so that one day, your people may finally live in peace.

games.name: Bedtime Nightmare
games.summary: In Bedtime Nightmare, you play as a kid who must finish all your tasks before going to sleep. But something is lurking in the dark areas of your house, so remember to always stay in the light.

games.name: Beggar's Road
games.summary: A darkly comic medieval roguelike where you travel between towns, recruit desperate companions, and survive strange encounters through difficult choices, scarce resources, and shifting alliances with bishops, merchants, and bandits.

games.name: Bit
games.summary: In Bit, you play as Bit. A little pixel alone in the void. Bit has the urge to climb. Why does he want to climb? Find out with him across 10 unique worlds and help him find his purpose.

games.name: Botmare
games.summary: BOTMARE is a hardcore Lovecraftian FPS. Survive timed challenges alone or with friends via split-screen & Steam Remote Play. Collect tokens, activate relics, escort allies and battle vicious monsters and bosses. Master diverse weapons and realistic ballistics in this ever-dangerous nightmare realm.

games.name: Bug Drop
games.summary: A top down action roguelite game with auto firing weapons, level up increasing diffrerent stats, equip up to six weapons and upgrade your build with hundreds of abilities. Fight against swarms of alien bug invaders including bosses.

games.name: Bulletreign: Survivors
games.summary: Top-down military bullet hell survivor. Drive armored vehicles behind enemy lines, rescue prisoners, fuse devastating weapons, and push forward. 25 weapons, 9 fusions, 6 crew members. Every run is a new offensive.

games.name: Busy Bar: World Tour
games.summary:
Serve drinks, survive ridiculous guests, upgrade your bars, and buy out rival moguls — solo or in co-op — in a chill bar empire game where every shift ends in progress.

Survive Ridiculous Guests
Your customers are more than walking orders.

games.name: Caravan Village: Farming Life
games.summary: Turn a scam into an empire! In Caravan Village, farm crops, raise animals, mine for resources, and renovate abandoned caravans into luxury suites. Recover your grandma's lost cookbook, cook delicious meals, and charm your guests in this open-ended life RPG. Create your own vacation paradise!

games.name: Cart by Cart
games.summary: Run your own cozy supermarket. Buy shelves and products, stock your store, open for customers, and scan items at checkout. Handle cash or card payments, give correct change and grow your business day by day.

games.name: Cats' World
games.summary: Inspired by PokeRouge, this game, Cats' World, adopts a retro visual effect similar to Snes Mode7, combines the framework of traditional turn-based games, and focuses on team development through automated battle and treasure grinding.

games.name: Chessillo
games.summary: A roguelike deck-building tactical game fused with chess. Choose a cursed Prince, collect pieces with magical abilities, and conquer three acts of boss encounters where the board itself fights against you.

games.name: Chrono CCG
games.summary: A digital collectible card game involving a war between rival time-traveling syndicates over the fate of history. Built by CCG veterans, incorporating favorite mechanics from a variety of beloved games as well as some new twists like Divers, Timeline Shifting, and Immortalization. Crowdfunded in 2024. Built for the CCG community, by the CCG community.

games.name: Clank-Robotics
games.summary: Build your own robot. Program your robots AI in the Visual Scripting logic editor. Compete against other people's robots in the ranked arena. Build the strongest and smartest robot and win.

games.name: Code Tycoon
games.summary: Code Tycoon is a tycoon simulation that traces the history of software development across four decades. Starting in 1980 with nothing but a computer and a garage, players build their own software company by taking on client projects, managing deadlines, hunting down bugs, and delivering working code on time and within budget. The game features over 20 historically authentic programming languages - from early pioneers like BASIC, Assembler, and COBOL to modern staples like Python - each with distinct strengths, weaknesses, and real-world applications. As the company grows, players hire programmers, upgrade their office, and navigate an evolving technology landscape with increasingly complex projects. Code Tycoon combines economic strategy with a deep appreciation for the history of programming.

games.name: Condemned to Clean
games.summary: You are a cleaner not by choice, but by necessity. A single-player eco-activist simulator that aims to bring life back to an old beach in a provincial town. Explore abandoned embankments and courtyards, collect rubbish, sort resources, and uncover the history of this forgotten place.

games.name: County Hospital Outbreak
games.summary: Co-op or solo sci-fi horror. Purge a biological outbreak with flamethrowers & grenades. Explore infested zones, grab keycards & stuff, then trigger the protocol to burn the Mother Organism. Team up. Erase the threat

games.name: Crazy Fruit Shooter
games.summary: One day you wake up and find yourself turned into a Fruitman? Face the endless waves of vegetables chasing you, grab your gun, and blast them away!

games.name: Dark Age Gladiator
games.summary: Dark Age Gladiator is a dark fantasy world where you live as a gladiator fighting in the arena for wealth and fame. The opponents are not limited to humans, but also include a variety of monsters.

games.name: Darkstone Restoration
games.summary: Darkstone Restoration brings the classic action RPG back to modern PCs with improved stability, compatibility, controls, readability, and quality-of-life improvements — while preserving the spirit of the original game.

games.name: Dart Racer
games.summary: Dart Racer is an immersive VR arcade racing game set in a futuristic galaxy obsessed with speed. Master the intuitive controls, fine-tune your dart, and compete in thrilling races across a variety of strange environments.

games.name: Dave's Word Game
games.summary: Dave's Word Game (known as DWG by fans) is an important new daily word game, where you must strategically use your best words to maximise your score every day.

games.name: Dawn Bell
games.summary: She wakes up in a mysterious castle. "Dawn Bell" is a side-scrolling 2D horror adventure where a girl with no memory explores the castle. Use items and clues to solve puzzles and uncover her lost past. Your choices shape the story's multiple endings. What truth awaits beyond the doors of memory?

games.name: Day Ticket
games.summary:
Day Ticket is a carp focused fishing game for Playdate.

Choose a venue, cast your line, watch the water, and strike when the reel runs. Once hooked, each fish becomes a hands-on fight: use the crank and buttons to manage tension, give line, tire the fish, and land it without snapping.

Earn coins from catches, upgrade your tackle, and unlock tougher waters as you build your carp fishing setup. Weather, wind, lake beds, bait, and gear all affect how a session plays out.

A full playable tutorial teaches the flow step by step, from casting and striking to fighting, netting, using the tackle shop, and saving your game.

Calm, compact, and skill-based, Day Ticket is made for players who like fishing games with patience, pressure, and progression.

games.name: Deadwave
games.summary:
Deadwave is a classic stylized third-person shooter with Ancient themed maps. Built by a solo indie developer, it drops you into striking locations from Egyptian sands to crumbling temples, where every fight turns into a desperate, chaotic last stand.

Along the Zombie game mode also resides typical multiplayer modes. In these Prop-Hunt shines with amazing party gameplay but if you want to get competitve, you can 1v1 your friend, play free-for-all or team deathmatch.

games.name: Deer & Boy
games.summary: A Cinematic Platformer who you follow the journey of a boy who, during his flight will meet an unexpected companion. Together they will overcome many obstacles that will change their lives forever.

games.name: Defracted
games.summary: Defracted - The world is set in a fictional sci-fi realm where 2 teams are at war with each other over prosperity in a virtual reality game created by an alien civilization.

games.name: Deliverage
games.summary: Deliverage is a hardcore open-world PvP delivery game where every shipment is a gamble. Fight other players for valuable cargo, repair and modify fragile vehicles, outplay rivals in a shifting economy, and climb from nothing to the top of a ruthless world.

games.name: Destroy All Humans!
games.summary:
A remake of Destroy All Humans!, an action-adventure video game that stands as the inaugural entry in the Destroy All Humans! franchise. It unfolds in 1959 in the United States. The game satirises the lifestyles, pop culture, and political attitudes of that era. Players take on the role of Cryptosporidium 137, a member of the fictional alien race known as "Furons." Functioning as a Furon spy hitman, Cryptosporidium 137 invades Earth with the mission of harvesting human DNA to sustain the cloning process for his species.

The remake features new missions, control schemes, upgrades, skins, abilities, and graphical enhancements.

games.name: Devil May Cry 5
games.summary: Devil May Cry 5 is a brand-new entry in the legendary over-the-top action series Devil May Cry. The game features three playable characters, each with a radically different stylish combat play style as they take on the city overrun with demons. Developed with Capcom’s in-house proprietary RE engine, the series continues to achieve new heights in fidelity with graphics that utilize photorealistic character designs and stunning lighting and environmental effects.

games.name: Digital Anima: Virtual Lifeform Care Kit
games.summary: Digital Anima: Electronic Life Form Raising Kit is a psychological desktop invasion horror game where you raise a virtual pet on your own computer. Raise a Digima inside a tiny window on your desktop and watch the conspiracy behind its evolution and the truth about its developer slowly unravel.

games.name: Dimhaven: The Lost Source
games.summary: After several years, the team behind Quern - Undying Thoughts is back with new mysteries to unfold. Explore Dimhaven, solve mind-bending puzzles and uncover the truth behind the Ravenwood legacy in this first-person adventure.

games.name: Disc Golf Masters
games.summary: Step onto the course in Disc Golf Masters, the most realistic disc golf game ever. Featuring the world’s top athletes, throw real-world discs on authentic courses. Start your pro career, refine your skills, and push the limits of the sport in the world's first true disc golf game!

games.name: Doodle Dice Monsters
games.summary: Doodle Dice Monsters is strategic turn-based battling game where you draw your own characters! Form your six character dream team, then duel in tag-team combat: the winner not only gets epic loot, but gets to take one of the defeated Doodlemon for their own!

games.name: Echoes of Above
games.summary: Echoes of Above is an action game where you strike back — literally. Hit enemy projectiles mid-air, deflect their force and use the environment to survive. Master precision combat across two difficulty modes in a mythical world abandoned by the gods. Every shot fired at you is a weapon waiting to be reclaimed.

games.name: Endless Defense
games.summary: Endless Defense is a roguelite sci-fi tower defense game where every run becomes a new build. Place turrets, choose traits, draw upgrade cards, use special tiles, and evolve your defense to survive endless waves of enemies, elites, and bosses.

games.name: Enter the Depths
games.summary: Enter the Depths is a minimalistic dice-building roguelike. Customize your dice, collect powerful relics, and battle through an ever-shifting dungeon to confront the Void.

games.name: FlipRide Rush
games.summary: Race through futuristic tracks and defy gravity in this fast-paced 3D bike racing game template.

games.name: Frog Climb
games.summary: Free-To-Play Stop following someone else's route. Create your own way to the top by building your own path Frog Climb is a stylized co-op climbing adventure where you must escape from terrariums Level up, gain powerful upgrades, and prove that no wall is too high for a frog with a plan
