games.summary: A Roguelike survivor-style action game of elemental mastery. Harness eight core elements, survive endless demon hordes, and join up to 4 players in co-op to unleash ancient formulas—embark on an epic journey to revive the lost glory of magic!

games.name: Maneuver Warfare 2: BTG
games.summary: A simulation of the 2022 Russo-Ukrainian War where the player maneuvers battalion tactical groups on a map and controls assets such as aircraft, special forces teams, satellites, field hospitals, and repair facilities to support these. The player can play single battles or a campaign game.

games.name: Mars Base Alley
games.summary: Mars Base Alley is a cozy city-builder about creating the perfect little corner of humanity on the red planet—one alley at a time.

games.name: May the Cards Lay Out a Straight
games.summary: Jack, a winning gambler, is trapped at the gambling table by his angry boss's magic spell. He is horrified to find the dice rushing towards him. Only by gripping his playing cards tightly and shattering all the incoming dice can he hope to escape the table alive.

games.name: MegaBattle
games.summary: Build robots and enter the arena to battle! Robots have taken control of the galaxy and now humans must build bots to fight in the MegaBattle Arena. MegaBattle combines the best of the CCG with innovative mechanics such as unique mana mode, opponent reading attack and a fast card draw system.

games.name: Melancholy Lake: Camocipher12 Shorts
games.summary: A surreal, abstract kinetic visual novel in which two girls go on a date in the middle of a broken world, using down-to-earth intimacy to survive the deteriorating nature and reality surrounding them.

games.name: MeowRig
games.summary: MeowRig is a mining-themed incremental game. Follow Me(ow) and search for Meow God's great treasure.

games.name: Milo
games.summary: Survive an onslaught of cult adherents that worship a mysterious beverage

games.name: Ming Dynasty: Cards & Court
games.summary: Mandarin Spin: Dynasty's Fate​ combines card strategy with slot-machine thrills for a unique take on Ming Dynasty power struggles. Each card pull is a high-stakes gamble of wealth and prestige—a strategic choice between life and death. Pay taxes, climb the ranks, rewrite history.

games.name: Mirage
games.summary:
Mirage is a desert-survival card game about the lone survivor of a helicopter tour crash. By day, searching the wreck costs water and draws supply cards; salvage feeds a transparent crafting system that builds fires, shade tarps, spears, solar stills, and a distress beacon. By night, hazard cards resolve against the player’s defenses, and a failing body draws delirium cards that distort the run.

Six playable survivors each carry a distinct strategy, and four difficulty modes range from a forgiving slope to an endless endurance mode with per-survivor high scores. The goal is to hold on until the extraction card arrives, or build the beacon and pull it forward.

games.name: Mobile Phone Shop Simulator
games.summary: Build and manage your own mobile phone shop! Buy, sell and expand your business in this detailed simulation game. Balance profits, manage your team, and become the best shop in town.

games.name: Mongol 2
games.summary: Call me Mongol! Some time ago, I ventured into Agrippa's perilous realm to claim the false god's life. Armed with an arsenal of weird weapons given onto me by Mithrithnogg, the prophet of worms, I uncovered a dark truth that shook the very foundation of reality!

games.name: Monopoly: Star Wars Heroes vs. Villains
games.summary: A dynamic team-based twist on the world’s favorite family board game from Hasbro, Monopoly: Star Wars Heroes vs. Villains offers reimagined gameplay with cinematic moments, themed spaces, and dynamic elements so that no two matches are the same. Build teams with iconic Star Wars heroes and villains, each of whom brings unique abilities that can shape strategy and turn the tide in your favor with every roll of the dice. Teamwork and hero combinations play a pivotal role in securing victory.

games.name: Murky Divers
games.summary: Co-op diving horror. Eliminate all traces of your employer's failed experiments from their abandoned underwater labs. Navigate your submarine, dive down with your crew, remove all corpses, but watch out for the abyssal terrors lurking.

games.name: MythBeasts
games.summary: Welcome to the world of Mythbeasts, an ambitious creature collection RPG that I'm developing completely solo as an autistic indie developer. Explore this huge world with endless progression and leveling for your mythbeasts

games.name: Narco Check
games.summary: Revive an abandoned airport in 2000s Colombia. Verify documents, stop smuggling with X-ray scans, and upgrade your terminal. Will you stay a loyal officer or collaborate with the cartels to rot the system from within? Every stamp and every bribe leads you either to justice or to a dark fortune.

games.name: NebulArena
games.summary:
Nebularena immerses you in futuristic PvP battles on space platforms, completely automated through your strategy. You will create the ultimate ship that will confront the constructions of other players in deathmatches where anything goes...

Build, customize, and unleash your ultimate space platform in NebulArena, a fast-paced, fully automated PvP arena where strategy, design, and destruction collide!

games.name: Neighbor Master
games.summary: Your neighbor just bought a SPORTS CAR. You? You're broke. But you have a shovel and a backyard full of... opportunity. Dig, melt, and bottle snow to build a "Premium Glacier Water" empire. Send in the drones, upgrade your gear, and save up for a ride that will make his car look like a cheap toy.

games.name: Neo Capitalist: Stock Market Survival Simulator
games.summary: Trade by day. Eat, sleep, and survive by night. Lose everything with a single bad decision. Neo Capitalist is a financial survival roguelite where the richer you get, the harder the system fights back. Play in a realistic stock market simulation or in a dystopian cyber-punk world.

games.name: Neo Ha_Bits
games.summary: Neo Ha_Bits plunges players into a chilling journey of psychological horror and mystery within a cyberpunk setting.

games.name: Newbie: Become a Skateboarder
games.summary: The interactive skate video! Free roam, pick a spot, set up your camera and try to ollie that stairset with the fully physics-driven board. Always-active ragdoll reacts to everything organically—no animations—making every moment unique! All you, realism first, and absolutely no hand-holding.

games.name: Night Club Simulator: Party King
games.summary: Step into the vibrant world of nightlife! Create, manage & customize your own nightclub, solo or co-op. From hiring staff and organizing events to setting the perfect atmosphere with music & lighting, every choice you make will shape your club. Are you ready to become the ultimate nightclub tycoon?

games.name: Nocturnal II
games.summary: Nocturnal 2 is an action-adventure game that lets you explore and rekindle the dark depths and towering heights of the city of Ytash.

games.name: Nocturnal Visitors: Book One
games.summary: Discover a world where magic and science, chaos and order, are two sides of the same coin.

games.name: Norse: Oath of Blood
games.summary:
Norse is a turn-based tactics and combat game for PC and console. Set against the rich backdrop of the Viking Age, join Gunnar, a young warrior, on a relentless quest for revenge across the rugged landscapes of Norway.

Build a thriving settlement, govern your community, forge alliances, grow strong, and win the favour of the gods. For this is a time when legends are forged in the fires of conflict, and only the brave are remembered.

Written by prize-winning and Sunday Times bestselling author Giles Kristian, Norse is set in a fully realised historical world, driven by a compelling narrative and brimming with memorable characters.

games.name: Not Only Nine
games.summary: A narrative turn-based RPG where the only fights are the bosses. Play as a cat and journey through the afterlife to save your human. Meet loveable characters and explore what it means to exist.

games.name: ODEZZA
games.summary: Chess meets Poker. A high-stakes game where chess battles and poker hands decide your fate. Capture pieces, build hands, and bet your way through the Odysseys.

games.name: Oblivion Maiden
games.summary: An exploration adventure set in St. Dorothia Academy, a magical educational institution hidden deep within a forest. A story that begins with an encounter with a girl named Lulunya, and unfolds through mysterious phenomena and dream worlds.

games.name: Oddli: A Satisfying Game
games.summary: ODDLI is a casual puzzle game about creating satisfying loops. Solve moving puzzles where the only obstacle is your past self. Reach the goal with your character, avoid your previous movements and watch it repeat your path. Continue reaching goals, while creating mesmerizing choreographies!

games.name: Ogora
games.summary: Ogora is a fantasy roguelike deck-builder where you will craft powerful decks, cast unwieldy spells, and blow up your own path through a procedurally generated dungeon. Adorn yourself with hidden trinkets and try to survive!

games.name: One Fenix Down
games.summary: A retro-inspired, classic turn-based RPG for those with nostalgia for the '90s golden era. Explore a vast world with 14 playable characters, fight hundreds of unique enemies, and delve into an epic story of war, betrayal, and redemption.

games.name: Operation Highjump: The Fall of Berlin
games.summary: In the last days of World War II, lead a suicide mission to hunt down the enemy leaders, steal their experimental technology and recover the art pieces and relics. A combination of frenetic action, tactical missions and an explosive run & gun platforming adventure.

games.name: Operation Zero
games.summary: Grab your biggest gun and jump into this story-driven top-down run-and-gun sci-fi arcade shooter starring the ultimate bio-engineered hero-manchild TASKILLER!

games.name: Orbital Chaos
games.summary: A physics-based bullet hell that's all about gravity - with you as the center of it!

games.name: Orbital Traffic Controller
games.summary: Orbital Traffic Controller is a sci-fi spaceship management game set in the Solar System. Become an interstellar traffic controller, directing vessels from planetary holding patterns and warp gates to atmospheric reentry, all while avoiding collisions with other spacecraft and planetary bodies.

games.name: Outside
games.summary: Dares reality game show — with cameras, neighbors, and escalation. Your friends dare you. Then lie, sabotage, and bet on your failure. Fail a dare and you’re sent OUTSIDE — escalating into strangers, neighbors, or real-world dares on camera (optional, phone supported).

games.name: Overtype
games.summary: Overtype is a roguelike typing action game set in a neon-drenched post-apocalypse. Type to fight, dodge, and survive against waves of cyborgs and corrupted machines. Every keystroke is your weapon master speed and precision to uncover Zyra’s legacy and type out humanity’s last hope.

games.name: Pair-A-Dice
games.summary: Decide your fate with a game of Pair-A-Dice. A strategic fight to relinquish your cards with dice that match, while Navigating a strange world with even stranger inhabitants. Despite what they claim, no one seems to play fair. Will you?

games.name: Panic Files: Buried Sanity
games.summary: Your first day at the local mine got a hell of a twist when the tunnels caved in. Can you escape when the only way out is going deeper? Avoid the deadly creatures, push through hallucinations and remember: Don't panic.

games.name: Paunchy Pets
games.summary: Paunchy Pets are your chubby little monsters that love to battle almost as much as they love to eat. Train them in flash-style mini-games, Feed them junk food in a cozy farming sim, Battle opponent’s pets in an autobattler based on skill, and Breed rare Paunchies to bolster your roster.

games.name: Pearls of Wisdom
games.summary: A rogue-like mindfulness deck builder with real-world side quests. The game involves matching quotes, using power-ups ('emblems'), and undertaking mindfulness tasks to increase the score.

games.name: Peglotto!
games.summary: PegLotto! is a roguelike that combines slots, pachinko, and deck-building. Pick your items, place them on the board, and pray that luck is on your side! Sit back, enjoy the view from the train window, and ride the waves of fortune!

games.name: Perihelion: Rogue Orbit
games.summary: Fit a ship, read the angle, and null your transversal for the high-alpha hit. Perihelion: Rogue Orbit is a 2D space combat roguelite about range control, tracking, and making your build work under pressure.

games.name: Perpetual Fear
games.summary: Embark on a mind-bending journey in a 3D first-person horror game that plunges you into the disorienting depths of an ever-shifting house. Trapped in an endless loop, you must navigate through bizarre rooms and find the anomalies. Can you spot the difference?

games.name: PiPu Party
games.summary: PiPu Party is a chaotic party puzzle-platformer game with a shared 3-slot symbol backpack. Pick and put symbols to alter the level. Co-op or outsmart your friends.

games.name: Pick Me Chance
games.summary: Pick Me Chance is an idle action RPG where players summon doll companions from an old capsule toy machine and explore a fantasy world. The game features automatic battles, offline progression, team building, farming dungeons, boss battles, PvP rankings, and collectible costumes.

games.name: Pionero Capital
games.summary: Pionero Capital is a sandbox business simulator where you build your company from zero to millionaire. Drive around an open world, manage employees, expand into different businesses, and become the richest in the city.

games.name: Piñata Puppy World
games.summary: Piñata Puppy World is a 2000’s nostalgia driven explorative campaign game with a dramatic and surreal storyline disguised within the genre of “Mascot Horror”.

games.name: Playback
games.summary:
PLAYBACK is a first-person psychological horror game set in the abandoned Ravenwood Street. Explore dark buildings, collect mysterious VHS tapes, and uncover hidden documents that reveal the disturbing history of the street and the people who once lived there.
A dangerous entity roams the area, forcing you to stay alert as you investigate locations including Panda’s Bamboo Bar, Wilted Rose, and other forgotten businesses. Every discovery brings you closer to the truth behind missing children, secret experiments, and the mysterious Dr. Zeno.
Search Ravenwood Street, survive the entity, and uncover what was never meant to be found.

games.name: Poco Loco
games.summary:
Poco Loco is a chaotic racing game for Twitch and Kick streamers. Host your own races, stream them live, and let your viewers join the grid with their own vehicles. Fill the track with up to 500 racers, start the madness from your creator arena, and watch your community battle for XP, standings, and bragging rights.

Engage more with your viewers by turning chat into a full racing grid on your stream. Create a session, fill the lobby, launch the race, and crown the fastest legends when the finish flag drops!

Get ready for fast, furious, hilariously chaotic races for your viewers and you!

games.name: Ponchorado
games.summary: Ponchorado is a satirical Wild West survival-action game with roguelite elements in a 1930s cartoon style, set in the ruins of a never-finished western movie. Play as Poncho, a forgotten stuntman battling through chaos, clichés, and caricatures.

games.name: Potion Craft Together
games.summary: Need a break? Open your own fantasy potion shop with your friends! Gather ingredients, process them, brew potions, and cure the troubles of customers visiting your shop. Add Potion Craft Together to your Wishlist and prepare to step into a magical world with your friends!

games.name: Prism Warriors DX
games.summary: The Prism Warriors return for another helping of retro-styled bullet hell action. Face off against the sinister Twilight Four, and fight to save more than just your friends...

games.name: Prismarch
games.summary: A colorful chess roguelike! Engage in dopaminergic, cinematic strategy while you fulfill a chess power fantasy - your pieces gain abilities as you construct a juiced up roster capable of surviving the onslaught! Only - seven mysterious prismatic kings stand before you and the one true crown...

games.name: Proxima B
games.summary: A short Sci-fi adventure game made for the Game Boy Color in GB Studio! Solve puzzles, collect energy for your weapons, and fight the alien Ackloids to claim the planet Proxima B for the humans!

games.name: Pure Pool Pro
games.summary: Welcome to Pure Pool Pro; the ultimate pool simulation. Play solo or online, master every game type, and compete in high-stakes tournaments in immersive venues. Experience breathtaking 8K native visuals, lifelike physics, and pinpoint-precise controls.

games.name: Push Through Hell
games.summary: Survival roguelite, where endless waves of monsters and enemies try to stop you from completing your objective. Choose your character, find upgrades and defeat bosses. Will you be able to move The Core all the way to the end, or will you die trying?

games.name: Puzzlor
games.summary: A strategic rogue-lite puzzle game where you collect and place Tetris-style pieces to defeat fantasy villains, unlock characters and upgrades, and build powerful runs. Focused on replayability, quick sessions, and meaningful strategic choices. Set in a traditional high fantasy world.

games.name: Queen of the Community
games.summary: Tackle the challenge of raising a little girl into adulthood under the harsh conditions of a Brazilian favela. Be the girl's adoptive father or mother! Buy her clothes, furniture and other objects, change her haircut and more! She can befriend several kids! Your choices will define her future!

games.name: RV There Yet?
games.summary: A co-op adventure about driving your Recreational Vehicle home.

games.name: Raise: Embrace the Future
games.summary: rAIse: Embrace the Future is a classic style first-person shooter inspired by cyberpunk and the golden age of 90s action games. Battle gangs and megacorporations in intense firefights driven by a brutal soundtrack.

games.name: Re: Spin. Die. Repeat.
games.summary: You died by misfortune and were reborn by fate. In this medieval slot-machine roguelike deckbuilder with isekai RPG roots, every spin shapes your destiny. Manipulate luck, outwit the Dark Goddess, and stop the quiet spread of darkness. Just when you think you reach the end the wheel spins once more.

games.name: Reactonix Sandbox
games.summary: Reactonix is a flexible and enjoyable simulation sandbox where every force is at your command. Create ecosystems alone or with friends, experiment with physics and watch life evolve—or start an apocalypse for the sake of science. Complete freedom to create and destroy is in your hands.

games.name: Redast
games.summary: Redast: Define the first-person co-op Horror-Observation genre. Observe 50 unique entities in the world's most unsettling corners and identify the unknown. An experience unlike any other, a hunt like no other. Darkness awaits.

games.name: Redemption of the Damned
games.summary:
You are a field doctor's assistant who was heading to a distant village to help local peasants. Someone attacked your stagecoach and you wake up in a mass grave, being the only survivor.

The player fights against monsters and other evil spirits in various biomes of the cursed forest, and the only safe place is the village, where he can complete tasks, recuperate or replenish supplies. In each location the player will meet with the guardian of this zone - the boss, who is the iconic character of the folklore of Western and Eastern Europe. The main goal of the game is to get into the high castle in order to eliminate its owner.

The player's arsenal is represented by a wide range of firearms typical for the chosen era - ancient flintlock pistols, classic revolvers, muskets and rifles, as well as special tools for certain types of enemies like vampires, ghouls, werewolves, swamp creatures, spirits, etc.

What scared you, being myths and scary tales, becomes reality and...attacks!

games.name: Regret to Inform
games.summary: A game about finding reasons to say "no." Review resumes, detect inconsistencies, and deliver rejection letters.

games.name: Remote Life Simulator
games.summary: Work remotely, build skills, earn money, and upgrade your life. Become a professional remote worker in this life simulation game!

games.name: Revolution: Young Mao
games.summary: Set around 1929, this interactive visual novel lets you relive the early Red Army's epic journey from a first-person perspective. Experience immersive historical narratives and make pivotal branching choices. Beware: wrong decisions will end your game!

games.name: Rewindead
games.summary: Rewindead is a single-player, third-person shooter about contract killing in time loops. Assassinate your target, rewind time, then eliminate your past selves before they complete the hit.

games.name: Robo Frenzy
games.summary: Build and battle in Robo Frenzy! Create dozens of weapons and construct inventions to crush gigantic gadgets in a sandbox action game that blends crafting with combat.

games.name: Rogue Hanafuda
games.summary: A roguelike deckbuilding game meets Hanafuda. Never played Hanafuda before? No problem. Jump right in and discover an addictive roguelike card game that's easy to learn but impossible to put down.

games.name: SCP: Pale Weaver
games.summary: SCP: Pale Weaver is a 2D pixel-art action-adventure. Play as a runaway anomaly: grapple with tentacles, fire silk tethers, and slow time to outrun lockdowns. Death resets the loop—your memory remains, driving you to the Endgame.

games.name: Samara
games.summary: A punishment trip turns into a nightmare. Trapped in a haunted school and an endless time loop, you must uncover the truth and find the killer before everyone disappears

games.name: Schizophrenia: R.E.M. Protocol
games.summary: Schizophrenia is a game where you have to not go crazy and get out of the bunker. Use all the items you can find to survive. Remember. The main thing is not to go crazy. And further. Don't make loud noises. They can hear you.

games.name: School Crisis
games.summary: A third-person co-op stealth comedy where up to four players sneak into an all-girls campus, while one player becomes the principal — the aggressive hunter with a shinai. Talk to the girls who only trust specific characters, complete missions, rescue captured friends, and survive the chaos together.

games.name: School's Out
games.summary: Trapped in a mysterious place modeled after an old school, an amnesiac hero joins forces with several enigmatic heroines to confront endlessly looping spaces and terrifying monsters. As they search for escape and the truth behind it all, they begin to break free from the fate that binds them.

games.name: Scourge of the Reptiles
games.summary: Scourge of the Reptiles is a party-based tactical RPG set in a prehistoric fantasy world. When a meteor strikes the Earth, humans, elves and dinosaurs alike are gifted with magical abilities—abilities that result in war, devastation and forces that stretch far beyond the hero’s quiet home village.

games.name: Secret of Sardinia
games.summary: Swim through a desolate underwater world to discover the truth of your lost civilization. As the last sardine in Sardinia, you must translate ancient fragments, listen to the voices of the dead, and rebuild a forgotten mythology as you uncover the deepest secrets of the sea.

games.name: Shadowverse
games.summary:
"Shadowverse: the next evolution in collectible card games!

Welcome to the fierce battlegrounds of Shadowverse, Japan's #1 competitive card collecting game!

From the creators of Rage of Bahamut and RPG sensation Granblue Fantasy, Shadowverse features AAA artwork and unique game mechanics that make it the most visually and tactically rich CCG on the market.

- SUMMON 400+ cards, each lavishly illustrated with jaw-dropping fantasy art
- STRATEGIZE with innovative mechanics that guarantee thrilling battles
- MASTER seven character classes each with unique play styles and killer cards
- BATTLE real-time opponents from around the world, or enjoy the fully voiced story mode

Come join our fun-loving community and show us your Shadowverse style! "

games.name: Shark Rain
games.summary: The very first Shark-Based Shooter game! Become a cute shark-girl and speed through water then emerge in human form and blast your enemies to oblivion! Nowhere will they be safe, not even on land!

games.name: Shelf Life
games.summary: Solve your supervisor's deadly task sequence to survive, but be warned: every wrong guess makes the store a more monstrous labyrinth. Unravel the horrific code and finally clock out, or be a permanent employee.

games.name: Shield of Breaker
games.summary: Shield of Breaker is a single-player Action-RPG set in a fantasy world. Protect your castle from endless waves of enemies and turn the tide of battle by deflecting their own blazing fireballs. Choose your hero, upgrade your powers,. Each victory unlocks your path to defend new lands in your realm.

games.name: Sinking Eternity
games.summary: Sinking Eternity is a single-player underwater exploration RPG. Survive extreme depths, hide from dangerous sea creatures, and uncover the secrets of a civilization lost for millennia.

games.name: Skelly's Skirmish
games.summary: Arcade platforming action with a spooky theme and a Game Boy aesthetic.

games.name: Skinwalker: First Blood
games.summary: Skinwalker is a hack n’ slash action platformer where you swear allegiance to a formidable beast to save your daughter from a terminal illness. Shapeshift into the creature’s monstrous form and wield untamed wrath in exchange for its freedom and the promise of a cure.

games.name: Socrates Ragebait
games.summary: Socrates and his crew are back and they won't stop yapping. Block the doors, survive the philosophical ragebait, and contain these ancient thinkers before they break your brain.

games.name: Sonya
games.summary: A surreal horror where your decisions and moral choices shape your destiny. Navigate a hospital, listen to the inner voices, and discover a truth that will break your mind.

games.name: Soulcery: Deck of Shadows
games.summary: An action roguelike fused with deck-building combat. Steal enemy abilities to shape your battle deck and unleash relentless, zero-cooldown combos.

games.name: Soup4U
games.summary: An exploration game made in Bapalon for SOUPJAM2026.

games.name: Spacerocks
games.summary: Mine asteroids, find rare loot, upgrade & modify your ship, build space factories, and destroy your enemies in this next-level space shooter. Just... One... More... Asteroid...

games.name: Sparkball
games.summary: Sparkball is a 4v4 adrenaline-packed ‘sports brawler’ where players select from a cast of lovably unique heroes and carefully balance both ballin' and brawlin' to score in the enemy team's goal! Affectionately described as League of Legends meets Rocket League (or Kung Fu-tbol!), Sparkball grips you immediately with its dopamine-inducing take on combat sports and keeps you coming back for more as you strive to master its surprisingly complex strategies.

games.name: Spin Blade Shop Simulator
games.summary: Run your own Spin Blade shop! Stock shelves with rare parts, craft your powerful collection and build your ultimate shop for customers. Discover legendary sets and test your collection in thrilling PvE battles.

games.name: Squingle Arcade
games.summary: Experience Squingle’s trippy VR/MR evolution in its FREE-TO-PLAY sequel, Squingle Arcade. Guide twin orbs through 100+ morphing 3D mazes in your room. Master hand-tracked “Squingles,” chase high scores, and climb global leaderboards in a psychedelic arcade puzzle journey.

games.name: Star Sailors
games.summary:
A fairy-tale fantasy world.

Star Sailors is a collectible turn-based RPG set in an anime-inspired JRPG fantasy world. Gather and grow captivating characters, summonlings, and gear to challenge dungeons & bosses and compete against other players.

Experiment with countless strategies and team combinations to claim victory.

games.name: Still Rolling
games.summary: Still Rolling is an incremental idle game where you roll dice and try to get six sixes in a row. Upgrade your probability and various other things to improve your odds.

games.name: Storm the Field
games.summary: Among a Viking tribe, you wield rune-magic in a puzzle version of chess with abilities instead of pawns. Cast powerful abilities onto enemy forces in calculated patterns and clear the board over successive turns.

games.name: Stranger Mahjong
games.summary: Stranger Tiles is a Mahjong-based strategy game. Step into a surreal dreamscape and duel against feline opponents. Optimize your tile setup and employ calculated strategies to counter speed with patience. Smash through the dream stages and defeat the Eternal Nightmare!

games.name: Strike City
games.summary:
Strike City is a 3D idle tycoon about building a bowling empire, where every purchase appears as a real object on the alley floor: lanes, beer taps, arcade cabinets, disco balls. Players buy and restyle lanes, staff the front desk, bar, pro shop, and arcade, keep the health inspector at bay, and furnish 37 individually upgradable interior pieces across eight rooms while a full day and night cycle moves bowlers through the house.

The campaign spans five cities, from Smallville to Capital Plaza, with 19 bookable events ranging from kids’ birthdays to pro tournaments, rival alleys that drop in with wagers, and a franchise system that grants permanent prestige bonuses for starting over faster.

games.name: Suck It Up
games.summary: You never cleaned your room… and now the dust fights back. Blast your way through waves of dirty creatures in this fast-paced roguelite FPS. Vacuum to grow stronger, parkour to survive, and finally make your mom proud.

games.name: Sugar Orbit
games.summary: A platformer where you play a gummibear jumping between planets to rescue lost gummies, playable at your own pace but built for speedrunners and perfect runs.

games.name: Supermarket Chaos
games.summary: Supermarket Chaos is a cozy organizing simulator where you sort 4,668 products in a messy supermarket. Enjoy the satisfaction of stocking shelves in a calm, relaxing atmosphere.

games.name: Supre-Immune
games.summary: Supremmune is a top-down arena game where you play as an immune cell fighting off bacteria and viruses. Earn DNA from battles to buy weapons and items, enhancing each cell's abilities. Make strategic choices to survive unexpected challenges. Evolve into a powerful cell, defeat enemies, and win!

games.name: Sweetie Candy Maze: Blackberry
games.summary: Dive into a vibrant candy world! Collect delicious sweets and find your way through playful blackberry mazes in this sweet and colorful adventure.

games.name: Syntax: Overload
games.summary: Compile. Execute. Overload. A strategic roguelite where Syntax is Everything. Drag & drop modules to optimize your execution queue, install .EXE software to break the rules, and face off against legendary viruses like ILOVEYOU and WannaCry. Can you crash the system and escape?

games.name: Taking Today Off
games.summary: Taking Today Off is a light-hearted roguelike deck-builder about managing modern life states. Draw cards, place them on the board, add stickers and tools, and build playful combos. Easy to learn, with fresh choices and strategies every run.

games.name: Talewarden: Riders of the New Day
games.summary: Talewarden is a weird west adventure visual novel. Restore time on a planet where the sun never sets as you explore locations, talk, romance, and bond with your companions. Find the source of the voice in your head and discover why you all fell here from different worlds.

games.name: Tax Return
games.summary: If the suits at the SRI think they can fleece people's taxes, they'd better watch out for the wolf. Join Swindling Steve as you take back your hard-earned money from the SRI's collectors, but watch out for the high rollers behind the scenes.

games.name: Telluricene
games.summary: Love is deception, germinated in desperation. Fill the role of one of the nation's top researchers. You will have 10 days to study the rapidly spreading and mysterious new species to decide: friend or foe? The coming Telluricene rests in your hands.

games.name: Tenshi Sword Quest
games.summary: This is a 2D horizontal board platform puzzle game about finding one's own Sword Of Scarlet Perception by the Hinanawi Tenshi. She use her ability to manipulate stones to overcome numerous obstacles and find the unclaimed Sword Of Scarlet Perception.

games.name: Terra Fighters
games.summary: The world is your weapon in this earth-slinging platform fighter where champions defend their continents from collapse!

games.name: Terradune
games.summary: Terradune is a hand-drawn 2D action RPG where you battle monsters, discover hidden treasures, and shape your hero’s fate. Explore scorching deserts, moonlit forests, and thrilling dungeons to uncover secrets in this fast-paced, immersive adventure.

games.name: Terrible Lizards
games.summary: Terrible Lizards is a horror parkour game set against the backdrop of an old Route 66 attraction… with something dark and sinister lurking below. To escape, you’ll need to move fast, navigate challenging terrain, and uncover what Dalton’s Dinos is really hiding. You’d better start running.

games.name: The Battle for Vega
games.summary: Inspired by the classic Space Invaders, The Battle for Vega takes the old-school gameplay you know and love and adds new features that make it a fresh and exciting experience.

games.name: The Elder Scrolls: Blades
games.summary: Take the Elder Scrolls anywhere you go with The Elder Scrolls: Blades. Revealed during the 2018 Bethesda E3 Showcase, Blades is an all-new Elder Scrolls game from Bethesda Game Studios. Launching in winter 2019, Blades will be free-to-play on iPhone, iPad and Android devices.

games.name: The Flinch: Unforgiven West
games.summary: To pull the trigger takes guts; to miss invites death. Hunt down 10 sinners in this mouse-only Noir Western. Battle your own nerves and a cursed revolver where hand tremors make every duel a gamble. How steady is your aim?

games.name: The Henchmen
games.summary: The Henchmen is a chaotic co-op heist game where you and your crew play as clueless, disposable henchmen pulling off robberies that are way above your pay grade. Sneak, steal, mess up, improvise, and try to escape with the loot.

games.name: The House They Left Behind
games.summary: A first-person horror game about returning to a familiar place that no longer feels safe. Explore a remote house, search for your missing grandparents, and uncover what was happening right in front of you all along.

games.name: The Hungry Town
games.summary:
The Hungry Town is an interactive visual novel in a dark fantasy setting with vampires.
You are a young vampire who has been drawn into a violent confrontation between two generations of vampires. You will have to choose a side or decide to stay true to yourself.

games.name: The Joust
games.summary: The Joust delivers laughably fun physics, HD cartoony graphics, and endless ways to brawl! Battle as a medieval knight, a futuristic space warrior, or even an elephant... with over 80 classes to choose from, the choice is yours! Multiplayer and Singleplayer are supported in a first-class fashion!

games.name: The Long Way Home
games.summary: You are alone on a drifting starship. No humans, only robots. As Miner 13-553; craft, farm, repair, upgrade skills and find your way home. Fight the machines or choose a peaceful path. Explore the mystery or just focus on the journey. The choice is yours.

games.name: The Loopler
games.summary: The Loopler is a idle-like roguelite simulation of a car driving in loops. Pick upgrades, place gates and sit back and relax as the mesmerizing loop gets going and the dopamine hits of numbers going up fills your brain. See if you can go endless and beyond.

games.name: The Shores of Stellaluna
games.summary: Sail a fractured world. Battle through dangerous dungeons, Stack powerful abilities, Rebuild cities, Manage trade, Survive ever-changing islands to gather lumen, get more powerful and shape the fate of a broken world in this first person craft and build focused RPG with a strong storyline.

games.name: The Song Of Will
games.summary: Arise and step into the whimsical, mysterious world of The Song Of WILL, a turn-based, story driven RPG that feels alive!

games.name: The Stalked 3
games.summary: A late-night thrill turns into a nightmare. Olivia sneaks into Creepwood Wonderland Carnival with her boyfriend, expecting a fun night alone in the park. But something feels off. Distant footsteps. Faint whispers. Someone else is here… Watching.

games.name: The Story of Mikagoyama
games.summary: This is an RPG where you explore a mountain called Mikagoyama. The water from this mountain is very delicious.The water from this mountain is very delicious.The water from this mountain is very delicious.The water from this mountain is very delicious.The water from this mountain is very delicious.Th

games.name: The Zodiac Mystery
games.summary: Step into The Zodiac Mystery, where a suspense-filled adventure begins! Players are immersed in a complex and bewildering cold case, searching for clues across time and space. Examine crime scenes, review files, and analyze evidence, following the trail concealed within a celestial haze.

games.name: Thief's Adventure
games.summary: A real-time tactical stealth game set in a gritty medieval fantasy world. Sneak, loot, and ambush your enemies. Being spotted means death.

games.name: Timberflow: Sawmill Simulator
games.summary: From a single tree to an entire industry! Manage and automate your lumber business in this relaxing, yet challenging Sawmill Simulator. Start small, grow rich, dominate the market.

games.name: Time Travel Train
games.summary: Time Travel Train is a roguelite incremental game about commanding a weaponized locomotive through history. Battle enemies, and upgrade your train to become an unstoppable force. Your train never stops moving. Keep it fueled, destroy everything in your path, and collect scrap from the wreckage.

games.name: Trash: Tale of Wastetown
games.summary: Explore Wastetown, a metropolis populated by trashes. Play as Slim, a cardboard box, in an action-stealth adventure among dangers and secrets. Will you be able to face deadly enemies and defeat a great enemy that has now taken control of the city?

games.name: Tricky Doors
games.summary: Tricky doors is a captivating game that offers a variety of puzzles. Find a creative way to get out of each room. Tricky doors is a point-and-click game in the "escape the room" genre with plenty of mini-games and complicated quests.

games.name: Trinity Archetype
games.summary: Trinity Archetype is a roguelike turn-based RPG where you craft skills as you go! Mix and match dozens of runes, boost it up in battle and unleash devastating combos to reclaim your broken world.

games.name: Turbo Hatchback Time Attack
games.summary: A turbo-powered hatchback? In this economy? You bet! It does everything you'd expect a car to do like drift, jump and... flip. You know, usual car stuff. Keep the turbo charged and boost your way to the top of the leaderboards!

games.name: Twilight Protocol
games.summary: Twilight Protocol is an atmospheric detective horror about an employee who becomes trapped in a corporate mystery. Explore the city, gather clues, talk to locals and colleagues, and uncover the truth hidden beneath the surface.

games.name: Type the Rhythm
games.summary: A rhythm typing trainer where you type real words to a variety of musical styles. Augmented proprioception lets you move the grooves between your brain and fingers for faster, cleaner typing. From hunt-and-peck to 150 WPM blindfolded, Type The Rhythm moves you forward.

games.name: Ultra Damage
games.summary: Ultra Damage is a hand-drawn Boomer Shooter packed with humor and action, featuring hand-crafted visuals and a story blending gritty detective work with absurd comedy. Each level is a wild ride. Unravel the mystery, find hidden clues, and deal ultra damage to save humanity!

games.name: Unhinged
games.summary: It’s a dark and stormy night, the power’s gone out in an apartment building, and it turns out one woman, Ava (voiced by Zoë Kravitz), isn’t nearly as alone as she thought she was. Unhinged, out now, is unlike anything you’ve seen (or played) before. It’s an immersive game experience that puts you in the center of a thriller-turned-horror story, and your phone, which you use as a controller, is your only lifeline to escape.

games.name: Unholy Employer Simulator
games.summary: A roguelike, incremental business-sim where you cultivate a family environment, make BIG profit and sacrifice the lives of your employees to the devil. Welcome to the world of business.

games.name: Valvontaa
games.summary: Valvontaa is a sci-fi third-person action RPG set in the distant future. Interact with townsfolk and fight off hostile aliens to survive. Find unique armor and equipment to aid on your descent into the depths.

games.name: Vampire Rancher
games.summary: Rancher by day, Vampire by night. Manage your time and resources to restore your sleepy little town to its former glory, all while satisfying your vampire needs for blood. Oversee shops and saloons, farm crops and humans, and explore ancient vampiric ruins in the Weird Wild West!

games.name: Void Fragment
games.summary: The Void needs to grow. An idle incremental game where you feed a Void with Mana and Essences. Collect Void Fragments to upgrade the spirits, so they can continue feeding the Void even more.

games.name: Void Sanction
games.summary: A sci-fi action RPG. Battle alien hordes with fast-paced combat, evolving weapons, and a combat drone companion. Upgrade your arsenal, defeat challenging bosses, and explore a hostile alien world.

games.name: Voxel Playground
games.summary: Voxel Playground is a physics-based voxel sandbox VR game

games.name: Wacky Coursers
games.summary: Wacky Coursers is a chaotic parkour racing game where you run, jump, shrink, smash, flip gravity , fly with wings 🪽, and get launched through surprise tubes . Race solo or online—and laugh your way to the finish!

games.name: Wasteland Punk
games.summary: Wasteland Punk is a wild post-apocalyptic RPG where you'll venture into radioactive wastelands and impenetrable swamps, inhabited by bandits, mutants, and something far more dangerous... Kill, scavenge, craft, and survive at any cost!

games.name: We Need an Army
games.summary: We Need An Army is a fantasy roguelike grid based deck builder about recruiting a powerful army! Recruit units, match patterns, and upgrade your grid in this tactical roguelike slots-based deckbuilder.

games.name: Where Are the Fish?
games.summary: A short exploration game about driving around in a truck to find fish in the desert.

games.name: Whiskers Wizards & Wands
games.summary:
Whiskers Wizards and Wands is a whimsical and cozy adventure game. Take on the role of a Wizard Cat who interacts with the world around them via a customizable wand. Fight enemies, find secret treasures, design spell combinations, to repair a world that has been broken and scrambled.

The game has a beautiful orchestral score, and is completely hand-drawn. Every image was drawn with markers on paper before being placed into the game.

games.name: Why Elephant Sit on Chair?
games.summary: Why Elephant Sit On Chair? is a game that combines block-clearing with light roguelite elements. Team up with your animal block companions to face all kinds of unexpected challenges. every run is full of surprises! Just a tip: don't step on their tails.

games.name: Wildsite
games.summary: Crash-landed on an unknown planet filled with plasma and toxic weather. Your only hope? Bob, a sarcastic-genius AI who will question your every survival decision. Explore, build your mobile base and try to avoid death alongside up to 3 friends in Co-op.

games.name: WinBolo
games.summary: A multiplayer top-down tank game for up to 16 players. Capture bases and pillboxes, harvest trees, build roads and walls, lay mines, and battle for control of the island. The Macintosh classic, rebuilt for modern platforms — free, open source, and cross-platform across desktop, mobile, and web.

games.name: XO-Planets
games.summary: Frantic rogue-lite, action platformer, and tower defense, with a little rpg elements.

games.name: Xcavator 2025
games.summary: This is Xcavator 2025 (NES Cartridge), a fully functional NES title built from Oberth’s original design of the same name. First developed at Incredible Technologies Inc., the company behind coin-op classics like Golden Tee Golf, Big Buck Hunter, and more, Xcavator was shopped around to multiple publishers across the country way back in 1991, but it never found a home, and was quietly archived and never looked at again.

games.name: Zombie For Real
games.summary:
A cyberpunk idle RPG set in a city destroyed by a zombie outbreak.

Command powerful ninjas, defeat endless waves of zombies, and grow stronger through automatic progression, farming dungeons, boss battles, PvP Arena, rankings, and guild content.

Players from “Gacha de Deai wo Motomete” can import their previous progress and continue their adventure in a connected multiverse.

games.name: Āsh
games.summary: A short virtual museum exhibit. Explore the environments for as long as you'd like. When you are ready to move on, find and interact with the object of interest located somewhere in the room.
